title.zh: 卷7 本紀七 圣祖本紀二
title.raw: 卷7 本紀七 圣祖本紀二

sentences.zh: 二十一年壬戌春正月壬戌，上元節，賜廷臣宴，觀燈，用柏梁體賦詩。

translations.literal: Year 21, renxu, spring, first month, day renxu: Lantern Festival; the emperor bestowed a banquet on court ministers, viewed lanterns, and had poems composed in the Ballad of Cypress Beam form.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Kangxi year 21, on the renxu day of the Lantern Festival, the emperor gave a banquet to his ministers, watched the lamps, and ordered verses in the linked Ballad of Cypress Beam style.

sentences.zh: 上首唱云：「麗日和風被萬方。

translations.literal: The emperor led off, saying: "Bright sun and gentle wind cover the myriad realms.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor opened with the line, "Bright sun and gentle breeze reach every quarter of the realm."

sentences.zh: 」廷臣以次屬賦。

translations.literal: " Court ministers in turn composed matching lines.
translations.idiomatic: The court ministers then took up the rhyme in succession.

sentences.zh: 上為制昇平嘉宴詩序，刊石於翰林院。

translations.literal: The emperor composed the preface to the Ascendant Peace Festive Banquet poems and had it carved on stone at the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote the preface to the poems for the Ascendant Peace Festive Banquet and had it engraved on stone in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，調蔡毓榮為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Cai Yurong was transferred to be Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Cai Yurong was reassigned as governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，王大臣奏曰：「耿精忠累世王封，甘心叛逆，分擾浙、贛，及於皖、徽，設非師武臣力，蔓延曷極。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: princes and great ministers memorialized: "Geng Jingzhong enjoyed hereditary princely enfeoffment for generations, yet willingly rebelled, dividing his raids through Zhejiang and Jiangxi even into Anhui and Huizhou; but for the martial efforts of officers and troops, how far would the unrest have spread?
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, princes and senior ministers memorialized: "Geng Jingzhong held a hereditary princely fief for generations, yet chose rebellion and spread disorder through Zhejiang and Jiangxi into Anhui and Huizhou. Had it not been for the army's fighting strength, where would the turmoil have stopped?"

sentences.zh: 李本深、劉進忠等多年提鎮，高官厚祿，不能革其鴞音，俯首從賊，抑有何益。

translations.literal: Li Benshen, Liu Jinzhong, and others were provincial commanders for many years with high rank and ample stipends; they could not change their rebellious nature and bowed to follow the rebels — what good came of it?
translations.idiomatic: Li Benshen, Liu Jinzhong, and others had long served as provincial commanders with high office and rich pay, yet could not shake off their treacherous bent and submitted to the rebels — to what end?

sentences.zh: 均宜從嚴懲治，大為之防，以為世道人心之范。

translations.literal: All should be punished severely with strong precautions, as a model for public morals and popular sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: All alike should be punished with the utmost severity and guarded against firmly, as a standard for the age and for men's hearts.

sentences.zh: 謹擬議請旨。

translations.literal: We respectfully submit our deliberations for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully submit these recommendations for Your Majesty's decision.

sentences.zh: 」得旨：耿精忠、曾養性、白顯中、劉進忠、李本深均磔死梟首。

translations.literal: " An edict replied: Geng Jingzhong, Zeng Yangxing, Bai Xianzhong, Liu Jinzhong, and Li Benshen shall all be executed by slicing and their heads displayed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: Geng Jingzhong, Zeng Yangxing, Bai Xianzhong, Liu Jinzhong, and Li Benshen were all to be dismembered and their heads exposed.

sentences.zh: 耿精忠之子耿繼祚，李本深之孫李象乾、李象坤，其侄李濟祥、李濟民，暨祖弘勛等俱處斬。

translations.literal: Geng Jingzhong's son Geng Jizu, Li Benshen's grandsons Li Xiangqian and Li Xiangkun, his nephews Li Jixiang and Li Jimin, and Zu Hongxun and others were all sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Jingzhong's son Geng Jizu; Li Benshen's grandsons Li Xiangqian and Li Xiangkun; his nephews Li Jixiang and Li Jimin; and Zu Hongxun and others were all sentenced to execution.

sentences.zh: 為賊絓誤之陳夢雷、李學詩、金境、田起蛟均減死一等。

translations.literal: Chen Menglei, Li Xueshi, Jin Jing, and Tian Qijiao, who had been misled by the rebels, all had their sentences reduced one degree from death.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Menglei, Li Xueshi, Jin Jing, and Tian Qijiao, who had been drawn astray by the rebels, each had the death penalty commuted one grade.

sentences.zh: 己巳，特封安親王岳樂子岳希為僖郡王。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Yuexi, son of Prince An Yuele, was specially enfeoffed as Prince Xi of the Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Yuexi, son of Prince An Yuele, was specially created Prince Xi of the Commandery.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，以達都為左都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen: Dadu was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengchen day, Dadu was made left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以平滇遣官告祭岳瀆、古帝陵、先師闕里。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: because Yunnan had been pacified, officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the sacred mountains and rivers, ancient imperial tombs, and the shrine of the First Teacher at Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, with Yunnan pacified, officials were sent to announce sacrifices at the sacred peaks and rivers, the ancient imperial tombs, and the temple of the First Teacher at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the emperor presided at the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以佟國維為領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Tong Guowei was made Inner Grand Secretary in charge of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Tong Guowei was appointed grand secretary in charge of the imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上齋居景山，為太皇太后祝釐。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the emperor fasted and dwelt at Jingshan to offer blessings for the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the emperor kept abstinence and resided at Jingshan to pray for blessings on behalf of the grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上東巡，啟鑾。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the emperor toured east and set forth from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the emperor began an eastern tour and departed the capital.

sentences.zh: 皇太子胤礽從。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Yinti accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Yinreng accompanied him.

sentences.zh: 蒙古王貝勒等請上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: Mongol princes and beiles requested that the emperor accept an honorific title; he did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol princes and beiles asked that he accept a honorific title; he refused.

sentences.zh: 以穆佔為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Muzhan was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhan was appointed commander-in-chief of the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 妖人朱方旦伏誅。

translations.literal: The sorcerer Zhu Fangdan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The sorcerer Zhu Fangdan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，次山海關，遣大臣祭伯夷、叔齊廟。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: halting at Shanhaiguan, he dispatched ministers to sacrifice at the temple of Boyi and Shuqi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, stopping at Shanhaiguan, he sent ministers to offer sacrifice at the shrine of Boyi and Shuqi.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，上謁福陵、昭陵，駐蹕盛京。

translations.literal: Third month, day renzi: the emperor visited the Fu and Zhao tombs and halted at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renzi day, the emperor visited the Fu and Zhao tombs and halted at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，告祭於福陵。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: he announced sacrifices at the Fu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, he performed the announcement sacrifice at the Fu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，告祭於昭陵。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: he announced sacrifices at the Zhao Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, he performed the announcement sacrifice at the Zhao Tomb.

sentences.zh: 大賚將軍以下，至守陵官、年老致仕官及甲兵廢閒者。

translations.literal: He bestowed largesse from the general down to tomb-guarding officials, aged retired officials, and idle bannermen and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He gave generous gifts from the general downward, including tomb guardians, elderly retired officials, and idle bannermen and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 曲赦盛京、寧古塔。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted in Mukden and Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: A limited amnesty was proclaimed for Mukden and Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 蠲蹕路所過租稅。

translations.literal: Land tax along the imperial route was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax along the route of the imperial progress was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己未，上謁永陵，行告祭禮。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the emperor visited the Yong Tomb and performed the announcing-sacrifice rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the emperor visited the Yong Tomb and performed the announcement sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 上具啟太皇太后、皇太后進奉鰱魚、𩺀魚。

translations.literal: The emperor submitted memorials to the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager offering mud carp and ma fish.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor presented memorials to the grand empress dowager and empress dowager, sending tribute of mud carp and ma fish.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上由山道幸烏拉行圍。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the emperor went by the mountain route to Wula for a hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the emperor took the mountain road to Wula for a hunting camp.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，望祭長白山。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: he performed a distant sacrifice to Changbai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, he offered a distant sacrifice to Changbai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，泛舟松花江。

translations.literal: Day yihai: he rowed boats on the Songhua River.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, he went boating on the Songhua River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi: the emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinsi day, the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 賜寧古塔將軍、副都統宴，賚致仕官及甲士。

translations.literal: He gave banquets to the general and lieutenant-general of Ningguta and bestowed gifts on retired officials and bannermen and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He feasted the general and lieutenant-general of Ningguta and rewarded retired officials, bannermen, and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，次中後所。

translations.literal: Day yisi: he halted at Zhonghousuo.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, he stopped at Zhonghousuo.

sentences.zh: 流人王廷試子德麟叩閽乞代父戍，部議不準。

translations.literal: Exile Wang Tingshi's son Delin knelt at the gate begging to serve his father's military exile in his stead; the ministry deliberated and denied it.
translations.idiomatic: Delin, son of the exile Wang Tingshi, came to the gate and begged to take his father's place in frontier service; the ministry considered the request and refused.

sentences.zh: 上諭：「王德麟所言情甚可憫。

translations.literal: The emperor directed: "What Wang Delin says is deeply pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Wang Delin's plea is deeply moving.

sentences.zh: 遇朕來此，亦難得之遭。

translations.literal: That he should meet with my coming here is a rare chance.
translations.idiomatic: To meet me here on my tour is a chance that seldom comes.

sentences.zh: 其父子俱讀書人，可均釋回。

translations.literal: Father and son are both men of learning; both may be released and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Father and son are both scholars; let both be released and sent home."

translations.literal: " (End of imperial rescript.)
translations.idiomatic: Thus ordered.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，上還京。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinhai: the emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinhai day, the emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔寧古塔地方苦寒，流人改發遼陽。

translations.literal: Day renzi: an edict stated that Ningguta was bitterly cold; exiles were henceforth to be sent to Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, an edict declared that Ningguta was too bitterly cold and that exiles should henceforth be sent to Liaoyang instead.

sentences.zh: 己未，大學士杜立德乞休，溫旨允之。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Grand Secretary Du Lide requested retirement; a gracious edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Grand Secretary Du Lide asked to retire; a warm edict approved his request.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，免吉林貢鷹，減省徭役。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: tribute hawks from Jilin were abolished and corvée levies reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the Jilin hawk tribute was abolished and labor levies were cut.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以王熙為大學士。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wang Xi was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Wang Xi was appointed grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，以佟國瑤為福州將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou: Tong Guoyao was appointed General of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yiyou day, Tong Guoyao was made general of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以公倭赫為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the duke Wohe was appointed Mongol Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Duke Wohe was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大學士馮溥乞休，溫旨允之，差官護送，馳驛回籍。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Grand Secretary Feng Pu requested retirement; a gracious edict granted it, officials were dispatched to escort him, and he was sent home by relay post.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Grand Secretary Feng Pu asked to retire; a warm edict granted it, officials were sent to escort him, and he was hurried home by relay.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，以杭艾為左都御史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: Hang Ai was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengxu day, Hang Ai was made left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命刑部尚書魏象樞、吏部侍郎科爾坤巡察畿輔，豪強虐民者拘執以聞。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Minister of Justice Wei Xiangjue and Vice Minister of Personnel Ke'erken were ordered to inspect the capital region; powerful bullies who abused the people were to be seized and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Wei Xiangjue, minister of justice, and Ke'erken, vice minister of personnel, were ordered to tour the capital districts; local bullies who oppressed the people were to be arrested and reported.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以三逆蕩平宣示蒙古。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the complete pacification of the Three Rebels was announced to the Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, news that the Three Rebellions had been wholly suppressed was proclaimed to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，詔內閣學士參知政事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: an edict made Grand Secretaries of the Secretariat participate in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingzi day, an edict authorized secretariat grand secretaries to take part in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，譚弘之子譚天祕、譚天倫伏誅。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Tan Hong's sons Tan Tianmi and Tan Tianlun were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Tan Hong's sons Tan Tianmi and Tan Tianlun were put to death.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，賜蔡升元等一百七十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen: Cai Shengyuan and 176 others were granted jinshi degrees with ranks according to distinction.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wushen day, Cai Shengyuan and 176 others received jinshi degrees, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔每日御朝聽政，春夏以辰初，秋冬以辰正。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict ordered daily attendance at court; in spring and summer audiences began at the first chen watch, in autumn and winter at the second chen watch.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, an edict required daily court audiences: in spring and summer from the first chen watch, in autumn and winter from the second chen watch.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，定遠大將軍貝子彰泰、征南大將軍都統賴塔凱旋，上郊勞之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiashen: the Pacifier of the Far, Prince Bao Tai, and the Southern Expedition Commander-in-Chief Laita returned in triumph; the emperor met them with suburban honors.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiashen day, the far-pacifying prince Zhangtai and the southern expedition commander-in-chief Laita returned in victory; the emperor received them with suburban honors.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以黃機、吳正治為大學士。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Huang Ji and Wu Zhengzhi were made Grand Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Huang Ji and Wu Zhengzhi were appointed grand secretaries.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔重修太祖實錄，纂修三朝聖訓、平定三逆方略。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: an edict ordered the Veritable Records of Taizu to be revised and the Sacred Instructions of three reigns and the Strategic Account of Pacifying the Three Rebels to be compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, an edict ordered the Veritable Records of Taizu revised and the compilation of the Sacred Instructions of three reigns and the Strategic Account of Pacifying the Three Rebellions.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，以李之芳為兵部尚書，希福為西安將軍，瓦岱為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiayin: Li Zhifang was made Minister of War, Xifu General of Xi'an, and Wadai General of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiayin day, Li Zhifang was made minister of war, Xifu general of Xi'an, and Wadai general of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔廣西建雙忠祠，祀巡撫馬雄鎮、傅弘烈。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: an edict ordered the Double Loyalty Shrine built in Guangxi to enshrine Governors Ma Xiongzhen and Fu Honglie.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, an edict ordered a Double Loyalty Shrine built in Guangxi to honor the governors Ma Xiongzhen and Fu Honglie.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以趙賴為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Zhao Lai was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Zhao Lai was appointed commander-in-chief of the Chinese banners.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以施維翰為浙江總督，以噶爾漢為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Shi Weihan was made Governor-General of Zhejiang and Garhan Commander-in-Chief of the Manchu Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Shi Weihan was made governor-general of Zhejiang and Garhan commander-in-chief of the Manchu banners.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，前廣西巡撫陳洪起從賊論死，命流寧古塔。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jimao: former Guangxi Governor Chen Hongqi, convicted of following the rebels and sentenced to death, was ordered exiled to Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jimao day, the former Guangxi governor Chen Hongqi, condemned to death for following the rebels, was ordered exiled to Ningguta instead.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以許貞為廣東提督。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Xu Zhen was made Provincial Commander of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Xu Zhen was appointed provincial commander of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 戊子，錄達海之孫陳布祿為刑部郎中。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Sun of Lu Duhai Chen Bulu was enrolled and appointed Director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Chen Bulu, grandson of the ennobled Lu Duhai, was recorded and appointed a director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，論行軍失律罪，簡親王喇布奪爵，餘遣戍降黜有差。

translations.literal: Day guisi: military discipline violations were adjudicated; Prince Jian Labu was stripped of his rank, and the rest were exiled, demoted, or dismissed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, offenses for breach of military discipline were judged; Prince Jian Labu was deprived of his title, and the others were exiled, demoted, or cashiered in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 庚子，郎談使黑龍江還，上羅剎犯邊事狀。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: envoy Lang Tan returned from the Amur and reported on Russian border incursions.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the envoy Lang Tan returned from the Amur and reported Russian raids on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 命寧古塔將軍巴海、副都統薩布素率師防之。

translations.literal: Bahai, General of Ningguta, and Lieutenant-General Sabusu were ordered to lead troops in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Bahai, general of Ningguta, and Lieutenant-General Sabusu were ordered to lead troops in defense.

sentences.zh: 建木城於黑龍江、呼馬爾，分軍屯田。

translations.literal: Wooden forts were built on the Amur and Hurka rivers, and troops were divided to open military farms.
translations.idiomatic: Wooden stockades were built on the Amur and Hurka rivers, and detachments were assigned to garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、山東、山西、浙江、湖廣等省七十八州縣衛被災額賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, quota land tax was remitted in varying degrees for seventy-eight prefectures, districts, and garrisons stricken by disaster in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, scheduled land tax was remitted in varying amounts for seventy-eight disaster-stricken prefectures, districts, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Annam sent tribute missions.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Annam sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二十二年癸亥春正月乙卯，宴賚廷臣。

translations.literal: Year 22, guihai, spring, first month, day yimao: a feast was given for court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Kangxi year 22, on the yimao day, the emperor feasted and rewarded his ministers.

sentences.zh: 己未，上閱官校較射。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the emperor reviewed archery contests among official students.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the emperor watched archery matches among the official students.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，帥顏保罷，以介山為禮部尚書，喀爾圖為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiyou: Suibianbao was dismissed; Jieshan was made Minister of Rites and Ka'ertu Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guiyou day, Suibianbao was removed from office; Jieshan was made minister of rites and Ka'ertu minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上幸五台山。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the emperor visited Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the emperor went to Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，還京。

translations.literal: Third month, day wushen: he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wushen day, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以噶爾漢為荊州將軍，彭春為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Garhan was made General of Jingzhou and Peng Chun Commander-in-Chief of the Manchu Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Garhan was made general of Jingzhou and Peng Chun commander-in-chief of the Manchu banners.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，命提鎮諸臣以次入覲。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yihai: provincial commanders were ordered to enter court for audience in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yihai day, provincial commanders were ordered to come to court for audience in turn.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命巴海回駐烏拉，薩布素、瓦禮祜帥師駐額蘇里備邊。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Bahai was ordered back to garrison Wula; Sabusu and Walihu were to lead troops stationed at Esuri for border defense.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Bahai was ordered back to garrison Wula; Sabusu and Walihu were to command troops posted at Esuri to guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以公坡爾盆為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the duke Po'erpen was appointed Mongol Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Duke Po'erpen was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，設漢軍火器營。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu: the Chinese Banner Firearms Brigade was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingwu day, the Chinese-banner firearms brigade was established.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命施琅征台灣。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Shi Lang was ordered to campaign against Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Shi Lang was ordered to campaign against Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，上閱內庫，頒賚廷臣幣器。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingchou: the emperor inspected the inner treasury and distributed silks and vessels to court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingchou day, the emperor inspected the inner treasury and distributed silks and vessels among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以伊桑阿為吏部尚書，杭艾為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Yisang'a was made Minister of Personnel and Hang Ai Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Yisang'a was made minister of personnel and Hang Ai minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上奉太皇太后避暑古北口。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to take the cool air at Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the emperor escorted the grand empress dowager to take the summer air at Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 閏六月戊午，施琅克澎湖。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day wuwu: Shi Lang took Penghu.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on the wuwu day, Shi Lang captured Penghu.

sentences.zh: 庚申，諭飭刑官勘獄勿淹系。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: an edict admonished judicial officials to examine cases and not prolong detention.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict warned judicial officials to investigate cases promptly and not hold prisoners indefinitely.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，車駕次胡圖克圖，賜隨圍蒙古王公冠服，兵士銀幣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: the imperial procession halted at Hutuktu; he bestowed caps and robes on Mongol princes who joined the hunt and silver coins on the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, the imperial train stopped at Hutuktu; he gave caps and robes to Mongol princes who joined the hunt and silver to the soldiers.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上奉太皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the emperor escorted the grand empress dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，命經筵大典，大學士以下侍班。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengzi: for the grand Classics lecture, Grand Secretaries and those below were ordered to attend in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengzi day, for the great Classics lecture, grand secretaries and those below were ordered to attend in attendance.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以哈佔為兵部尚書，科爾坤為左都御史。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Hazhan was made Minister of War and Ke'erken Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Hazhan was made minister of war and Ke'erken left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，施琅疏報師入台灣，鄭克塽率其屬劉國軒等迎降，台灣平。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Shi Lang memorialized that the army had entered Taiwan; Zheng Keshuang led his followers Liu Guoxuan and others out to surrender; Taiwan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Shi Lang reported that his forces had entered Taiwan; Zheng Keshuang led Liu Guoxuan and the rest out to surrender, and Taiwan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 詔錫克塽、國軒封爵，封施琅靖海侯，將士擢賚有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted Zheng Keshuang and Liu Guoxuan ennoblement, enfeoffed Shi Lang as Marquis Pacifying the Sea, and promoted and rewarded officers and soldiers according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ennobled Zheng Keshuang and Liu Guoxuan, created Shi Lang marquis Pacifying the Sea, and promoted and rewarded officers and men according to merit.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，以丁思孔為偏沅巡撫。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: Ding Sikong was made Governor of Bianyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guiyou day, Ding Sikong was appointed governor of Bianyuan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上奉太皇太后幸五台山。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the emperor escorted the grand empress dowager to Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，次長城嶺，太皇太后以道險迴鑾。

translations.literal: Day renchen: halting at Changcheng Ridge, the Grand Empress Dowager turned back because the road was perilous.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, at Changcheng Ridge, the grand empress dowager turned back because the road was too dangerous.

sentences.zh: 上如五台山。

translations.literal: The emperor proceeded to Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor continued on to Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 限額魯特入貢人數。

translations.literal: A quota was set on the number of Torghut tribute bearers.
translations.idiomatic: A cap was placed on how many Torghut tribute envoys might come.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，上至五郎河行宮，奉太皇太后還京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: the Emperor reached the Wulanghe traveling palace and escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Emperor arrived at the Wulanghe traveling palace and brought the Grand Empress Dowager back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，群臣以台灣平，請上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the ministers, because Taiwan had been pacified, requested that an honorific title be conferred on the Emperor; he did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the officials, citing the pacification of Taiwan, asked that an exalted title be bestowed on the Emperor; he refused.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以薩布素為新設黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On guihai, Sabusu was appointed to the newly established post of General of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Sabusu was made general of the newly created Heilongjiang command.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔沿海遷民歸復田裡。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict ordered coastal evacuees to return and restore their fields and homes.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an edict told coastal residents displaced by relocation policy to go home and resume their farms and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，授羅剎降人宜番等官。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guiwei: Yifan and other surrendered Russians were granted offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, Yifan and other Russians who had submitted were given official posts.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上以海寇平，祭告孝陵。

translations.literal: On wuzi, because the sea rebels had been pacified, the Emperor offered sacrifices and announced the news at Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, with the pirates at sea subdued, the Emperor reported the victory in sacrifice at the Xiaoling mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上巡幸邊界。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Emperor toured the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Emperor inspected the border regions.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，上還京。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiachen: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen, the Emperor came back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，從逆土司陸道清伏誅。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the rebellious native official Ludaoqing was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Ludaoqing, a native chieftain who had joined the rebels, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以紀爾他布為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On renzi, Jiertabu was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Jiertabu was appointed commander of the Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，易經日講成，上制序頒行。

translations.literal: On yimao, the daily lectures on the Book of Changes were completed; the Emperor composed a preface and ordered their publication.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the serialized lectures on the Changes were finished; the Emperor wrote a preface and had the text promulgated.

sentences.zh: 尚書朱之弼、左都御史徐元文以薦舉非人免。

translations.literal: Minister Zhu Zhibi and Censor-in-Chief Xu Yuanwen were dismissed for recommending unworthy men.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Zhibi, minister of a department, and Xu Yuanwen, left censor-in-chief, were removed for having recommended unsuitable candidates.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On yichou, the joint autumnal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the collective seasonal rites were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免山東、山西、甘肅、江西、湖廣、廣西等省二十州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, land tax was remitted in varying degrees for twenty disaster-stricken prefectures and counties in Shandong, Shanxi, Gansu, Jiangxi, Huguang, Guangxi, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax grain was reduced or waived, according to local need, in twenty disaster-hit districts across Shandong, Shanxi, Gansu, Jiangxi, Huguang, Guangxi, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute missions arrived from Korea and Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 二十三年甲子春正月辛巳，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, jiazi, first month of spring, xinsi: the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, jiazi, on xinsi in the first month of spring, the Emperor proceeded to the Southern Park for the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，加封安親王岳樂子袁端為勤郡王。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Yuan Duan, son of Prince An Yuele, was further ennobled as Prince of Qin Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Yuan Duan, son of Prince An of the First Rank Yuele, was raised to Prince of Qin Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命整肅朝會禮儀。

translations.literal: On renchen, he ordered court assembly ritual to be rectified.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he commanded that ceremonial order at court audiences be tightened.

sentences.zh: 羅剎踞雅克薩、尼布潮二城，飭斷其貿易，薩布素以兵臨之。

translations.literal: The Russians held the two cities of Albazin and Nibchu; trade with them was ordered cut off, and Sabusu advanced with troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: Russians occupied Albazin and Nibchu; the court forbade their trade and sent Sabusu to press them with an army.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, yisi: the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, the Emperor presided at the lecture on the classics.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he made a tour of the metropolitan districts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，還駐南苑。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he returned and encamped at the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he came back and lodged at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 大學士黃機罷。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Huang Ji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Huang Ji left office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，給事中王承祖疏請東巡，命查典禮以聞。

translations.literal: On yichou, Supervising Secretary Wang Chengzu memorialized requesting an eastern tour; he was ordered to investigate ritual precedents and report.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the supervising secretary Wang Chengzu asked permission for an eastern progress; the Emperor told the ministries to consult precedent and reply.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，以劉國軒為天津總兵官，陛辭，賜白金二百、緞匹三十、內廄鞍馬一。

translations.literal: Third month, renshen: Liu Guoxuan was appointed Grand Coordinator of Tianjin; at his farewell audience he was granted two hundred taels of silver, thirty bolts of silk, and one saddle horse from the imperial stables.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renshen, Liu Guoxuan was named commander at Tianjin; when he took leave of the throne he received two hundred taels of silver, thirty lengths of silk, and a horse from the inner stud.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上制五台山碑文，召示廷臣。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Emperor composed a stele inscription for Mount Wutai and summoned the ministers to view it.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he finished the text for a Wutai Shan stele and had it read before the court.

sentences.zh: 諭之曰：「近人每一文出，不樂人點竄，此文之所以不工也。

translations.literal: He instructed them, saying: "Whenever people today finish a piece of writing, they dislike others revising it—that is why the writing turns out crude."
translations.idiomatic: He told them, "Nowadays as soon as someone finishes a draft he hates to have it corrected—and that is exactly why his prose stays rough."

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，設台灣府縣官，隸福建行省。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiyou: prefectural and county officials for Taiwan were established, subordinate to the Fujian provincial administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, civil posts for Taiwan were created under Fujian province.

sentences.zh: 壬子，刑部左侍郎宋文運乞休，命加太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: On renzi, Song Wenyun, vice minister of justice, requested retirement and was ordered to retire with the rank of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Song Wenyun, vice minister of justice, asked to resign and was allowed to retire with the honorary title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 庚申，諭凡一事經關兩部，俱會同具奏。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict stated that whenever one matter involved two ministries, both were to memorialize jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the throne ruled that any business touching two boards must be submitted in concert by both.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，諭講官：「講章以精切明晰為尚，毋取繁衍。

translations.literal: On yichou, he instructed the lecturers: "Lecture chapters should aim at precision and clarity; do not make them prolix."
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he admonished the lecturers: "Your expositions should be exact and plain—avoid swollen rhetoric."

sentences.zh: 朕閱張居正尚書、四書直解，義俱精實，無泛設之詞，可為法也。

translations.literal: When I read Zhang Juzheng's Straight Explanation of the Four Books, the meanings are all solid and there are no empty phrases—it may serve as a model.
translations.idiomatic: I have been reading Zhang Juzheng's Straight Explanation of the Four Books; every gloss is substantive, without padding. Take that as your standard.

sentences.zh: 」江南江西總督于成龍卒，予祭葬，諡清端。

translations.literal: 」Governor-General of Jiangnan and Jiangxi Yu Chenglong died; he was granted sacrificial rites and burial, posthumous name Qingduan.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chenglong, governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi, died; he received state funeral honors and the posthumous title Qingduan.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，裁浙江總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingmao: the post of Governor-General of Zhejiang was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingmao, the Zhejiang governor-generalship was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 以公瓦山為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Gongwashan was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Gongwashan was appointed commander of the Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 己巳，修《大清會典》。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Draft Institutions of the Great Qing were ordered revised.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi work was ordered on revising the Collected Statutes of the Great Qing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以孫思克為甘肅提督。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Sun Sike was made provincial military commissioner of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Sun Sike was named provincial commander in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命廷臣察舉清廉官。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the court ministers were ordered to recommend upright and incorrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the throne directed the high officials to nominate men known for clean government.

sentences.zh: 九卿舉格爾古德、蘇赫、范承勛、趙侖、崔華、張鵬翮、陸隴其。

translations.literal: The Nine Ministers recommended Gegerude, Suhe, Fan Chengxun, Zhao Lun, Cui Hua, Zhang Pengxi, and Lu Longqi.
translations.idiomatic: The heads of the nine ministries put forward Gegerude, Suhe, Fan Chengxun, Zhao Lun, Cui Hua, Zhang Pengxi, and Lu Longqi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，起巴海為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Bahai was recalled as Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Bahai was reappointed commander of the Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上幸古北口，詔蹕路所經勿踐田禾。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Emperor went to Gubeikou and decreed that crops along the imperial route must not be trampled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he traveled to Gubeikou and ordered that standing grain along the procession route be left untouched.

sentences.zh: 乙未，惠郡王博翁果諾坐陪祀不謹削爵。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Prince of Hui Boenggonuo was stripped of his rank for careless attendance at a collateral temple sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Prince Hui Boenggonuo lost his title for lax conduct while assisting at a joint ancestral offering.

sentences.zh: 王大臣議奏侍郎宜昌阿、巡撫金僑查看尚之信家產，隱蝕銀八十九萬，並害殺商人沈上達，應斬。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers memorialized that Vice Minister Yichang'a and Governor Jin Qiao, in examining the property of Shang Zhixin, had concealed and embezzled eight hundred and ninety thousand taels of silver and had also murdered the merchant Shen Shangda; they should be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and ministers reported that Vice Minister Yichang'a and Governor Jin Qiao, while auditing Shang Zhixin's estate, had hidden nearly eight hundred and ninety thousand taels and had killed the merchant Shen Shangda; both deserved decapitation.

sentences.zh: 郎中宋俄託、員外郎卓爾圖及審讞不實之侍郎禪塔海應絞。

translations.literal: Director Song'etuo, Section Chief Zhuo'ertu, and Vice Minister Chantahai, who had judged the case untruthfully, should be strangled.
translations.idiomatic: Director Song'etuo, section chief Zhuo'ertu, and Vice Minister Chantahai, who had mishandled the investigation, were recommended for strangulation.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 詔追銀勿入內務府，交戶部充饟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the recovered silver not enter the Imperial Household Department but be handed to the Board of Revenue for army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that the recovered silver go not to the inner palace treasury but to the Board of Revenue for military rations.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，琉球請遣子弟入國子監讀書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingwei: Ryukyu requested that princes and sons be sent to study in the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingwei, Ryukyu asked to send royal youths to the National University.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was allowed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，暹羅國王森列拍臘照古龍拍臘馬呼陸坤司由提呀菩挨遣陪臣言貢船到虎跳門，阻滯日久，每致損壞。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the King of Siam Senliepailaozhaogulongpailamahulukensiyoutiyapuai sent envoys stating that when tribute ships reached Hujiaomen they were long detained, which often caused damage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the king of Siam, Senliepailaozhaogulongpailamahulukensiyoutiyapuai, sent envoys reporting that tribute vessels reaching Hujiaomen were held up so long that cargo frequently spoiled.

sentences.zh: 乞諭粵省官吏准其放入河下，早得登岸，貿易採辦，勿被攔阻。

translations.literal: They begged that Guangdong officials be instructed to let them enter the river mouth, go ashore promptly, trade and procure goods, and not be obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that Guangdong authorities let them into the estuary, land quickly, trade and buy supplies, and not be blocked.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 諭一等侍衛阿南達曰：「朕視外旗蒙古與八旗一體。

translations.literal: He instructed First-Rank Bodyguard Ananda: "I regard the Outer Banner Mongols the same as the Eight Banners."
translations.idiomatic: He told First-Rank Bodyguard Ananda, "I treat the Outer Banner Mongols no differently from our own Eight Banners."

sentences.zh: 今巡行之次，見其衣食困苦，深用惻然。

translations.literal: On this tour I have seen their clothing and food hardship and am deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: On this journey I have seen how thinly they are clothed and fed, and it weighs on me.

sentences.zh: 爾即傳諭所過地方蒙古無告者，許其來見，詢其生計。

translations.literal: You are at once to announce that destitute Mongols along the route may come before me so I may inquire into their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Tell every place we pass that needy Mongols may come to me and state their circumstances.

sentences.zh: 」於是蒙古扶老扌巂幼，叩首行宮門。

translations.literal: 」Thereupon Mongols, supporting the old and leading the young, kowtowed at the gate of the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols then came in crowds, old and young together, and prostrated themselves outside the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 上詳問年齒生計，給與銀兩布疋。

translations.literal: The Emperor questioned them in detail about age and livelihood and gave silver and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor asked each group about age and means and distributed silver and cloth.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上閱牧群，賜從臣馬。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Emperor reviewed the herds and bestowed horses on his attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he inspected the pasture herds and gave horses to the officials in his train.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書魏象樞再疏乞休。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Wei Xiangqi again memorialized requesting retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xiangqi, minister of justice, once more asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was permitted to leave office.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以湯斌為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Tang Bin was made Governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Tang Bin was appointed governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 七月乙亥，以宋德宜為大學士。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yihai: Song Deyi was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yihai, Song Deyi entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上駐蹕英尼湯泉。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Emperor halted at the Yingni hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the imperial progress paused at the Yingni hot springs.

sentences.zh: 以佟佳為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Tong Jia was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Jia was named commander of the Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，上還京。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wushen: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wushen, the Emperor came back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大學士李霨卒，遣官奠茶酒，賜祭葬，諡文勤。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Grand Secretary Li Mo died; officials were sent to offer libations of tea and wine, and sacrificial rites and burial were granted, posthumous name Wenqin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Grand Secretary Li Mo died; the court sent officers to pour libations and granted him state funeral honors with the posthumous title Wenqin.

sentences.zh: 甘肅提督靖逆侯張勇卒，予祭葬，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong, provincial military commissioner of Gansu and Marquis Who Pacifies Rebellion, died; he was granted sacrificial rites and burial, posthumous name Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong, Gansu commander and Marquis Who Pacifies Rebellion, also died; he received funeral rites and the posthumous title Xiangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子朔，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiazi, new year's day: autumn executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new-year day of the ninth month the autumn judicial executions were stayed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以張士甄為刑部尚書，博濟為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Zhang Shizhen was made Minister of Justice and Boji Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhang Shizhen became minister of justice and Boji commander of the Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 以錢貴，更鑄錢，減四分之一。

translations.literal: Because money was costly, coin was recast, reduced by one quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Because copper cash was dear, new coins were cast at three quarters of the former weight.

sentences.zh: 聽民采銅鉛，勿稅。

translations.literal: The people were permitted to mine copper and lead without tax.
translations.idiomatic: Private mining of copper and lead was allowed, free of levy.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，改梁清標為兵部尚書，余國柱為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Liang Qingbiao was transferred to Minister of War and Yu Guozhu to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Liang Qingbiao moved to the Ministry of War and Yu Guozhu to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以蒙古都統阿拉尼兼理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Mongol commander Alani was also placed in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Mongol commander Alani was given concurrent charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以陳廷敬為左都御史，莽奕祿為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Chen Tingjing was made Censor-in-Chief and Mangilu Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Chen Tingjing became censor-in-chief and Mangilu commander of the Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔南巡車駕所過，賜復一年。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict granted one year's tax remission wherever the southern tour passed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the throne promised a year's tax relief along the route of the southern progress.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上啟鑾。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the imperial procession set out.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Emperor began his journey south.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，上次泰安，登泰山，祀東嶽。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renyin: the Emperor reached Tai'an, ascended Mount Tai, and sacrificed to the Eastern Peak.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renyin, he came to Tai'an, climbed Mount Tai, and offered to the god of the eastern peak.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，次桃源，閱河工，慰勞役夫，戒河吏勿侵漁。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he stopped at Taoyuan, inspected river works, comforted the laborers, and warned river officials not to embezzle.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he halted at Taoyuan, reviewed the Yellow River projects, encouraged the workers, and cautioned officials against graft.

sentences.zh: 臨視天妃閘。

translations.literal: He personally inspected the Tianfei sluice.
translations.idiomatic: He went in person to the Tianfei floodgate.

sentences.zh: 與河臣靳輔論治河方略。

translations.literal: With river official Jin Fu he discussed strategy for controlling the river.
translations.idiomatic: He conferred with the river commissioner Jin Fu on flood-control policy.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上渡淮。

translations.literal: On renzi, the Emperor crossed the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he crossed the Huai River.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，次高郵湖，登岸行十餘里，詢耆老疾苦。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he stopped at Gaoyou Lake, went ashore for more than ten li, and inquired into the hardships of the elderly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he paused at Gaoyou Lake, walked more than ten li inland, and asked old villagers about their troubles.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上幸焦山、金山，渡揚子江，舟中顧侍臣曰：「此皆戰艦也。

translations.literal: On bingchen, he visited Jiaoshan and Jinshan, crossed the Yangzi, and in the boat turned to his attendants, saying: "These are all warships."
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he toured Jiaoshan and Jinshan and crossed the Yangzi; aboard ship he said to his ministers, "Every one of these vessels was built for war."

sentences.zh: 今以供巡幸，然艱難不可忘也。

translations.literal: Now they serve the tour, yet hardship must not be forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: Today they carry us on a pleasure cruise—but we must never forget how hard won our peace was.

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，弛海禁。

translations.literal: 」On dingsi, maritime prohibitions were relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the ban on sea trade was lifted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上駐蘇州。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Emperor lodged at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he took up residence at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸惠山。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he visited Huishan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he went to Huishan.

sentences.zh: 諭巡撫：百姓遠道來觀，其不能歸者資遣之。

translations.literal: He instructed the governor: those among the people who had come from afar to see him and could not return home were to be given travel funds.
translations.idiomatic: He told the governor to pay the expenses of commoners who had traveled far to glimpse the procession and could not afford the journey home.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌朔，上駐江寧。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renxu, new year's day: the Emperor lodged at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu new-year day of the eleventh month he was at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詣明陵致奠。

translations.literal: On guihai, he went to the Ming imperial tombs and offered libations.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he visited the Ming mausoleums and performed rites.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，迴鑾。

translations.literal: On yichou, the procession turned back.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the tour reversed course.

sentences.zh: 泊舟燕子磯，讀書至三鼓。

translations.literal: Moored at Yanziji, he read until the third watch.
translations.idiomatic: Anchored off Yanziji, he read books until the third watch of the night.

sentences.zh: 侍臣高士奇請曰：「聖躬過勞，宜少節養。

translations.literal: Attendant Gao Shiqi requested, saying: "Your sacred person is overtaxed; you should spare yourself a little."
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shiqi, in attendance, urged him: "Your Majesty labors excessively—you ought to rest somewhat."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「朕自五齡受書，誦讀恆至夜分，樂此不為疲也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "From the age of five I received instruction; I have always read until midnight and take joy in it without weariness."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied, "I began my studies at five and have habitually read far into the night; I delight in it and do not feel fatigue."

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，命伊桑阿、薩穆哈視察海口。

translations.literal: 」On dingmao, Yisang'a and Samuha were ordered to inspect the estuary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he sent Yisang'a and Samuha to survey the river mouth.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「海口沙淤年久，遂至壅塞。

translations.literal: He instructed them: "The estuary has silted up over many years until it is choked."
translations.idiomatic: He told them, "The mouth has been silting for years until the channel is blocked."

sentences.zh: 必將水道疏通，始免昏墊。

translations.literal: The watercourse must be cleared so that flooding may be avoided."
translations.idiomatic: "Only by dredging the waterway can we keep the land from drowning."

sentences.zh: 即多用經費，亦所不惜。

translations.literal: Even if great expense is required, it will not be regretted."
translations.idiomatic: "Spend whatever is needed—I will not count the cost."

sentences.zh: 」辛未，臨閱高家堰。

translations.literal: 」On xinwei, he personally inspected the Gaojia embankment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he went in person to review the Gaojiayan floodworks.

sentences.zh: 次宿遷。

translations.literal: Next he lodged at Suqian.
translations.idiomatic: He next stopped at Suqian.

sentences.zh: 過白洋河，賜老人白金。

translations.literal: Passing Baiyang River, he bestowed white silver on the elderly.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Baiyang River, he gave silver to the aged.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上次曲阜。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Emperor proceeded to Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day the Emperor arrived at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上詣先師廟，入大成門，行九叩禮。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Emperor went to the Temple of the Former Master, entered the Dacheng Gate, and performed the nine prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the Emperor went to the Temple of the Former Master, entered the Dacheng Gate, and performed nine kowtows.

sentences.zh: 至詩禮堂，講易經。

translations.literal: At the Hall of Poetry and Rites he lectured on the Book of Changes.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of Poetry and Rites he lectured on the Book of Changes.

sentences.zh: 上大成殿，瞻先聖像，觀禮器。

translations.literal: He ascended the Dacheng Hall, viewed the image of the Former Sage, and inspected the ritual vessels.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended the Dacheng Hall, viewed Confucius's image, and inspected the ritual vessels.

sentences.zh: 至聖跡殿，覽圖書。

translations.literal: At the Hall of the Sage's Traces he perused the books and pictures.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of the Sage's Traces he examined the books and illustrations.

sentences.zh: 至杏壇，觀植檜。

translations.literal: At the Apricot Altar he viewed the planted cypress.
translations.idiomatic: At the Apricot Altar he viewed the planted cypress.

sentences.zh: 入承聖門，汲孔井水嘗之。

translations.literal: Entering the Chengsheng Gate, he drew Kong Well water and tasted it.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the Chengsheng Gate, he drew water from Confucius's well and tasted it.

sentences.zh: 顧問魯壁遺迹，博士孔毓圻占對甚詳，賜官助教。

translations.literal: Inquiring about the relic of the Lu Wall, Erudite Kong Yuqi answered in great detail; he was granted the office of Assistant Instructor.
translations.idiomatic: Asking about the Lu Wall relic, Erudite Kong Yuqi answered at length and was granted the post of assistant instructor.

sentences.zh: 詣孔林墓前酹酒。

translations.literal: He went to the Kong Forest and poured libation wine before the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: He went to the Kong Forest and poured a libation before Confucius's tomb.

sentences.zh: 書「萬世師表」額。

translations.literal: He wrote the plaque "Teacher for Ten Thousand Generations."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote the plaque "Teacher for Ten Thousand Generations."

sentences.zh: 留曲柄黃蓋。

translations.literal: He left a yellow canopy with curved handle.
translations.idiomatic: He left an imperial yellow canopy with a curved handle.

sentences.zh: 賜衍聖公孔毓埏以次日講諸經各一。

translations.literal: He granted the Yansheng Duke Kong Yushan to lecture on each of the Classics on successive days.
translations.idiomatic: He granted Duke Yansheng Kong Yushan to lecture on one Classic on each of the following days.

sentences.zh: 免曲阜明年租賦。

translations.literal: He remitted Qufu's taxes and levies for the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted Qufu's taxes and levies for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上還京。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 以馬哈達為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Mahada was made Manchu Commandant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Mahada was appointed Manchu commandant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰朔，以石文炳為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen new moon: Shi Wenbing was made Han Banner Commandant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the twelfth month, Shi Wenbing was appointed Han Banner commandant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命公瓦山視師黑龍江，佟寶、佛可托副之，備羅剎。

translations.literal: On guimao, Duke Washan was ordered to take command on the Heilongjiang front; Tong Bao and Fuketuo were made his deputies, to guard against the Russians.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Duke Washan was ordered to take command on the Heilongjiang front, with Tong Bao and Fuketuo as deputies, to guard against the Russians.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜公鄭克塽、伯劉國軒、馮錫范田宅，隸漢軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the court granted Duke Zheng Keshuang, Earl Liu Guoxuan, and Feng Xiyu fields and houses and enrolled them in the Han Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the court granted fields and houses to Duke Zheng Keshuang, Earl Liu Guoxuan, and Feng Xiyu and enrolled them in the Han Banners.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命流人值冬令，過嚴寒時乃遣。

translations.literal: On bingwu, it was ordered that exiles be sent off only when the severe cold season had passed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day it was ordered that exiles be sent off only after the worst of winter cold had passed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上謁陵，賜守陵官兵牛羊。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs and bestowed cattle and sheep on the tomb-guard garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the Emperor visited the imperial tombs and bestowed cattle and sheep on the tomb-guard garrison.

sentences.zh: 己未，還宮。

translations.literal: On jiwei, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、河南、湖廣等省二十六州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes and levies were remitted in varying degrees for twenty-six prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Henan, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes and levies were remitted in varying degrees for twenty-six prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Henan, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Siam sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二十四年乙丑春正月癸酉，享太廟。

translations.literal: Year twenty-four, yichou, spring, first month, day guiyou: sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, on the guiyou day of the first month of spring, the Emperor sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「贊禮郎讀祝，讀至朕名，聲輒不揚，失父前子名之義。

translations.literal: An edict said: "When the ritual officer reads the prayer, upon reading my name his voice is not raised—this loses the meaning of a son not speaking his father's name aloud.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "When the ritual officer reads the prayer, upon reaching my name his voice is not raised—this loses the meaning of a son not speaking his father's name aloud.

sentences.zh: 自今俱令宣讀。

translations.literal: From now on all are to read it aloud."
translations.idiomatic: From now on all are to read it aloud."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，命公彭春赴黑龍江督察軍務。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Duke Peng Chun was ordered to proceed to Heilongjiang to supervise military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Duke Peng Chun was ordered to proceed to Heilongjiang to supervise military affairs.

sentences.zh: 命侯林興珠率福建藤牌兵從之。

translations.literal: Marquis Lin Xingzhu was ordered to lead Fujian rattan-shield troops to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Lin Xingzhu was ordered to lead Fujian rattan-shield troops to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 以班達爾沙、佟寶、馬喇參軍事。

translations.literal: Bandarsa, Tong Bao, and Ma La were made deputies on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Bandarsa, Tong Bao, and Ma La were appointed deputies on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，試翰詹官於保和殿，上親定甲乙，其不稱者改官。

translations.literal: On yichou, Hanlin and Hanlin Bachelor officials were examined at the Hall of Preserving Harmony; the Emperor personally fixed their grades, and those found unfit were reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Hanlin and Hanlin Bachelor officials were examined at the Hall of Preserving Harmony; the Emperor personally fixed their grades, and those found unfit were reassigned.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命蒙古科爾沁十旗所貢牛羊送黑龍江軍前。

translations.literal: On wuzi, it was ordered that cattle and sheep presented by the ten banners of Khorchin Mongolia be sent to the Heilongjiang army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day it was ordered that cattle and sheep presented by the ten banners of Khorchin Mongolia be sent to the Heilongjiang army.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，命周公後裔東野氏為五經博士，予祀田。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi: a descendant of the Duke of Zhou of the Dongye clan was made Doctor of the Five Classics and granted sacrificial fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengzi day, a descendant of the Duke of Zhou of the Dongye clan was made Doctor of the Five Classics and granted sacrificial fields.

sentences.zh: 以額赫納為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Ehena was made Manchu Commandant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Ehena was appointed Manchu commandant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Emperor presided over the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the Emperor presided over the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 庚申，還京。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 再賜劉國軒第宅。

translations.literal: Liu Guoxuan was again granted a residence.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guoxuan was again granted a residence.

sentences.zh: 以范承勛為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Fan Chengxun was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chengxun was appointed governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，上撰孔子廟碑文成，親書立碑。

translations.literal: Third month, day renxu: the Emperor's text for the Confucius Temple stele was completed; he personally wrote it and set up the stele.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renxu day, the Emperor's text for the Confucius Temple stele was completed; he wrote it himself and had the stele erected.

sentences.zh: 重修賦役全書。

translations.literal: The Comprehensive Book of Tax and Corvée was revised.
translations.idiomatic: The Comprehensive Book of Tax and Corvée was revised.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜陸肯堂等一百二十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Lu Kentang and 120 others were granted jinshi and other degrees in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Lu Kentang and 120 others received jinshi and other degrees in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，予宋儒周敦頤裔孫五經博士。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinmao: a descendant of Song Confucian Zhou Dunyi was granted the office of Doctor of the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the xinmao day of the fourth month, a descendant of the Song Confucian Zhou Dunyi was granted the office of Doctor of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 丙申，授李之芳輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Li Zhifang was granted the hereditary office of Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Li Zhifang was granted the hereditary office of commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，馬喇以所俘羅剎上獻，命軍前縱遣之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Ma La presented captured Russians to the throne; the court ordered them released at the front.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Ma La presented captured Russians to the throne; the court ordered them released at the front.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔以直隸連年旱災，逋賦六十餘萬盡免之，並免今年正賦三分之一。

translations.literal: On xinchou, an edict said: "Because Zhili has suffered drought year after year, more than 600,000 taels of arrears are wholly remitted, and one-third of this year's regular levy is also remitted."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day an edict said: "Because Zhili has suffered drought year after year, more than 600,000 taels of arrears are wholly remitted, and one-third of this year's regular levy is also remitted."

sentences.zh: 詔醫官博採醫林載籍，勒成一書。

translations.literal: An edict ordered medical officers broadly to collect medical works and compile them into one book.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered medical officers to collect medical works broadly and compile them into one book.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，設內務府官學。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Inner Palace Office school was established.

translations.idiomatic: Jin Fu proposed opening six rivers and building a long dike.

translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict said that having suppressed rebellion and pacified the frontier, the court should proclaim virtue so that distant peoples were moved to fear and to cherish imperial grace.

translations.idiomatic: Recently the emperor had seen high officials in Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and Guangdong who failed to pacify their districts, often ruling harshly; greed and corruption bred incidents, and they invented pretexts to claim merit.

translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day the emperor attended the classics lecture.

translations.idiomatic: Jin Jin was appointed chief guard of the inner court.

translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Alantai was made left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，錫荷蘭國王耀漢連氏甘勃氏文綺白金，命其使臣賚書致鄂羅斯。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiyou: silk brocade and white silver were bestowed on the Dutch king; his envoy was ordered to carry a letter to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiyou day, brocade and white silver were granted the Dutch king and his envoy was told to deliver a letter to Russia.

sentences.zh: 吏部奏定侍讀、庶子以下各官學問不及者，以同知、運判外轉。

translations.literal: The Board of Civil Appointments memorialized fixing that Readers-in-waiting, Sub-expositors of the Heir Apparent, and officials below whose learning was insufficient should be transferred out as subprefects and transport commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Civil Appointments ruled that readers-in-waiting, sub-expositors, and other officials whose learning fell short should be transferred out as subprefects or transport commissioners.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day the emperor toured beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，上駐蹕烏爾格蘇台。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei: the emperor halted at Urgusutai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinwei day, the emperor halted at Urgusutai.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上還京。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 以索額圖為領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Songgotu was made Chief Guard of the Inner Court.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu was made chief guard of the inner court.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔薩布素圍雅克薩城，遏其援師，以博定參軍事。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict ordered Sabsu to besiege Albazin and block its relief forces; Boding was to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Sabsu was ordered to besiege Albazin and cut off relief; Boding was assigned to the campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔天下學宮崇祀先儒。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict ordered schools throughout the realm to honor former Confucian sages in worship.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict ordered district schools empire-wide to honor the former sages.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔增孔林地十一頃有奇，從衍聖公孔毓埏請也，除其賦。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: an edict increased Confucius's forest estate by more than eleven qing, at the request of the Duke Who Continues the Sage Kong Yuyan; its tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, at Kong Yuyan's request, more than eleven qing were added to the Confucian forest and the levy was remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，以班達爾沙為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jichou: Bandarsha was made Mongol commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jichou day, Bandarsha was made Mongol commandant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以圖納為四川陝西總督。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Tuna was made governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Tuna was made governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以陳廷敬為工部尚書，馬齊為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Chen Tingjing was made Minister of Works; Ma Qi was made governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Chen Tingjing became Minister of Works and Ma Qi governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鄂羅斯察漢汗使來請解雅克薩之圍。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an envoy of the Russian tsar came to ask that the siege of Albazin be lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day a Russian envoy asked that the siege of Albazin be raised.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 是月，內大臣拉篤祜奉詔與羅卜藏濟農及噶爾丹定地而還。

translations.literal: That month, Inner Court Minister Laduhu, by imperial order, fixed boundaries with Lobzang Jinong and Galdan and returned.
translations.idiomatic: That month Inner Court Minister Laduhu, by edict, delimited territory with Lobzang Jinong and Galdan and returned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，調張士甄為禮部尚書，以胡升猷為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: Zhang Shizhen was transferred to Minister of Rites; Hu Shengyou was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingchen day, Zhang Shizhen became Minister of Rites and Hu Shengyou Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，上謁孝陵。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengzi: the emperor visited the Xiaoling Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengzi day, the emperor visited the Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 賞蒙古喀喇沁兵征浙江、福建有功者。

translations.literal: Kharchin Mongol troops who had merit campaigning in Zhejiang and Fujian were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Kharchin Mongols who had served meritoriously in Zhejiang and Fujian were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，上還宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: the emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guichou day, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命侍郎薩海督察鳳凰城屯田。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Vice-minister Sa Hai was ordered to supervise military colonization at Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Vice-minister Sa Hai was ordered to supervise garrison farming at Fengcheng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，諭：「糾儀御史糾察必以嚴，設朕躬不敬，亦當舉奏。

translations.literal: Day guihai, an instruction said: "Censors who regulate ceremony must be strict in correction; if even my person is disrespectful, they should also memorialize and impeach.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day he instructed: "Ceremonial censors must be strict; if the emperor himself is remiss, they should memorialize it.

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: " Day wuyin: joint autumn sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day the joint autumn sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、浙江、湖廣、甘肅等省二十七州縣被災額賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, land-tax quotas were remitted in varying degrees for twenty-seven prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Huguang, Gansu, and other provinces that had suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That year land-tax quotas were partially remitted for twenty-seven disaster-stricken prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Huguang, Gansu, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南、荷蘭、吐魯番入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Annam, Holland, and Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Annam, Holland, and Turfan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十六年丁卯春正月戊子，遣醫官往治雅克薩軍士疾，羅剎原就醫者並醫之。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, dingmao, spring, first month, day wuzi: medical officers were sent to treat illness among troops at Albazin; Russians who wished treatment were also treated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, first month of spring, on the wuzi day, physicians were sent to treat troops at Albazin; Russians who sought care were treated as well.

sentences.zh: 丙申，蒙古土謝圖汗、車臣汗及濟農合疏請上尊號。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the Tüsiyetü Khan, the Chünwang Khan, and the jinong of Mongolia jointly memorialized asking to bestow an honorific title on the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the Tüsiyetü Khan, Chünwang Khan, and Mongol jinong jointly asked to honor the emperor with a title.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: It was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，大學士吳正治乞休。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Grand Secretary Wu Zhengzhi asked to retire.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Grand Secretary Wu Zhengzhi asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: His request was granted.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，上大閱於盧溝橋。

translations.literal: Second month, day guichou: the emperor held a great review at the Lugou Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guichou day, the emperor held a great review at the Lugou Bridge.

sentences.zh: 原任湖廣總督蔡毓榮隱藏吳三桂孫女為妾，匿取逆財，減死鞭一百，枷號三月，籍沒，並其子發黑龍江。

translations.literal: Former Huguang governor-general Cai Yurong had hidden Wu Sangui's granddaughter as a concubine and concealed rebel property; his death sentence was reduced to one hundred lashes of the whip, three months in the cangue, confiscation of property, and his sons were sent to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Former Huguang governor Cai Yurong had kept Wu Sangui's granddaughter as a concubine and hidden rebel goods; he was spared death for one hundred lashes, three months in the cangue, confiscation, and banishment of his sons to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 原讞尚書禧佛等坐隱庇，黜革有差。

translations.literal: Formerly the investigating ministers, including Minister Xifo, were punished with dismissal or reduction in rank for concealing the matter, in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating ministers including Minister Xifo were dismissed or demoted for concealing the case.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以余國柱為大學士。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Yu Guozhu was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Yu Guozhu was made grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命八旗都統、副都統更番入值紫禁城。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the commandants-in-chief and vice commandants-in-chief of the Eight Banners were ordered to rotate in attendance within the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Eight Banner commandants and vice commandants were ordered to take turns on duty inside the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以張玉書為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Zhang Yushu was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Zhang Yushu was made Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 壬申，戶部奏滸墅關監督桑額溢徵銀二萬一千餘兩。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the Board of Revenue memorialized that Sange, supervisor of the Huxu Pass, had collected more than twenty-one thousand taels of silver beyond the quota.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day the Board of Revenue reported that Huxu Pass supervisor Sange had levied over twenty-one thousand taels beyond quota.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「設立榷關，原為稽察姦宄。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript said: "Toll stations were established originally to inspect for malfeasance.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript said: "Toll stations were meant to check smuggling and fraud.

sentences.zh: 桑額多收額銀，乃私封便民橋，以致擾害商民。

translations.literal: Sange collected extra quota silver and privately sealed off the Convenience Bridge, thereby harassing merchants and the people.
translations.idiomatic: Sange had taken extra silver and closed the Convenience Bridge, harassing merchants and civilians.

sentences.zh: 著嚴加議處。

translations.literal: He is to be severely punished after deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: He was to be severely punished after deliberation.

sentences.zh: 嗣後司榷官有額外橫徵者，該部其嚴飭之。

translations.literal: Hereafter, if revenue officials levy extra tolls, that ministry is to discipline them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter any toll official who levied beyond quota was to be strictly disciplined by the board.

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
