translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，以董訥為江南江西總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: Dong Ne was made governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jichou day, Dong Ne was made governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以王鴻緒為左都御史。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Wang Hongxu was made Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Wang Hongxu was made left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上御太和門視朝，諭大學士等詳議政務闕失，僉以無弊可陳對。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the emperor held court at the Gate of Supreme Harmony and instructed the grand secretaries and others to deliberate in detail on omissions and failures in government; all replied that there were no abuses to report.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, at the Gate of Supreme Harmony, the emperor told the grand secretaries to examine governmental failings; all said there were none.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「堯、舜之世，府修事和，然且兢兢業業，不敢謂已治已安。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "In the age of Yao and Shun, all offices were in harmony, yet they were still cautious and fearful and did not dare call the realm already governed and already at peace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Even Yao and Shun's age, though harmonious, was met with caution—they never called the realm fully settled.

sentences.zh: 漢文帝亦古之賢主，賈誼猶指陳得失，直言切諫。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Han was also an ancient worthy ruler, yet Jia Yi still pointed out gains and losses and remonstrated bluntly.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Han was a sage ruler, yet Jia Yi still laid out faults frankly.

sentences.zh: 今但云主聖臣賢，政治無闕，豈國家果無一事可言耶？

translations.literal: Now you only say the ruler is sage and ministers worthy and that government has no flaw—can it be that the state truly has nothing to speak of?
translations.idiomatic: Now you say only that the ruler is sage and government flawless—as if nothing in the realm needed saying.

sentences.zh: 大小臣工，各宜盡心職業，視國事如家事，有所見聞，入陳無隱。

translations.literal: Great and small officials should each devote themselves to duty, treat state affairs as family affairs, and whatever they see or hear, enter memorial without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Every official should treat state affairs as his own household and memorialize without hiding what he sees or hears.

sentences.zh: 」以馬世濟為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: " Ma Shiji was made governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shiji was made governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，上諭大學士曰：「纂修明史諸臣，曾參看前明實錄否？

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiwei: the emperor instructed the grand secretaries: "Have the compilers of the Ming History consulted the former Ming Veritable Records?
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiwei day, he asked the grand secretaries whether compilers of the Ming History had consulted the Ming Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 若不參看實錄，虛實何由悉知。

translations.literal: If they do not consult the Veritable Records, how can they know what is true and what false?
translations.idiomatic: Without those records, he said, how could truth and falsehood be known?

sentences.zh: 明史成日，應將實錄並存，令後世有所考證。

translations.literal: When the Ming History is completed, the Veritable Records should be kept together so that later ages may have material for verification.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ming History was finished, the Veritable Records should be preserved together for later verification.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，以田雯為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: " Day bingyin: Tian Wen was made governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Tian Wen was made governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷科道侍班。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: attendance in court by censors and supervising secretaries was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day censors and supervising secretaries were removed from court attendance duty.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，宗人府奏平郡王納爾都打死無罪屬人，折傷手足，請革爵圈禁。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jihai: the Court of the Imperial Clan memorialized that Prince of Ping Commandery Naludu had beaten to death a guiltless dependent, breaking hands and feet, and asked that his title be revoked and he be confined in the circle.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the fifth month the Court of the Imperial Clan reported that Prince of Ping Commandery Naludu had killed a blameless dependent and maimed others, and asked that his title be revoked and he confined.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「革爵，免圈禁。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript said: "Revoke the title; exempt from confinement in the circle.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript said: "Revoke his title but spare confinement.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，詔曰：「今茲仲夏，久旱多風，陰陽不調，災孰大焉。

translations.literal: " Day gengchen, an edict said: "Now at midsummer, long drought and much wind—yin and yang are not in harmony; what disaster could be greater?
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day an edict said that at midsummer drought and wind showed heaven and earth out of harmony—what disaster could be greater?

sentences.zh: 用是減膳撤樂，齋居默禱。

translations.literal: Therefore I have reduced meals and withdrawn music, dwelt in fasting quarters, and prayed in silence.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had reduced meals, withdrawn music, and prayed in seclusion.

sentences.zh: 雖降甘霖，尚未霑足。

translations.literal: Though sweet rain has fallen, it is not yet sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Rain had fallen but was not yet enough.

sentences.zh: 皆朕之涼德，不能上格天心。

translations.literal: All this is my meager virtue, unable to reach the mind of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: This reflects my own deficient virtue, unable to move Heaven.

sentences.zh: 政令有不便於民者更之。

translations.literal: Government orders that are inconvenient for the people are to be changed.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts inconvenient to the people were to be revised.

sentences.zh: 罪非常赦不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Crimes not normally pardoned by general amnesty are all pardoned and removed.
translations.idiomatic: Crimes not usually covered by amnesty were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，上召陳廷敬、湯斌十二人各試以文。

translations.literal: " Day wuzi: the emperor summoned Chen Tingjing, Tang Bin, and twelve others to each be tested in composition.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Chen Tingjing, Tang Bin, and twelve others were tested in literary composition.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「朕閒與熊賜履講論經史，有疑必問。

translations.literal: An instruction said: "In my leisure I discuss the classics and histories with Xiong Cilü; when I have doubts I always ask.
translations.idiomatic: He said: "In leisure I discussed the classics with Xiong Cilü and questioned him whenever I doubted.

sentences.zh: 繼而張英、陳廷敬以次進講，大有裨益。

translations.literal: Afterward Zhang Ying, Chen Tingjing, and others lectured in turn, with great benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhang Ying, Chen Tingjing, and others lectured in succession to great benefit.

sentences.zh: 德格勒每好評論時人學問，朕心以為不然，故茲召試，茲判然矣。

translations.literal: Degere often liked to criticize people's learning; in my heart I thought that wrong; therefore I now summon this test—and the difference is clear.
translations.idiomatic: Degere often judged others' learning harshly; the emperor had disapproved, and this test made the difference plain.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，上制周公、孔子、孟子廟碑文，御書勒石。

translations.literal: " Day renchen: the emperor composed inscriptions for the temples of the Duke of Zhou, Confucius, and Mencius, and personally wrote them on stone.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day he composed temple inscriptions for the Duke of Zhou, Confucius, and Mencius and had them carved in his own hand.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，上素服步行，祈雨於天壇。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingyou: in plain dress the emperor walked on foot to pray for rain at the Temple of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the sixth month the emperor walked in plain dress to pray for rain at the Temple of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 是夜，雨。

translations.literal: That night, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: That night it rained.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，改祀北海於混同江。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: worship of the Northern Sea was moved to the Hun Tong River.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day worship of the Northern Sea was transferred to the Hun Tong River.

sentences.zh: 以楊素蘊為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Yang Suyun was made governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Suyun was made governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，鄂羅斯遣使議和，命薩布素退兵。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuzi: Russia sent envoys to discuss peace; Sabsu was ordered to withdraw his troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuzi day, Russia sent envoys to negotiate peace and Sabsu was ordered to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 丙午，戶部請裁京員公費。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the Board of Revenue requested to cut metropolitan officials' public allowances.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Board of Revenue asked to reduce the public allowances of capital officials.

sentences.zh: 得旨勿裁。

translations.literal: An edict said: Do not cut them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that they not be cut.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiyou day, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou day, the emperor toured beyond the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，次博洛和屯行圍。

translations.literal: On guichou day he halted at Boluohetun to conduct the hunt encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day he stopped at Boluohetun for the hunting encampment.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賜外籓銀幣。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day he bestowed silver and coins on the outer vassals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day he granted silver and coin to the outer vassals.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，上還京。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jimao day, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao day, the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，于成龍進嘉禾。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Yu Chenglong presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Yu Chenglong presented stalks of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「今夏乾旱，幸而得雨，未足為瑞也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This summer there was drought; fortunately rain came, but it is not enough to count as an auspicious omen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "This summer brought drought; though we have been fortunate to receive rain, that alone is not enough to count as a true auspicious sign.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，以李之芳為大學士。

translations.literal: " On renwu day Li Zhifang was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: " On renwu day Li Zhifang was appointed Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 乙未，調湯斌為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Tang Bin was transferred to be Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Tang Bin was transferred to the post of Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 起徐元文為左都御史。

translations.literal: Xu Yuanwen was recalled to be Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yuanwen was recalled and made Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guichou day, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guichou day, the emperor toured the metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Emperor returned and halted at the Spring Garden at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he returned and lodged at the Spring Garden in Mukden.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，以李正宗為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiashen day, Li Zhengzhong was made Commander-in-Chief of the Han Banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen day, Li Zhengzhong was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Han Banners.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太皇太后不豫。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill.

sentences.zh: 上詣慈寧宮侍疾。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to the Cining Palace to attend her in her illness.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to the Cining Palace to nurse her through her illness.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，上為太皇太后不豫，親制祝文，步行禱於天壇。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yisi new moon, because the Grand Empress Dowager was ill the Emperor personally composed a prayer text and walked on foot to pray at the Temple of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi new moon of the twelfth month, with the Grand Empress Dowager gravely ill, the emperor composed a prayer in his own hand and walked in person to offer it at the Temple of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以王永譽為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On guihai day Wang Yongyu was made Commander-in-Chief of the Han Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Wang Yongyu was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Han Banners.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，湖廣巡撫張為御史陳紫芝劾其貪婪，侍郎色楞額初按不實。

translations.literal: On yichou day the Huguang governor Zhang Wei was impeached by censor Chen Zizhi for greed; Vice President Selengge's initial investigation had found the charge untrue.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Huguang governor Zhang Wei was impeached by censor Chen Zizhi for corruption, though Vice President Selengge's first inquiry had cleared him.

sentences.zh: 至是，命于成龍、馬齊、開音布馳往提拏，究擬論死，陳紫芝內升。

translations.literal: At this time Yu Chenglong, Ma Qi, and Kaiyinbu were sent posthaste to arrest and try him; he was sentenced to death, and Chen Zizhi was promoted within the palace service.
translations.idiomatic: Now Yu Chenglong, Ma Qi, and Kaiyinbu were dispatched in haste to seize and try him; he was condemned to death, and Chen Zizhi was promoted within the inner service.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On jisi day the Grand Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Grand Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 上哭踴視襝，割辮服衰，居慈寧宮廬次。

translations.literal: The Emperor wailed and leapt, viewed the shroud, cut his queue and wore deep mourning, and dwelt in a mourning hut beside the Cining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wailed and leapt in grief, viewed her shroud, cut his queue, put on the deepest mourning, and lived in a mourning hut by the Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌除夕，群臣請上還宮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, New Year's Eve, the ministers asked the Emperor to return to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, New Year's Eve, the ministers begged the emperor to return to the palace.

sentences.zh: 不允。

translations.literal: He did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山東、山西、江西等省四州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year land tax was remitted in varying degrees for four prefectures and counties in Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, Jiangxi, and other provinces stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That year land tax was remitted in varying degrees for four disaster-stricken prefectures and counties in Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, Jiangxi, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十七年戊辰春正月戊子，上居乾清門外左幕次。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, on wuzi day the Emperor dwelt in the left mourning tent outside the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, on wuzi day of the first month of spring, the emperor remained in the left mourning tent outside the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 乙未釋服。

translations.literal: On yiwei day he ended mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day he laid aside mourning garments.

sentences.zh: 丁酉聽政。

translations.literal: On dingyou day he resumed hearing government.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day he resumed holding court.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，大學士勒德洪、明珠、余國柱有罪免，李之芳罷御史，郭琇具疏論列也。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi day, Grand Secretaries Ledehong, Mingzhu, and Yuguo were dismissed for guilt; Li Zhifang was removed as censor; Guo Xiu had submitted a memorial enumerating their faults.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi day, Grand Secretaries Ledehong, Mingzhu, and Yuguo were dismissed for misconduct; Li Zhifang was stripped of his censorial post after Guo Xiu's memorial had laid out their offenses.

sentences.zh: 尚書科爾昆、佛倫、熊一瀟俱罷。

translations.literal: Ministers Ke'erkun, Folun, and Xiong Yixiao were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers Ke'erkun, Folun, and Xiong Yixiao were all removed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以梁清標、伊桑阿為大學士，李天馥為工部尚書，張玉書為兵部尚書，徐乾學為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Liang Qingbiao and Yisang'a were made Grand Secretaries; Li Tianfu was made Minister of Works; Zhang Yushu was made Minister of War; Xu Qianxue was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Liang Qingbiao and Yisang'a were appointed Grand Secretaries; Li Tianfu became Minister of Works; Zhang Yushu, Minister of War; and Xu Qianxue, Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 定宗室襲封年例。

translations.literal: Regulations were fixed for the years of banner princes' inheritance of titles.
translations.idiomatic: Rules were set governing the years at which members of the imperial clan might inherit banner titles.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，以馬齊為左都御史。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yihai day, Ma Qi was made Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yihai day, Ma Qi was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上召廷臣及董訥、靳輔、于成龍、佛倫、熊一瀟等議河務。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the Emperor summoned court ministers together with Dong Ne, Jin Fu, Yu Chenglong, Folun, Xiong Yixiao, and others to deliberate on river works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor convened court ministers along with Dong Ne, Jin Fu, Yu Chenglong, Folun, Xiong Yixiao, and others to debate river control.

sentences.zh: 次日亦如之。

translations.literal: The next day was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: He did the same again the following day.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，色楞額以按張獄欺罔論死，總督徐國相以徇庇，侍郎王遵訓等以濫舉，俱免官。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Selengge was sentenced to death for deceit in investigating Zhang's case; Governor-General Xu Guoxiang was dismissed for shielding him; Vice President Wang Zunxun and others were dismissed for reckless recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Selengge was condemned to death for deceiving the court in the Zhang Wei investigation; Governor-General Xu Guoxiang was removed for covering for him; Vice President Wang Zunxun and others were dismissed for reckless nominations.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以王新命為河道總督。

translations.literal: On jichou day Wang Xinming was made Director-General of Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Wang Xinming was appointed Director-General of Rivers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，裁湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the Huguang governor-generalship was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the post of Huguang governor-general was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，論河工在事互訐諸臣，董訥、熊一瀟、靳輔、慕天顏、孫在豐俱削官，並趙吉士、陳潢罪之。

translations.literal: On dingyou day an edict addressed the river officials then accusing one another: Dong Ne, Xiong Yixiao, Jin Fu, Mu Tianyan, and Sun Zaifeng were all stripped of office, and Zhao Jishi and Chen Huang were also punished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the emperor rebuked the river officials then trading accusations in office: Dong Ne, Xiong Yixiao, Jin Fu, Mu Tianyan, and Sun Zaifeng were all stripped of rank, and Zhao Jishi and Chen Huang were punished as well.

sentences.zh: 己亥，增遣督捕理事官張鵬翮、兵科給事中陳世安，會內大臣索額圖與鄂羅斯議約定界。

translations.literal: On jihai day Zhang Penghe and Supervising Secretary Chen Shi'an of the Bureau of Military Affairs were further dispatched as commissioners for frontier pacification to join Inner Minister Songgotu in negotiating a boundary treaty with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Zhang Penghe and supervising secretary Chen Shi'an of the Bureau of Military Affairs were additionally sent as frontier pacification commissioners to join Inner Minister Songgotu in fixing a border treaty with Russia.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜沈廷文等一百四十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On renyin day Shen Tingwen and one hundred forty-six others were granted jinshi degrees and court ranks in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Shen Tingwen and one hundred forty-six others received jinshi degrees and court appointments in varying grades.

sentences.zh: 李光地坐妄舉德格勒議處。

translations.literal: Li Guangdi was punished for improperly recommending Degele.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangdi was penalized for improperly recommending Degele.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「李光地前於台灣一役有功，仍以學士用。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Li Guangdi formerly had merit in the Taiwan campaign; he is still to be used as a Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read, "Li Guangdi once rendered distinguished service in the Taiwan campaign; let him continue in office as a Hanlin academician.

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the guimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guimao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以傅拉塔為江南江西總督。

translations.literal: On wushen day Fulata was made governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Fulata was appointed governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上躬送太皇太后梓宮奉安暫安奉殿。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the Emperor personally escorted the Grand Empress Dowager's coffin for temporary enshrinement at the Temporary Resting Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the emperor went in person to escort the Grand Empress Dowager's coffin to its temporary resting place in the Temporary Resting Hall.

sentences.zh: 其後起陵，是曰昭西陵。

translations.literal: When the mausoleum was later raised, it was called the Zhaoxi Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: When her tomb was later completed, it was named the Zhaoxi Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 回蹕至薊州除發。

translations.literal: On the return journey he halted at Jizhou to remove mourning hair.
translations.idiomatic: On the return procession he stopped at Jizhou to complete the rites of removing mourning hair.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以厄魯特侵喀爾喀，使諭噶爾丹。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, because the Oirats invaded the Khalkha, envoys were sent to admonish Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, because the Oirats had invaded the Khalkha, envoys were sent to warn Galdan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上還宮。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命侍郎成其范、徐廷璽查閱河工。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Vice Presidents Cheng Qifan and Xu Tingxi were ordered to inspect river works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Vice Presidents Cheng Qifan and Xu Tingxi were ordered to inspect the river works.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，吏部尚書陳廷敬、刑部尚書徐乾學以疾罷。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao day, Ministers Chen Tingjing and Xu Qianxue of the Boards of Civil Office and Punishments resigned on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao day, Ministers Chen Tingjing and Xu Qianxue of the Boards of Civil Office and Punishments retired because of illness.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以紀爾他布為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Jiertabu was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Jiertabu was appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上謁祭暫安奉殿。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the Emperor performed sacrifice at the Temporary Resting Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the emperor offered sacrifice at the Temporary Resting Hall.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，湖廣督標裁兵夏逢龍作亂，踞武昌，巡撫柯永升投井死，署布政使糧道葉映榴罵賊遇害。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiachen day, Xia Fenglong, a soldier cut from the Huguang governor-general's command, rebelled, seized Wuchang, Huguang governor Ke Yongsheng threw himself into a well and died, and Acting Financial Commissioner Ye Yingliu cursed the rebels and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen day, Xia Fenglong, a trooper dismissed from the Huguang governor-general's command, rose in revolt and seized Wuchang; Governor Ke Yongsheng drowned himself in a well, and Acting Financial Commissioner Ye Yingliu reviled the rebels and was slain.

sentences.zh: 命瓦岱佩振武將軍印討之。

translations.literal: Wadai was ordered to take the seal of the Zhenwu General and suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Wadai was ordered to take the seal of the Zhenwu General and put down the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 庚申，阿喇尼奏噶爾丹侵厄爾德尼招，哲卜尊丹巴、土謝圖汗遁。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Arni reported that Galdan had invaded Erdeni Juu, and that Jebtsundamba and the Tushiyetu Khan had fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Arni reported that Galdan had overrun Erdeni Juu and that Jebtsundamba and the Tushiyetu Khan had fled.

sentences.zh: 發兵防邊。

translations.literal: Troops were sent to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were dispatched to guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，起熊賜履為禮部尚書，徐元文為左都御史。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Xiong Cifu was recalled as Minister of Rites, and Xu Yuanwen as Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Xiong Cifu was recalled as Minister of Rites and Xu Yuanwen as Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 以翁叔元為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Weng Shuyuan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Shuyuan was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，以輔國公化善為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou day, Assistant Duke Huashan was made Commander-in-Chief of the Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou day, Assistant Duke Huashan was made Commander-in-Chief of the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，湖廣提督徐治都大敗夏逢龍於應城，於鯉魚套焚賊舟，賊遁黃岡。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Huguang Provincial Commander Xu Zhidu heavily defeated Xia Fenglong at Yingcheng; at Liyu Tao he burned the rebel boats, and the rebels fled to Huanggang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Huguang provincial commander Xu Zhidu routed Xia Fenglong at Yingcheng; at Carp Reach he burned the rebel fleet, and the rebels fled toward Huanggang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the emperor again toured beyond the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，南陽總兵史孔華復漢陽。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Nanyang commander Shi Konghua recovered Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Nanyang commander Shi Konghua recovered Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，瓦岱復黃州，獲夏逢龍，磔誅之，賊平。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Wadai recovered Huangzhou, captured Xia Fenglong, and executed him by dismemberment; the rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Wadai retook Huangzhou, seized Xia Fenglong, and put him to death by dismemberment; the rebellion was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，雲南提督萬正色侵冒兵饟，按律論死。

translations.literal: On renwu day Yunnan Provincial Commander Wan Zhengse was sentenced to death by law for embezzling military rations.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Yunnan provincial commander Wan Zhengse was condemned to death under the statutes for embezzling military provisions.

sentences.zh: 上念其前陷賊時抗志不屈，行間血戰勞績甚多，免死，革提督，仍留世職。

translations.literal: The Emperor, recalling that when he had earlier been trapped among the rebels he had held firm and refused to submit, and that on campaign he had fought with bloody merit many times, spared his life, removed him as provincial commander, but allowed him to retain his hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, remembering that Wan had once been besieged among the rebels yet held firm and would not yield, and that in battle he had shed blood and won great merit, spared his life, stripped him of the provincial command, but let him keep his hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上駐喀爾必哈哈達，有峰舊名納哈里，高百數十丈，上發數矢皆過峰頂，賜今名。

translations.literal: On renchen day the Emperor halted at Karbinihada; there was a peak formerly called Nahari, several hundred tens of feet high; the Emperor shot several arrows and all passed above the summit, and he bestowed its present name.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the emperor halted at Karbinihada, where a peak once called Nahari rose many hundreds of feet; he loosed several arrows and each flew beyond the summit, and he gave the peak its present name.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，上駐巴顏溝行圍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guimao day, the Emperor halted at Bayangou for the hunt encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao day, the emperor encamped at Bayangou for the hunt.

sentences.zh: 葉映榴遺疏至，贈工部侍郎，下部優恤。

translations.literal: Ye Yingliu's posthumous memorial arrived; he was posthumously made Vice Minister of Works, and the ministries were ordered to grant generous condolence.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Yingliu's final memorial arrived; he was posthumously made Vice Minister of Works, and the ministries were ordered to grant generous mourning favors.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，張玉書奏查閱河工，多用靳輔舊議。

translations.literal: On yimao day Zhang Yushu reported on his inspection of river works, largely adopting Jin Fu's former proposals.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Zhang Yushu reported on his inspection of the river works, relying heavily on Jin Fu's earlier plans.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，遣彭春、諾敏率師駐歸化城防邊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renshen day, Pengchun and Nomin were sent to lead troops stationed at Guihuacheng to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, Pengchun and Nomin were sent to lead troops stationed at Guihuacheng for frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 是時喀爾喀為噶爾丹攻破，徙近邊內。

translations.literal: At this time the Khalkha had been broken by Galdan and moved inward near the border.
translations.idiomatic: By then Galdan had shattered the Khalkha, who had moved in toward the inner frontier.

sentences.zh: 遣阿喇尼往宣諭之，並運米賑撫。

translations.literal: Arni was sent to proclaim and instruct them, and grain was also transported to relieve and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: Arni was dispatched to proclaim the court's will to them, and grain was shipped to feed and comfort them.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復設湖廣總督，以丁思孔為之。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Huguang governor-generalship was restored, and Ding Sikong was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Huguang governor-generalship was reestablished, with Ding Sikong appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，移楊素蘊為湖廣巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao day, Yang Suyun was transferred to be Huguang governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao day, Yang Suyun was transferred to be governor of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以輔國公綽克託為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Assistant Duke Chuoketuo was made General of Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Assistant Duke Chuoketuo was appointed General of Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上大行太皇太后尊諡曰孝庄文皇后。

translations.literal: On yimao day the late Grand Empress Dowager was given the honorific title Empress Xiaozhuangwen.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the late Grand Empress Dowager received the temple honorific Empress Xiaozhuangwen.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，升祔太廟，頒詔中外。

translations.literal: On xinyou day she was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and an edict was promulgated within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day she was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and an edict was issued throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，荊州將軍噶爾漢等坐討賊逗遛奪職，鞭一百，官吏從賊受官者逮治，餘貸之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, Jingzhou General Ga'erhan and others were stripped of office for delaying in suppressing bandits, flogged one hundred strokes, officials who had followed the rebels and accepted office were seized for trial, and the rest were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, Jingzhou general Ga'erhan and others were dismissed for sluggish pursuit of the rebels, flogged one hundred strokes; officials who had joined the rebels and taken posts were arrested for trial, and the remainder were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，以希福為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengzi day, Xifu was made Commander-in-Chief of the Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi day, Xifu was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，建福陵、昭陵聖德神功碑，御制碑文。

translations.literal: On jiachen day sacred merit steles were erected at the Fuling and Zhaoling mausoleums, with imperially composed inscriptions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day steles of sacred merit were raised at the Fuling and Zhaoling tombs, bearing inscriptions composed by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 上謁孝庄山陵。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the Xiaozhuang mountain mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor paid a visit to the Xiaozhuang mountain tomb.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以尼雅翰為西安將軍。

translations.literal: On yisi day Niyahan was made General of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Niyahan was appointed General of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 己酉，進張玉書為禮部尚書；

translations.literal: On jiyou day Zhang Yushu was promoted to Minister of Rites;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Zhang Yushu was promoted to Minister of Rites;

sentences.zh: 徐元文刑部尚書，再進戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Xu Yuanwen was made Minister of Punishments and then further promoted to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yuanwen became Minister of Punishments and was then promoted again to Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上還京。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 兵部、工部會疏福建前造砲船核減工料銀二萬餘兩，應著落故總督姚啟聖名下追賠。

translations.literal: The Boards of War and Works jointly memorialized that in Fujian the earlier construction of gunboats should have its material costs reduced by more than twenty thousand taels of silver, which ought to be charged for recovery against the late governor-general Yao Qisheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Boards of War and Works jointly reported that the earlier Fujian gunboat project had been overcharged by more than twenty thousand taels of silver, which should be recovered from the estate of the late governor-general Yao Qisheng.

sentences.zh: 上以姚啟聖經營平台甚有功績，毋庸著追。

translations.literal: The Emperor said Yao Qisheng had had great merit in organizing the Taiwan campaign and need not be pursued for recovery.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that Yao Qisheng's great service in organizing the Taiwan campaign made further recovery unnecessary.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、江西、湖廣、雲南、貴州等省三十三州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year land tax was remitted in varying degrees for thirty-three prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Huguang, Yunnan, Guizhou, and other provinces stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That year land tax was remitted in varying degrees for thirty-three disaster-stricken prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Huguang, Yunnan, Guizhou, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十八年己巳春正月庚午，詔南巡臨閱河工。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, spring, first month, on gengwu day an edict ordered a southern tour to inspect river works on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, on gengwu day of the first month of spring, an edict announced a southern tour to inspect the river works in person.

sentences.zh: 丙子啟鑾。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the imperial procession set out.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial procession set out.

sentences.zh: 詔所過勿令民治道。

translations.literal: An edict said that along the route the people were not to be made to repair the roads.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded that wherever the procession passed, the people were not to be compelled to repair the roads.

sentences.zh: 獻縣民獻嘉禾。

translations.literal: The people of Xian County presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xian County presented stalks of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔免山東地丁額賦。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict remitted the land and poll tax quotas of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict remitted Shandong's land and poll tax quotas.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上駐濟南。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the Emperor halted at Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the emperor halted at Jinan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，望祀泰山。

translations.literal: On yiyou, distant worship at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Emperor performed the distant rite to Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，次剡城，閱中河。

translations.literal: On gengyin, halted at Yancheng and inspected the Middle Canal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he stopped at Yancheng and inspected the Middle Canal.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，次清河。

translations.literal: On renchen, halted at Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he halted at Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔免江南積欠二十餘萬。

translations.literal: On guisi, an edict remitted more than two hundred thousand in accumulated arrears in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi an edict remitted over two hundred thousand taels of accumulated tax arrears in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上駐揚州。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the Emperor halted at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the imperial procession stopped at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕觀風問俗，鹵薄不設，扈從僅三百人。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We observe local customs on tour; the full imperial train is not deployed, attendants number only three hundred."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "On this tour to observe customs, the full imperial escort is not deployed—only three hundred attendants accompany Us."

sentences.zh: 頃駐揚州，民間結綵盈衢，雖出自愛敬之誠，不無少損物力。

translations.literal: Recently while halting at Yangzhou, the people hung festoons filling the streets; though this came from loyal respect, it was not without some waste of resources.
translations.idiomatic: While recently at Yangzhou the people hung banners along every street; though born of loyal regard, it still cost them something in labor and goods.

sentences.zh: 其前途經過郡邑，宜悉停止。

translations.literal: Along the route through prefectures and counties ahead, this should all be stopped."
translations.idiomatic: Every prefecture and county yet to be passed should cease such displays entirely."

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: [Closing quotation mark]

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，上駐蘇州。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinchou: the Emperor halted at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, the Emperor stopped at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，駐杭州。

translations.literal: On dingwei, halted at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he halted at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔廣學額，賚軍士，復因公降謫官，賜扈從王大臣以次銀幣，賜駐防耆民金。

translations.literal: Ordered expansion of examination quotas, bounty to soldiers, restoration of officials demoted for public service, grants of silver and coin to attendant princes and ministers in order, and gold to garrison elders.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered wider examination quotas, bounties for soldiers, reinstatement of officials demoted for official business, silver and cash gifts for the attendant princes and ministers in rank order, and gold for elderly residents of the garrisons.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，渡錢塘江，至會稽山麓。

translations.literal: On xinhai, crossed the Qiantang River to the foot of Kuaiji Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he crossed the Qiantang River to the foot of Kuaiji Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬子，祭禹陵，親制祭文，書名，行九叩禮，制頌刊石，書額曰「地平天成」。

translations.literal: On renzi, sacrificed at Yu's tomb; personally composed the sacrificial text, wrote his name, performed the nine-kowtow rite, composed a hymn and had it carved on stone, and inscribed a plaque reading "Earth Leveled, Heaven Accomplished."
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he sacrificed at the tomb of Yu the Great, composed the offering text himself, signed his name, performed nine kowtows, wrote a hymn for carving on stone, and titled the plaque "Earth Leveled, Heaven Accomplished."

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上還駐杭州。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Emperor returned and halted at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he returned and lodged at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 閱騎射，賜將軍以及官兵大酺。

translations.literal: Reviewed mounted archery and bestowed a grand feast on the general and on officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He reviewed mounted archery and granted a great feast to the garrison general, officers, and troops.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，次蘇州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, halted at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he stopped again at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 故湖廣糧道葉映榴之子敷迎鑾，為其父請諡。

translations.literal: Ye Yingliu's son Fu welcomed the imperial carriage and requested a posthumous title for his father, former grain intendant of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Fu, son of the late Huguang grain intendant Ye Yingliu, met the imperial train and asked a posthumous title for his father.

sentences.zh: 上書「忠節」二大字賜之。

translations.literal: The Emperor wrote the two characters "Loyal and Upright" and bestowed them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote the two characters "Loyal and Upright" and granted them to the family.

sentences.zh: 松江百姓建碑祈壽，獻進碑文。

translations.literal: Songjiang commoners erected a stele praying for longevity and submitted the inscription.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners of Songjiang erected a longevity stele and presented its text.

sentences.zh: 江南百姓籲留停蹕，獻土物為御食，委積岸上。

translations.literal: Jiangnan commoners begged him to prolong his stay; they presented local produce for imperial food and heaped it on the bank.
translations.idiomatic: People of Jiangnan pleaded that he prolong his halt, offering local foods for the imperial table and piling them along the shore.

sentences.zh: 令取米一撮，果一枚，為留一日。

translations.literal: He ordered one pinch of rice and one fruit taken as tokens, staying one day.
translations.idiomatic: He accepted only a pinch of rice and a single fruit as tokens of their gift and remained one day.

sentences.zh: 浙江巡撫金鋐有罪，削職遣戍。

translations.literal: Jin Qian, Zhejiang governor, was guilty; his office was stripped and he was sent to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Qian, governor of Zhejiang, was found guilty, dismissed, and banished to frontier duty.

sentences.zh: 以張鵬翮為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhang Penghe was appointed Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Penghe was made governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 增設武昌、荊州、常德、岳州水師。

translations.literal: Naval forces were added at Wuchang, Jingzhou, Changde, and Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Riverine forces were established at Wuchang, Jingzhou, Changde, and Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上駐蹕江寧。

translations.literal: On guihai, the imperial carriage halted at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the imperial procession lodged at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祭明陵。

translations.literal: On jiazi, sacrificed at the Ming tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he sacrificed at the Ming imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 賜江寧、京口駐防高年男婦白金。

translations.literal: Bestowed white silver on elderly men and women of the garrisons at Jiangning and Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: He granted silver to aged men and women among the garrison populations at Jiangning and Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上閱射，賜酺。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Emperor reviewed archery and granted a feast.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he held an archery review and bestowed a feast.

sentences.zh: 上詣觀星台，與學士李光地咨論星象，參宿在觜宿之先，恆星隨天而動，老人星合見江南，非隱見也。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to the Observatory and with Academician Li Guangdi discussed the stars: the Shen lodge was ahead of the Zi lodge; fixed stars move with heaven; the Old Man star was jointly visible in Jiangnan—not merely appearing and hiding.
translations.idiomatic: At the Observatory he discussed astronomy with Academician Li Guangdi: Shen preceded Zi among the lodges; the fixed stars wheel with the sky; and the Old Man star shone over Jiangnan as a steady presence, not a fleeting apparition.

sentences.zh: 江寧士民籲留聖駕。

translations.literal: Scholars and commoners of Jiangning begged the sacred carriage to remain.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and townspeople of Jiangning begged the Emperor to stay longer.

sentences.zh: 為留二日。

translations.literal: He remained two days.
translations.idiomatic: He granted them two more days.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰朔，發江寧。

translations.literal: Third month, first day wuchen: departed Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the first of the third month, he left Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，閱高家堰，指授治河方略。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, inspected Gaojia Weir and personally directed river-control strategy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he inspected Gaojia Weir and set out his plan for controlling the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上還京。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 聞安親王岳樂之喪，先臨其第哭之，乃還宮。

translations.literal: Hearing of the death of Prince An Yuele, he first went to his residence to mourn and only then returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Learning of Prince An Yuele's death, he went first to the prince's house to mourn before returning to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命八旗科舉先試騎射。

translations.literal: On dinghai, ordered that Eight Banners examination candidates first be tested in mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he decreed that civil examination candidates of the Eight Banners must first pass a mounted archery test.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔靳輔治河勞績昭然，可復原官。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict said Jin Fu's achievements in river work were manifest and his original office could be restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi an edict declared Jin Fu's river works plainly meritorious and restored him to his former rank.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，增設八旗火器營，副都統領之。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Eight Banners Firearms Brigade was added, commanded by vice commandants.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he established the Eight Banners Firearms Brigade under vice commandants.

sentences.zh: 閏三月壬子，予安親王岳樂祭葬立碑，諡曰和。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day renzi: granted Prince An Yuele funeral rites, a stele, and the posthumous title He.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the intercalary third month he granted Prince An Yuele full funeral honors, a memorial stele, and the posthumous name He.

sentences.zh: 己未，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Emperor visited the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he performed tomb observances.

sentences.zh: 丙午，謁孝庄皇后山陵，謁孝陵。

translations.literal: On bingwu, visited Empress Xiaozhuang's mausoleum and Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he visited the mausoleum of Empress Xiaozhuang and then Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上還京。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥朔，上制孔子贊序及顏、曾、思、孟四贊，頒於學宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day yihai: the Emperor composed the preface to the eulogy of Confucius and eulogies of Yan, Zeng, Si, and Meng, and promulgated them to the academies.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the first day of the fourth month of summer, he composed the preface to Confucius's eulogy and eulogies for Yan, Zeng, Si, and Mencius, and sent them to the schools.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，覆命索額圖等赴尼布楚，與鄂羅斯定邊界。

translations.literal: On renchen, again ordered Songgotu and others to proceed to Nerchinsk to fix the border with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he again dispatched Songgotu and his party to Nerchinsk to settle the boundary with Russia.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀外蒙古內附告飢。

translations.literal: Outer Khalkha Mongolia submitted and reported famine.
translations.idiomatic: The outer Khalkha Mongols, having submitted, reported famine.

sentences.zh: 命內大臣伯費揚古往賑撫之。

translations.literal: Ordered Inner Minister Bo Feiyanggu to go relieve and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Inner Minister Bo Feiyanggu to distribute relief and calm the region.

sentences.zh: 命台灣鑄錢。

translations.literal: Ordered Taiwan to cast coin.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered coin to be cast in Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，以阿蘭泰、徐元文為大學士，顧八代為禮部尚書，郭琇為左都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi: appointed Alan Tai and Xu Yuanwen Grand Secretaries, Gu Badai Minister of Rites, and Guo Xiu Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the fifth month he made Alan Tai and Xu Yuanwen Grand Secretaries, Gu Badai Minister of Rites, and Guo Xiu Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，頒行孝經衍義。

translations.literal: On renxu, promulgated the Expanded Meaning of the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he issued the Expanded Meaning of the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命歸化城屯兵備邊。

translations.literal: On guihai, ordered garrison troops at Guihua Cheng to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he ordered the Guihua Cheng garrison to strengthen frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，以佟寶為寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: appointed Tong Bao general at Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the sixth month he appointed Tong Bao general at Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 兩廣總督吳興祚以鼓鑄不實黜官。

translations.literal: Wu Xingzuo, governor-general of the two Guangs, was dismissed for casting inferior coin.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xingzuo, governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, was removed for debased coinage.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以石琳為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: appointed Shi Lin governor-general of the two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Shi Lin was made governor-general of the two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，冊立貴妃佟氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On guimao, enfeoffed Consort Tong as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he elevated Consort Tong of the Tong clan to empress.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，皇后崩，諡曰孝懿。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the empress died; posthumous title Xiaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the empress died and was given the posthumous name Xiaoyi.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，上巡幸邊外。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiyou: the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the eighth month the Emperor went on tour beyond the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，駐博洛和屯，賜居民銀米。

translations.literal: On wuyin, halted at Boluohetun and bestowed silver and grain on residents.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he stopped at Boluohetun and gave silver and grain to the local people.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，上還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the ninth month he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以倭赫為蒙古都統，額駙穆赫為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On wuwu, appointed Wohe Mongol commander-in-chief and imperial son-in-law Mukhe Han-Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he named Wohe commander of the Mongols and Mukhe, an imperial son-in-law, commander of the Han-martial banners.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，以郎談為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingyin: appointed Langtan Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the tenth winter month Langtan became Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，增設喀爾喀兩翼扎薩克，招集流亡，編置旗隊。

translations.literal: On xinwei, added jasaks for the two wings of Khalkha; gathered displaced persons and organized banner detachments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he added jasak princes for the Khalkha left and right wings, gathered refugees, and registered them in banner units.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，左都御史郭琇以致書本省巡撫請託降官。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Censor-in-chief Guo Xiu was demoted for writing the governor of his native province to seek favors.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Censor-in-chief Guo Xiu was reduced in rank for soliciting patronage from his home-province governor.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，葬孝懿皇后，上臨送。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, buried Empress Xiaoyi; the Emperor attended the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Empress Xiaoyi was buried and the Emperor went in person to the funeral.

sentences.zh: 是月，岷州生番內附。

translations.literal: That month, raw tribes of Minzhou submitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month the uncivilized tribes of Minzhou came under allegiance.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，上還宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the eleventh month he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，孝懿皇后祔奉先殿。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Empress Xiaoyi was enshrined in Fengxian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Empress Xiaoyi was installed in the spirit tablets of Fengxian Hall.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，詔免雲南二十一年至二十三年民欠。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yichou: an edict remitted arrears of Yunnan from the twenty-first through twenty-third years.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the twelfth month an edict canceled tax arrears in Yunnan dating from years twenty-one through twenty-three.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上朝皇太后於慈寧新宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Emperor attended the empress dowager at Cining New Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he paid court to the empress dowager at the new Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以張英為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On wuchen, appointed Zhang Ying Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhang Ying was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，內大臣索額圖疏報與鄂羅斯立約，定尼布楚為界，立碑界上，以五體文書碑。

translations.literal: On yihai, Inner Minister Songgotu memorialized that a treaty with Russia had been concluded, fixing Nerchinsk as the border; a stele was erected on the boundary, inscribed in five scripts.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Inner Minister Songgotu reported that he had concluded a treaty with Russia setting Nerchinsk as the border, with a boundary stele carved in five languages.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、浙江、湖北等省十一州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for eleven prefectures and counties in Zhili, Zhejiang, Hubei, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster levies were reduced or waived, each place according to its need, in eleven prefectures and counties of Zhili, Zhejiang, Hubei, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十九年庚午春正月癸丑，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, gengwu; spring, first month, day guichou: the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, gengwu, on guichou of the first spring month the Emperor went to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣官賑蒙古喀爾喀。

translations.literal: On gengshen, dispatched officials to relieve Khalkha Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he sent officers to distribute famine relief among the Khalkha Mongols.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，以岳樂子馬爾渾嗣封安郡王。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: enfeoffed Yuele's son Ma'erhun to succeed as Prince Anjun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the second month Ma'erhun, son of Yuele, was enfeoffed to succeed as Prince Anjun.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣大臣巡視直隸災區流民。

translations.literal: On yichou, dispatched grand ministers to inspect refugee streams in the Zhili disaster areas.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he sent high ministers to survey displaced populations in the famine districts of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 五城粥廠寬期，倍發銀米，增置處所。

translations.literal: The Five Cities porridge kitchens were extended in term; silver and grain were doubled in issue and more sites were added.
translations.idiomatic: The public soup kitchens of the Five Cities were kept open longer, their grain and silver allotments doubled, and new sites opened.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上謁孝庄山陵，謁孝陵。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Emperor visited Xiaozhuang's mausoleum and Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he visited the tomb of Empress Xiaozhuang and then Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大雨。

translations.literal: On gengwu, heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu there was torrential rain.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上還京。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Emperor presided over the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he held court for the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 戊子，起陳廷敬為左都御史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, recalled Chen Tingjing as Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Chen Tingjing was recalled to serve as Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，除長蘆新增鹽課。

translations.literal: Third month, first day renchen: abolished the newly added salt levy at Changlu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the first day of the third month, the new Changlu salt surcharge was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔修三朝國史。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict ordered compilation of the National History of the Three Reigns.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict commissioned the compilation of the national history of the three reigns.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命都統額赫納、護軍統領馬賴、前鋒統領碩鼐率師征厄魯特。

translations.literal: On guimao, ordered commanders-in-chief Ehen, brigade commander Malai, and vanguard commander Shuonai to lead troops against the Eleuths.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he ordered Ehen, brigade commander Malai, and vanguard commander Shuonai to take the field against the Eleuths.

sentences.zh: 先是，噶爾丹兵侵喀爾喀，迭詔諭解不從，兵近邊塞。

translations.literal: Previously Galdan's troops had invaded Khalkha; repeated edicts ordering withdrawal were ignored, and his army neared the frontier passes.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Galdan had invaded Khalkha; repeated imperial orders to withdraw went unheeded until his forces pressed the border passes.

sentences.zh: 至是，命額赫納等蒞邊御之。

translations.literal: At this time Ehen and the others were ordered to go to the frontier to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Now Ehen and his colleagues were sent to the frontier to meet the threat.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，除雲南黑井加增鹽課。

translations.literal: On xinhai, abolished the increased salt levy at Yunnan's Heijing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the added salt tax at Heijing in Yunnan was rescinded.

sentences.zh: 以張思恭為京口將軍。

translations.literal: Zhang Sigong was appointed general at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Sigong was made garrison general at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，以旱赦殊死以下繫囚。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingchou: owing to drought, amnestied prisoners below capital offense.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the fourth summer month, because of drought, prisoners below the death penalty were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 甲申，建子思子廟於闕里。

translations.literal: On jiashen, built the temple of Master Zisi at Que in Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a temple to Master Zisi was erected at Que in Lu.

sentences.zh: 大清會典成。

translations.literal: The Great Qing Institutional Canon was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Qing Institutional Canon was finished.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯朔，命九卿保舉行取州縣堪為科道者。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day xinmao: ordered the Nine Ministers to recommend prefectural and county officials fit for censorial selection.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the first day of the fifth month, the Nine Ministers were told to nominate local magistrates qualified for promotion to the censorate.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，大學士徐元文免。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: Grand Secretary Xu Yuanwen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the sixth month Grand Secretary Xu Yuanwen was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，噶爾丹追喀爾喀侵入邊。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Galdan pursued Khalkha and invaded the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Galdan pursued the Khalkha into the empire's borderlands.

sentences.zh: 命內大臣蘇爾達赴科爾沁徵蒙古師備御。

translations.literal: Ordered Inner Minister Surda to levy Mongol troops in Khorchin for defense.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Inner Minister Surda to raise Mongol forces in Khorchin for frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 命康親王傑書、恪慎郡王岳希師駐歸化城。

translations.literal: Ordered Prince Kang Jieshu and Prince Kejin Yuexi to garrison Guihua Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Kang Jieshu and Prince Kejin Yuexi were stationed at Guihua Cheng.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅朔，以張英為禮部尚書，以董元卿為京口將軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day gengyin: appointed Zhang Ying Minister of Rites and Dong Yuanqing general at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the first day of the seventh autumn month, Zhang Ying became Minister of Rites and Dong Yuanqing garrison general at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，噶爾丹入犯烏珠穆秦。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Galdan invaded and attacked Ujimchin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Galdan crossed in force against Ujimchin.

sentences.zh: 命裕親王福全為撫遠大將軍，皇子胤禔副之，出古北口。

translations.literal: Ordered Prince Yu Fuquan to be Pacification-General of the Distant Campaign, with the prince Yinreng as his deputy, to march out by Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor appointed Prince Yu Fuquan Pacification-General of the Distant Campaign, with Crown Prince Yinreng as his deputy, and ordered them out through Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 恭親王常寧為安遠大將軍，簡親王喇布、信郡王鄂扎副之，出喜峰口。

translations.literal: Prince Gong Changning was made Secure-the-Distant Grand General, with Prince Jian Labu and Prince Xin E-zha as deputies, to march out by Xifengkou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gong Changning was named Secure-the-Distant Grand General, with Prince Jian Labu and Prince Xin E-zha as his deputies, and they marched out through Xifengkou.

sentences.zh: 內大臣佟國綱、索額圖、明珠、彭春等俱參軍事，阿密達、阿拉尼、阿南達俱會軍前。

translations.literal: Inner ministers Tong Guogang, Songgotu, Mingzhu, Pengchun, and others all took part in military affairs; A-mi-da, A-la-ni, and A-nan-da all assembled before the army.
translations.idiomatic: The inner ministers Tong Guogang, Songgotu, Mingzhu, Pengchun, and others all joined the war council, while A-mi-da, A-la-ni, and A-nan-da all gathered at the front.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以陳廷敬為工部尚書，于成龍為左都御史。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Chen Tingjing was made Minister of Works and Yu Chenglong Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Chen Tingjing was appointed Minister of Works and Yu Chenglong was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上親征，發京師。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, the Emperor personally took the field and set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the Emperor led the campaign in person and departed from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上駐博洛和屯，有疾迴鑾。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, the Emperor encamped at Boluohetun; because of illness he turned back the imperial procession.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the Emperor halted at Boluohetun, but fell ill and turned back toward the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the yimo day, the first of the eighth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, the yimo day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 撫遠大將軍裕親王福全大敗噶爾丹於烏闌布通，噶爾丹以喇嘛濟隆來請和，福全未即進師。

translations.literal: Pacification-General Prince Yu Fuquan inflicted a great defeat on Galdan at Ulan Butung; Galdan had the lama Jilong come to sue for peace, and Fuquan did not press the advance at once.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification-General Prince Yu Fuquan routed Galdan at Ulan Butung. Galdan sent the lama Jilong to sue for peace, and Fuquan held his army back instead of pursuing at once.

sentences.zh: 上切責之。

translations.literal: The Emperor sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked him in the sternest terms.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上還京。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，噶爾丹以誓書來獻。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Galdan presented a written oath.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Galdan submitted a sworn pledge in writing.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「此虜未足信也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This fellow is not to be trusted.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This barbarian is not to be trusted.

sentences.zh: 其整師待之。

translations.literal: Keep the army in readiness against him.
translations.idiomatic: Keep the army ready and watch for him.

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，先是，烏闌布通之戰，內大臣公佟國綱戰歿於陣。

translations.literal: On the guisi day of the ninth month — earlier, at the battle of Ulan Butung, Inner Minister Duke Tong Guogang had died fighting in the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the ninth month: at the battle of Ulan Butung, Inner Minister Duke Tong Guogang had already fallen in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 至是，喪還，命皇子率大臣迎之。

translations.literal: By this time the coffin had returned; the Emperor ordered princes to lead the ministers in meeting it.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the coffin had returned, he ordered the princes to lead the ministers out to receive it.

sentences.zh: 凡陣亡官咸賜奠賜恤有差。

translations.literal: All officers who had died in battle were granted mourning rites and condolence payments according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Every officer killed in battle was granted funeral rites and graded relief for his family.

sentences.zh: 戊申，停今年秋決。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, autumn executions for the year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, the autumn executions were suspended for the year.

sentences.zh: 壬子，弛民間養馬之禁。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the prohibition on commoners keeping horses was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the ban on horse-raising among the common people was eased.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，上疾少愈，召大學士諸臣至乾清宮輪對。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the tenth month of winter, the Emperor's illness had somewhat improved; he summoned the grand secretaries and other ministers to the Qianqing Palace for rotating audiences.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day in the tenth month of winter, as the Emperor's illness eased, he summoned the grand secretaries and other ministers to the Qianqing Palace for successive audiences.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以鄂倫岱為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, E-lun-dai was made Commandant-General of the Han Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, E-lun-dai was appointed Commandant-General of the Han Banners.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，領翰林院學士張英失察編修楊瑄撰擬佟國綱祭文失當，削禮部尚書，楊瑄褫官戍邊入旗。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, Zhang Ying, Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, for failing to oversee that Compiler Yang Xuan had drafted an improper memorial for Tong Guogang, was stripped of the post of Minister of Rites; Yang Xuan was dismissed from office, banished to the frontier, and enrolled in the banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Zhang Ying, Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, was demoted from Minister of Rites for not catching Compiler Yang Xuan's improper elegy for Tong Guogang; Yang Xuan was stripped of office, sent to serve on the frontier, and enrolled in the banners.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，以熊賜履為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the eleventh month, Xiong Cilü was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the eleventh month, Xiong Cilü was appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，達賴喇嘛請上尊號。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, the Dalai Lama requested that an honorific title be conferred on the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the Dalai Lama asked to bestow an honorific title upon the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 不許，並卻其貢。

translations.literal: It was not permitted, and his tribute was also refused.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused, and his tribute was returned as well.

sentences.zh: 己酉，裕親王福全等至京聽勘。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Prince Yu Fuquan and the others reached the capital to await investigation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Prince Yu Fuquan and his command returned to the capital to face inquiry.

sentences.zh: 王大臣議上。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers deliberated and memorialized punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and ministers deliberated and submitted recommendations for punishment.

sentences.zh: 上薄其罪，輕罰之。

translations.literal: The Emperor treated their offenses lightly and punished them leniently.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor judged their offenses lightly and imposed mild penalties.

sentences.zh: 將士仍敘功。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers were still granted merit according to their deeds.
translations.idiomatic: The officers and soldiers were still rewarded according to their merits.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，上謁陵，行孝庄文皇后三年致祭禮。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the twelfth month, the Emperor visited the tombs and performed the three-year mourning sacrifice for Empress Dowager Xiaozhuangwen.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the twelfth month, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs and performed the three-year mourning rites for Empress Dowager Xiaozhuangwen.

sentences.zh: 庚辰還京。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、浙江、甘肅等省三十二州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for thirty-two districts and guards in Zhili, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Gansu, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tax relief for disaster-stricken areas was granted, in varying degrees, to thirty-two districts and guards in Zhili, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Gansu, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十年辛未春正月戊申，封阿祿科爾沁貝勒楚依為郡王，以與厄魯特力戰受傷被執不屈而脫歸也。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, xinwei, on the wushen day of the first month of spring, Chuyi, Beile of the Aluke'erqin, was enfeoffed as a prince of the second rank, because in fierce fighting with the Eleuths he had been wounded, captured, and refused to submit, then escaped and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, xinwei, on the wushen day of the first month of spring, Chuyi, Beile of the Aluke'erqin, was raised to prince of the second rank for having fought the Eleuths to the last, been wounded and taken captive, refused to yield, and made his way home.

sentences.zh: 其十二旗陣亡台吉俱贈一等台吉，賜號達爾漢，子孫承襲。

translations.literal: All the taiji of his twelve banners who had died in battle were posthumously granted First-rank Taiji, given the title Daerhan, and their descendants allowed to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: Every taiji of his twelve banners who had fallen in battle was posthumously made First-rank Taiji, granted the title Daerhan, and given hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹復掠喀爾喀。

translations.literal: Galdan again raided the Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan again raided the Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 命瓦岱為定北將軍，駐張家口，郎談為安北將軍，駐大同，川陝總督會西安將軍駐兵寧夏備之。

translations.literal: Wadai was ordered to be Secure-the-North General and to garrison Zhangjiakou; Lang Tan was made Pacify-the-North General and garrisoned Datong; the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, together with the Xi'an general, stationed troops at Ningxia in readiness.
translations.idiomatic: Wadai was named Secure-the-North General and stationed at Zhangjiakou; Lang Tan was named Pacify-the-North General and stationed at Datong; and the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, with the Xi'an general, held troops at Ningxia in reserve.

sentences.zh: 命在籍勇略將軍趙良棟參軍事。

translations.literal: The retired Yonglue General Zhao Liangdong was ordered to take part in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The retired Yonglue General Zhao Liangdong was ordered to join the staff.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以馬齊為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Ma Qi was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Ma Qi was appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the first of the second month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, the dingsi day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 命步軍統領領巡捕三營，兼轄五城督捕。

translations.literal: The commandant-general of the Foot Brigade was ordered to lead the three patrol battalions and also to oversee arrest duties in the Five Cities.
translations.idiomatic: The commandant-general of the Foot Brigade was ordered to lead the three patrol battalions and to take charge of law enforcement in the Five Cities as well.

sentences.zh: 戊午，厄魯特策旺阿拉布坦使來，噶爾丹之侄也，厚賚其使，比旋，遣郎中桑額護其行。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, an envoy came from the Eleuth Tsewang Arabtan — Galdan's nephew; the envoy was richly rewarded, and when he departed an official of the Court, Sang E, was sent to escort him on his way.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, an envoy arrived from the Eleuth Tsewang Arabtan, Galdan's nephew; the court lavished gifts on him, and when he left, the director Sang E was sent to escort him home.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，繙譯通鑒綱目成，上制序文。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the third month, the Manchu translation of the Comprehensive Mirror was completed, and the Emperor composed a preface.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the third month, the Manchu translation of the Comprehensive Mirror in Outline was completed, and the Emperor wrote a preface for it.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜戴有祺等一百四十八人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Dai Youqi and one hundred forty-eight others were granted jinshi degrees and court ranks in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Dai Youqi and one hundred forty-eight others received jinshi degrees and court ranks according to their standing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，左都御史徐乾學致私書于山東巡撫錢鈺，事發，並褫職。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the fourth month of summer, Left Censor-in-Chief Xu Qianxue sent a private letter to Shandong Governor Qian Yu; when the matter came to light, both were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day in the fourth month of summer, Left Censor-in-Chief Xu Qianxue was found to have sent a private letter to Shandong Governor Qian Yu; when the affair was exposed, both men were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上以喀爾喀內附，躬蒞邊外撫綏。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, because the Khalkha had submitted, the Emperor went in person to the outer marches to pacify and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, with the Khalkha now under imperial protection, the Emperor went in person to the frontier to receive and reassure them.

sentences.zh: 是日，啟鑾。

translations.literal: That same day the imperial procession set out.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the imperial procession set out.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，上駐多羅諾爾。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the fifth month, the Emperor encamped at Dolonnor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the fifth month, the Emperor encamped at Dolonnor.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀來朝。

translations.literal: The Khalkha came to court.
translations.idiomatic: The Khalkha came to pay homage.

sentences.zh: 先是，喀爾喀土謝圖汗聽哲卜尊丹巴唆，殺其同族扎薩克圖汗得克得黑墨爾根阿海，內亂迭興，為厄魯特所乘。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Khalkha Tushetu Khan, heeding the instigation of Jebzundamba Khutuktu, had killed his kinsman the Zhasaktu Khan Dekedehei Mo'ergen Ahai; internal strife broke out repeatedly, and the Eleuths took advantage of it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the Khalkha Tushetu Khan, at the urging of Jebzundamba Khutuktu, had killed his kinsman the Zhasaktu Khan Dekedehei Mo'ergen Ahai; civil strife flared again and again, and the Eleuths seized the moment.

sentences.zh: 至是，遣大臣按其事。

translations.literal: By this time ministers were dispatched to investigate the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Emperor sent ministers to investigate the affair.

sentences.zh: 土謝圖汗、哲卜尊丹巴具疏請罪。

translations.literal: Tushetu Khan and Jebzundamba Khutuktu both submitted written confessions asking pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Tushetu Khan and Jebzundamba Khutuktu both submitted written confessions begging forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 上赦之。

translations.literal: The Emperor pardoned them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned them.

sentences.zh: 以扎薩克圖汗，七旗之長，飭其弟策旺扎布襲汗號，封為親王。

translations.literal: For the Zhasaktu Khan — chief of the seven banners — his younger brother Tsewang Zhab was ordered to succeed to the khan's title and was enfeoffed as a prince of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: As for the Zhasaktu Khan, head of the seven banners, the Emperor ordered his younger brother Tsewang Zhab to succeed to the khanate and enfeoffed him as a prince of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上御行幄，土謝圖汗、哲卜尊丹巴入覲，俯伏請罪。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, the Emperor received audience in his traveling tent; Tushetu Khan and Jebzundamba Khutuktu entered, prostrated themselves, and begged forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the Emperor held court in his traveling tent; Tushetu Khan and Jebzundamba Khutuktu entered, prostrated themselves, and begged forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 大臣宣赦，泣涕謝恩。

translations.literal: A minister proclaimed the pardon; weeping, they thanked the grace.
translations.idiomatic: A minister proclaimed the pardon, and they thanked him in tears.

sentences.zh: 賜茶賜宴賜坐，大合樂，九叩首而退。

translations.literal: Tea, a feast, and seats were granted; great music was performed; they bowed nine times and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They were given tea, a banquet, and seats; music was played; they performed nine kowtows and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 戊子，復召土謝圖汗、哲卜尊丹巴、策旺扎布、車臣汗及喀爾喀諸部濟農、偉徵、諾顏、阿玉錫諸大台吉三十五人賜宴。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Tushetu Khan, Jebzundamba Khutuktu, Tsewang Zhab, the Tsetsen Khan, and thirty-five great taiji of the Khalkha — jijin, weizheng, noyan, and Ayuxi — were again summoned to a feast.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Tushetu Khan, Jebzundamba Khutuktu, Tsewang Zhab, the Tsetsen Khan, and thirty-five Khalkha nobles — jijin, weizheng, noyan, and Ayuxi among them — were summoned again to a feast.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「朕欲熟識爾等，故復饗宴。

translations.literal: He instructed: "I wish to know you well; therefore this second feast.
