translations.idiomatic: He told them, "I wish to know you well, and so I have given this second banquet.

sentences.zh: 」賜之冠服。

translations.literal: " Caps and robes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: " He then bestowed caps and robes.

sentences.zh: 策旺扎布年幼，以皇子衣帽數珠賜之。

translations.literal: Tsewang Zhab was young; he was given a prince's hat and robes and prayer beads.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang Zhab was still young, so he received a prince's hat and robes and a set of prayer beads.

sentences.zh: 以車臣汗之叔扎薩克濟農納穆扎爾前勸車臣汗領十萬眾歸順，身為之倡，請照四十九旗一例，殊為可嘉，許照舊扎薩克，去其濟農之號，封為郡王。

translations.literal: The Tsetsen Khan's uncle, Jasak Jijin Namjilar, had earlier urged the Tsetsen Khan to lead one hundred thousand men in submission and had taken the lead himself; he asked that, in accordance with the precedent of the forty-nine banners, this be deemed especially praiseworthy — permission was given to retain his old jasak status, to remove the title of jijin, and to enfeoff him as a prince of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Tsetsen Khan's uncle, Jasak Jijin Namjilar, had earlier urged the khan to bring one hundred thousand men into allegiance and had led the way himself; citing the precedent of the forty-nine banners, he asked that this be held especially worthy of praise. The Emperor allowed him to keep his former jasak standing, stripped him of the title jijin, and enfeoffed him as a prince of the second rank.

sentences.zh: 餘各封爵有差。

translations.literal: The rest were enfeoffed with titles in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: The others received titles and ranks according to their deserts.

sentences.zh: 傳諭喀爾喀曰：「爾等困窮至極，互相偷奪，朕已拯救愛養。

translations.literal: A message was sent to the Khalkha: "You were utterly destitute and robbed one another; I have rescued and cherished you.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was sent to the Khalkha: "You were driven to utter want and preyed on one another; I have rescued you and shown you favor.

sentences.zh: 今與四十九旗一體編設各處扎薩克，管轄稽察，其各遵守。

translations.literal: Now, like the forty-nine banners, you are organized everywhere with jasak to govern and inspect; each must obey.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as with the forty-nine banners, jasak are appointed throughout your lands to govern and keep order; each of you must abide by that rule.

sentences.zh: 如再妄行，則國法治之矣。

translations.literal: If you act recklessly again, the law of the realm will deal with you.
translations.idiomatic: If you act recklessly again, the law of the realm will punish you."

sentences.zh: 」己丑，上御甲胄乘馬，遍閱各部。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, the Emperor, in armor and on horseback, reviewed all the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the Emperor, armored and mounted, reviewed all the tribes.

sentences.zh: 下馬親射，十矢九中。

translations.literal: He dismounted and shot in person; nine of ten arrows hit.
translations.idiomatic: He dismounted and shot in person, hitting nine arrows out of ten.

sentences.zh: 次大閱滿洲兵、漢軍兵、古北口兵，列陣鳴角，鳥槍齊發，聲動山谷。

translations.literal: Next came a grand review of Manchu troops, Han Banner troops, and Gubeikou troops; the formations sounded horns and muskets fired together, shaking the valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Then came a grand review of the Manchu troops, the Han Banners, and the Gubeikou garrison; horns sounded in the ranks, muskets fired as one, and the noise rolled through the valleys.

sentences.zh: 眾喀爾喀環矚駭嘆曰：「真神威也！

translations.literal: The Khalkha Mongols gathered round, stared in alarm, and exclaimed: "Truly divine prowess!
translations.idiomatic: The Khalkha gathered round, stared in awe, and cried, "This is truly divine might!

sentences.zh: 」科爾沁喀爾喀各蒙古王貝勒請上尊號。

translations.literal: " The Khorchin and Khalkha Mongol princes and beile requested an honorific for the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: " The Khorchin and Khalkha princes and beile asked to bestow an honorific title on the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: It was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上按閱喀爾喀營寨，賚牛羊及其窮困者。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, the Emperor reviewed the Khalkha encampments and bestowed cattle and sheep, including on those in want.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the Emperor inspected the Khalkha camps and gave cattle and sheep, especially to those in want.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣官往編喀爾喀佐領，予之游牧。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, officials were sent to register Khalkha assistant banners and grant them pasture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, officials were sent to enroll the Khalkha in assistant banners and assign them grazing lands.

sentences.zh: 烏珠穆秦台吉車根等以降附厄魯特，按實罪之。

translations.literal: The Ujumchin taiji Chegen and others, for having gone over to the Eleuths, were punished according to the facts.
translations.idiomatic: The Ujumchin taiji Chegen and others, for defecting to the Eleuths, were punished once the facts were established.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, the Emperor turned back the imperial procession.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the Emperor began the journey home.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，還京。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，分會試中卷南左、南右、北左、北右、中左、中右，從御史江蘩之言也。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, metropolitan examination papers were divided into South Left, South Right, North Left, North Right, Central Left, and Central Right — following the proposal of Censor Jiang Fan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the metropolitan examination papers were divided into six regional groups — South Left, South Right, North Left, North Right, Central Left, and Central Right — as Censor Jiang Fan had proposed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，群臣請上尊號。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the ministers requested an honorific title for the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the ministers asked to bestow an honorific title on the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: It was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，以李天馥為吏部尚書，陳廷敬為刑部尚書，高爾位為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the sixth month, Li Tianfu was made Minister of Personnel, Chen Tingjing Minister of Justice, and Gao Erwei Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the sixth month, Li Tianfu was appointed Minister of Personnel, Chen Tingjing Minister of Justice, and Gao Erwei Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，西安將軍尼雅翰奉詔督兵遷巴圖爾額爾克濟農於察哈爾，濟農憚行遁去，尼雅翰追之不及，按問論死。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the seventh month of autumn, Xi'an General Niyahan, by imperial order supervising troops to relocate Batu Erke Jijin to Chahar, found the jijin afraid to go and fled; Niyahan pursued but could not overtake him, was tried, and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day in the seventh month of autumn, Xi'an General Niyahan, ordered to move Batu Erke Jijin to Chahar, found the jijin unwilling to go and in flight; Niyahan pursued but failed to catch him, was tried, and condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 命總督葛思泰追討之。

translations.literal: Governor-General Ge Sitai was ordered to pursue and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Ge Sitai was ordered to pursue and subdue him.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮使人以買一統志發其國論罪。

translations.literal: A Korean envoy was punished for having bought the Unified Gazetteer and sent it home to his country.
translations.idiomatic: A Korean envoy was punished for purchasing the Unified Gazetteer and sending it home to his country.

sentences.zh: 致仕大學士杜立德卒，予祭葬，諡文端。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Secretary Du Lide died; funeral rites were granted and the posthumous title Wenduan was given.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Secretary Du Lide died; he was granted state funeral honors and the posthumous name Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 閏七月丙辰，葛思泰疏報濟農之弟博濟在昌寧湖，經總兵柯彩派兵剿敗，生擒博濟及前禁之格隆等，均斬之。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the intercalary seventh month, Ge Sitai memorialized that the jijin's younger brother Boji was at Changning Lake; the provincial commander Ke Cai had sent troops to defeat him, captured Boji and the previously detained Gelong and others, and all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the intercalary seventh month, Ge Sitai reported that the jijin's younger brother Boji was at Changning Lake; regional commander Ke Cai had routed him, taken Boji and the previously held Gelong and others prisoner, and put them all to death.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上巡幸邊外。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the Emperor toured the outer marches.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Emperor toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，上迴鑾，道遵化，謁孝庄山陵，謁孝陵。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the ninth month, the Emperor returned the imperial procession; passing Zunhua, he visited the tomb of Empress Xiaozhuang and the Xiaoling Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the ninth month, the Emperor returned; on the way he stopped at Zunhua to visit Empress Xiaozhuang's tomb and the Xiaoling Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，還京。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以公阿靈阿為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, Duke A-ling-a was made Mongol Commandant-General.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Duke A-ling-a was appointed Mongol Commandant-General.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命侍郎博濟、李光地、徐廷璽偕靳輔視河。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, Vice Ministers Boji, Li Guangdi, and Xu Tingxi were ordered to join Jin Fu in inspecting the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Vice Ministers Boji, Li Guangdi, and Xu Tingxi were ordered to accompany Jin Fu on an inspection of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，謝爾素番盜殺參將朱震，西寧總兵官李芳述擒盜首華木爾加誅之。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the tenth month of winter, Xie'ersu tribesmen murdered Regional Commander Zhu Zhen; Garrison Commander Li Fangshu of Xining captured the bandit chief Hua Mu'erjia and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day in the tenth month of winter, Xie'ersu tribesmen murdered Regional Commander Zhu Zhen; Li Fangshu, garrison commander of Xining, seized the bandit leader Hua Mu'erjia and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以巴德渾為滿洲都統，杭奕祿為荊州將軍。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Ba Dehun was made Manchu Commandant-General and Hang Yilu Jingzhou General.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Ba Dehun was appointed Manchu Commandant-General and Hang Yilu was appointed Jingzhou General.

sentences.zh: 丁未，甘肅提督孫思克討阿奇羅卜藏，斬之。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, Gansu Provincial Commander-in-Chief Sun Sike campaigned against A-chi-luo-bu-zang and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Gansu Provincial Commander-in-Chief Sun Sike campaigned against A-chi-luo-bu-zang and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 先是，使於厄魯特之侍讀學士達虎還及嘉峪關，為阿奇羅卜藏所害，命思克討之。

translations.literal: Earlier, the reader Dahū, sent on mission to the Eleuths, had been killed at Jiayu Pass by A-chi-luo-bu-zang; Sike had been ordered to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the reader Dahū, returning from a mission to the Eleuths, had been killed at Jiayu Pass by A-chi-luo-bu-zang, and Sun Sike had been ordered to punish him.

sentences.zh: 至是，捷聞。

translations.literal: By this time word of victory arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Now word of victory arrived.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，以索諾和、李振裕為工部尚書，以伊勒慎為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the eleventh month, Suo Nuohe and Li Zhenyu were made Ministers of Works, and Yilezhen was made Manchu Commandant-General.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the eleventh month, Suo Nuohe and Li Zhenyu were appointed Ministers of Works, and Yilezhen was appointed Manchu Commandant-General.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔曰：「朕崇尚德教，蠲滌煩苛，大小諸臣，咸被恩禮。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, an edict said: "I esteem virtue and teach, abolishing vexatious burdens; ministers great and small have all received favor and courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, an edict said, "I honor virtue and instruction and have swept away harassing regulations; ministers great and small have all been shown favor and courtesy.

sentences.zh: 即因事罷退，仍令曲全鄉里。

translations.literal: Even when dismissed for cause, they are still allowed full standing in their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: Even when removed from office for cause, they are still allowed their full standing at home.

sentences.zh: 近來交爭私怨，糾結不已，頗有黨同伐異之習，豈欲釀明季門戶之禍耶？

translations.literal: Recently, exchanging private grudges, entangling without end, there is much the habit of banding with one's own and attacking those who differ—do you wish to brew the factional calamity of the late Ming?
translations.idiomatic: Lately you have traded private grievances and kept up feuds without end, and the habit of siding with allies while attacking opponents has grown strong—do you mean to recreate the late-Ming disaster of factional strife?

sentences.zh: 其各蠲私忿，共矢公忠。

translations.literal: Let each set aside private resentment and together pledge public loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Let each of you lay aside private resentments and together devote yourselves to public loyalty.

sentences.zh: 有怙終者，朕必窮治之。

translations.literal: Those who persist to the end—I shall thoroughly punish them.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever persists stubbornly, I shall punish to the full extent of the law.

sentences.zh: 」是時徐元文、徐乾學、王鴻緒既罷，而傅臘塔等抉摘瑣隱，鉤連興獄，故特詔儆飭焉。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] At that time Xu Yuanwen, Xu Qianxue, and Wang Hongxu had already been dismissed, while Fu Lata and others picked out petty hidden matters and linked cases into prosecutions—hence this special edict to warn and admonish.
translations.idiomatic: By then Xu Yuanwen, Xu Qianxue, and Wang Hongxu had already been removed from office, while Fu Lata and others ferreted out trivial secrets and wove them into prosecutions—hence this special edict of warning.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔曰：「欽天監奏來歲正月朔日食。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, an edict said: "The Directorate of Astronomy reports that on the new moon of the first month next year there will be an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict stated: "The Directorate of Astronomy reports a solar eclipse on the new moon of the first month next year.

sentences.zh: 天象示儆，朕甚懼焉。

translations.literal: The celestial signs show a warning—I am greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven has sent a warning, and I am deeply afraid.

sentences.zh: 其罷元日筵宴諸禮。

translations.literal: Let the New Year's banquet and related rites be canceled.
translations.idiomatic: Cancel the New Year's banquet and related ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 諸臣宜精白供職，助朕修省。

translations.literal: Ministers should purify themselves and devote themselves to duty, aiding Me in self-examination and restraint.
translations.idiomatic: You ministers should purify yourselves, perform your offices diligently, and help me examine my conduct and practice restraint.

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，詔曰：「朕撫馭區宇，惟以愛養蒼生，俾臻安阜為念。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on day jiashen, an edict said: "In governing the realm, I think only of cherishing and nourishing the common people so they may reach peace and plenty.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiashen day, an edict said: "In ruling the realm I think only of cherishing the people and bringing them peace and plenty.

sentences.zh: 比歲地丁額賦，迭經蠲免，而歲運漕米，尚在輸將，時切軫念。

translations.literal: In recent years land-and-poll quota levies have been repeatedly remitted, yet the annual transport grain for the Grand Canal still must be delivered—I constantly bear this in mind with concern.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years land and poll taxes have been remitted again and again, yet annual transport grain for the Grand Canal must still be delivered—a matter that weighs constantly on my mind.

sentences.zh: 除河南已經蠲免外，其湖廣、江蘇、浙江、安徽、山東漕米，以次各免一年，用紓民力。

translations.literal: Apart from Henan, which has already been exempted, the transport grain of Huguang, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, and Shandong shall each in turn be exempted for one year to ease the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from Henan, which has already been exempted, transport quotas for Huguang, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, and Shandong shall each be waived for one year in succession, to ease the people's burden.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，移旗庄壯丁赴古北口外達爾河墾田。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day dinghai, strong young men from Banner estates were moved beyond Gubeikou to reclaim land at the Da'er River.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, able-bodied men from banner estates were sent beyond Gubeikou to open farmland on the Da'er River.

sentences.zh: 遣侍郎阿山、德珠等往陝西監賑。

translations.literal: Vice Presidents Ashan, Dezhu, and others were dispatched to Shaanxi to supervise famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Presidents Ashan, Dezhu, and others were sent to Shaanxi to supervise famine relief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，諭督、撫、提、鎮保舉武職堪任用及曾立功者，在內八旗旗員，令都統等舉之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, [the Emperor] ordered governors-general, governors, provincial military commanders, and regional commanders to recommend martial officials fit for employment and those who had performed meritorious service; for Eight Banner members within [the capital], commanders-in-chief and the like were ordered to recommend them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Emperor ordered governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders to recommend martial officials fit for service and those who had won distinction; for banner officers in the capital, commanders-in-chief and the like were to make recommendations.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、河南、山東、陝西、湖廣、雲南等省一百八十八州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster levies were remitted in varying amounts for 188 prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, Huguang, Yunnan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying amounts for 188 prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, Huguang, Yunnan, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Annam, and the Ryukyus sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Annam, and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 三十一年壬申春正月辛亥朔，日有食之，免朝賀。

translations.literal: In the 31st year, renshen, spring, first month, on day xinhai the new moon—there was an eclipse of the sun; court congratulations were dispensed with.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, renshen, spring, first month, on the xinhai new moon there was a solar eclipse; the New Year court audience was canceled.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上御乾清門，出示太極圖、五音八聲八風圖，因言：「律呂新書徑一圍三之法，用之不合。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor took the throne at the Gate of Heavenly Purity and displayed the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate and the diagrams of the five tones, eight sounds, and eight winds, saying: "The New Book of Pitch Pipes uses the method of diameter one, circumference three—it does not fit when applied.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor presided at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, displayed the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate and charts of the five tones, eight sounds, and eight winds, and said: "The New Book of Pitch Pipes uses the rule 'diameter one, circumference three'—applied in practice it does not hold.

sentences.zh: 徑一尺圍當三尺一寸四分一釐，積至百丈，所差至十四丈外矣。

translations.literal: With one chi diameter the circumference should be three chi one cun four fen one li; accumulated to a hundred zhang, the error exceeds fourteen zhang.
translations.idiomatic: A diameter of one chi should give a circumference of three chi, one cun, four fen, and one li; carried to a hundred zhang, the error exceeds fourteen zhang.

sentences.zh: 寧可用邪？

translations.literal: How can it be used?
translations.idiomatic: How can such a method be used?

sentences.zh: 惟隔八相生之說，試之悉合。

translations.literal: Only the theory of generating [tones] by skipping eight—when tested, all accord.
translations.idiomatic: Only the principle of generation by the interval of eight, when tested, proves fully correct.

sentences.zh: 」又論河道閘口流水，晝夜多寡，可以數計。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] He again discussed the flow of water at canal sluice gates, saying that day and night volumes can be reckoned by number.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to explain that the volume of water passing canal locks by day and night can be calculated numerically.

sentences.zh: 又出示測日晷表，畫示正午日影至處，驗之不差。

translations.literal: He again produced a sundial for measuring the sun, marking where the noon shadow reaches; verified, it was without error.
translations.idiomatic: He also produced a solar gnomon, marked where the noon shadow fell, and when checked it proved exact.

sentences.zh: 諸臣皆服。

translations.literal: All ministers were convinced.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled ministers were fully persuaded.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting encampment.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，以靳輔為河道總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi: Jin Fu was made Director-General of Rivers and Canals.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi day, Jin Fu was appointed Director-General of Rivers and Canals.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以陝西旱災，發山西帑銀、襄陽米石賑之。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because of drought disaster in Shaanxi, treasury silver from Shanxi and grain from Xiangyang were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, because of drought in Shaanxi, treasury silver from Shanxi and grain from Xiangyang were disbursed for relief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor made a tour of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，陝西巡撫薩弼以賑災不實褫職。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Shaanxi Governor Sabi was stripped of office for false reporting on famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Shaanxi Governor Sabi was dismissed for misreporting famine relief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上還京。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Emperor held court for the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以馬齊為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Ma Qi was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Ma Qi was appointed Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，遣內大臣阿爾迪、理籓院尚書班迪赴邊外設立蒙古驛站。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: Inner Minister Ardi and Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs Bandi were sent beyond the border to establish Mongol courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingchen day, Inner Minister Ardi and Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs Bandi were sent beyond the frontier to establish Mongol relay stations.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命府丞徐廷璽協理河工。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Vice Director Xu Tingxi was ordered to assist in managing river works.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Vice Director Xu Tingxi was ordered to assist in river works.

sentences.zh: 加甘肅提督孫思克太子少保，予世職。

translations.literal: Gansu Provincial Military Commander Sun Sike was promoted to Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and granted a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Sike, provincial military commander of Gansu, was promoted to Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and granted a hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 致仕大學士馮溥卒，予祭葬，諡文敏。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Secretary Feng Pu died; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted; posthumous title Wenmin.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Secretary Feng Pu died; funeral sacrifices and burial honors were granted, with the posthumous title Wenmin.

sentences.zh: 以阿席坦為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Ashitan was made Manchu Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Ashitan was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 置雲南永北鎮。

translations.literal: The Yongbei garrison in Yunnan was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongbei garrison in Yunnan was established.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰朔，以希福為滿洲都統，護巴為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengchen new moon: Xifu was made Manchu Commander-in-Chief; Hubai was made Mongol Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the gengchen new moon, Xifu was made Manchu commander-in-chief and Hubai Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己丑，發帑銀百萬賑陝西，尚書王騭、沙穆哈往視加賑。

translations.literal: On day jichou, one million taels from the treasury was issued for Shaanxi relief; Ministers Wang E and Shamuka went to inspect and add further relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day one million taels of treasury silver was sent for Shaanxi relief; Ministers Wang E and Shamuka went to inspect conditions and add further aid.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上幸瀛台，召近臣觀稻田及種竹。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor went to Yingtai and summoned close ministers to view the rice fields and bamboo planting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor went to Yingtai and summoned close ministers to view the rice fields and bamboo groves.

sentences.zh: 河道總督靳輔請建新莊、仲家淺各一閘，下部議行。

translations.literal: Director-General of Rivers Jin Fu requested building one sluice each at Xinzhuang and Zhongjiaqian; the matter was referred to the ministries for deliberation and execution.
translations.idiomatic: Director-General of Rivers Jin Fu requested one new lock each at Xinzhuang and Zhongjiaqian; the proposal was sent to the ministries for approval and implementation.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，諭戶部，山西平陽豐收，可遣官購買備荒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin: the Ministry of Revenue was instructed that Pingyang in Shanxi had a bountiful harvest and officials could be sent to purchase grain for famine reserve.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin day, the Ministry of Revenue was told that Pingyang in Shanxi had had a rich harvest and that officials might be sent to buy grain for famine reserves.

sentences.zh: 命王維珍董其事。

translations.literal: Wang Weizhen was ordered to oversee the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Weizhen was ordered to take charge of the purchases.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，定喀爾喀部為三路，土謝圖為北路，車臣為東路，扎薩克圖為西路，屬部各從其分地畫為左右翼。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Khalkha were defined as three routes: Tushetu as the northern route, Choying as the eastern route, and Zasagtu as the western route; dependent tribes were each, according to their territories, divided into left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Khalkha were organized into three routes—Tushetu in the north, Choying in the east, and Zasagtu in the west—and dependent tribes were each, by territory, assigned left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，以宋犖為江寧巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: Song Luo was made Governor of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengchen day, Song Luo was appointed governor of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 乙未，蒙古科爾沁進獻錫伯、卦爾察、打虎爾一萬餘戶，給銀酬之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Khorchin Mongols presented more than ten thousand households of Sibe, Guwalgiya, and Dahur; silver was given in reward.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Khorchin Mongols presented more than ten thousand households of Sibe, Guwalgiya, and Dahur people; silver was given in reward.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yihai: the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on yihai day, the Emperor toured beyond the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，以翁叔元為刑部尚書，以博濟為西安將軍，李林隆為固原提督，李芳述為貴州提督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: Weng Shuyuan was made Minister of Justice; Boji was made General of Xi'an; Li Linlong was made Garrison Commander of Guyuan; Li Fangshu was made Garrison Commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Weng Shuyuan was appointed Minister of Justice; Boji was made general of Xi'an; Li Linlong garrison commander of Guyuan; and Li Fangshu garrison commander of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，噶爾丹屬人執我使臣馬迪戕之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen: Galdan's followers seized and killed Our envoy Ma Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen day, men under Galdan seized and killed the envoy Ma Di.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上還次湯泉。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor halted at Tangquan on his return.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, on the return journey, the Emperor stopped at Tangquan.

sentences.zh: 己未，還京。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上大閱於玉泉山。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor held a grand review at Jade Spring Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor conducted a grand military review at Jade Spring Mountain.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，詔曰：「秦省比歲凶荒，加以疾疫，多方賑濟，未甦積困。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao, an edict said: "Shaanxi Province in recent years has suffered famine and additionally pestilence; relief has been applied on many sides, yet accumulated distress has not revived.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jimao day, an edict said: "Shaanxi has suffered famine year after year, and plague as well; though relief has been sent from many quarters, deep distress has not yet eased.

sentences.zh: 所有明年地丁稅糧，悉予蠲免。

translations.literal: All land-and-poll taxes and grain levies for next year are entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All land and poll taxes and grain levies for next year are hereby remitted in full.

sentences.zh: 從前逋欠，一概豁除。

translations.literal: Prior arrears are wholly written off.
translations.idiomatic: All past arrears are likewise canceled.

sentences.zh: 用稱朕子惠元元至意。

translations.literal: Thus to accord with My will to nurture the people from the ultimate source.
translations.idiomatic: Thus to fulfill my intent to care for the people to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，以李天馥為大學士。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day gengchen, Li Tianfu was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Li Tianfu was appointed Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor paid respects at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 曲赦陝西，非十惡及軍前獲譴者，皆免死減一等。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for Shaanxi: except for the ten abominations and those punished before the army, all were spared death and reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: A limited amnesty was proclaimed for Shaanxi: except for the ten capital crimes and those condemned on campaign, all death sentences were commuted and penalties reduced one degree.

sentences.zh: 以佛倫為川陝總督，宗室董額為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Folun was made Governor-General of Sichuan and Shaanxi; the imperial clansman Dong'e was made Manchu Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Folun was appointed governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi, and the imperial clansman Dong'e Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以熊賜履為吏部尚書，張英為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Xiong Cilü was made Minister of Personnel; Zhang Ying was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Xiong Cilü was appointed Minister of Personnel and Zhang Ying Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 庚子，停直省進鮮茶暨賚送表箋。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, delivery of fresh tribute tea and presentation of memorials and felicitations from the provinces were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the provinces were excused from sending fresh tribute tea and from presenting memorials of congratulation.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，以阿靈阿為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: Aringga was made Manchu Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengxu day, Aringga was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命熊賜履勘察淮、揚濱河涸田。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Xiong Cilü was ordered to survey dried-up fields along the Huai and Yang rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiong Cilü was ordered to inspect dried-up fields along the Huai and Yang river coasts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，加孫思克振武將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Sun Sike was promoted to General Who Quells the Martial.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Sun Sike was promoted to General Who Quells the Martial.

sentences.zh: 以覺羅席特庫為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: The Aisin Gioro clansman Xiteku was made Mongol Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The Aisin Gioro clansman Xiteku was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，河道總督靳輔卒，予祭葬，諡文襄。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu: Director-General of Rivers Jin Fu died; sacrificial rites and burial were granted; posthumous title Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu day, Director-General of Rivers Jin Fu died; funeral sacrifices and burial honors were granted, with the posthumous title Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 以于成龍為河道總督，董訥為左都御史。

translations.literal: Yu Chenglong was made Director-General of Rivers; Dong Ne was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chenglong was appointed Director-General of Rivers, and Dong Ne Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以郎化麟為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Lang Hualin was made Chinese Banner Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Lang Hualin was appointed Chinese Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以西安飢，運襄陽米平糶。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, because Xi'an was famine-stricken, grain from Xiangyang was transported for sale at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because Xi'an was suffering famine, grain from Xiangyang was shipped in for sale at fair price.

sentences.zh: 加希福建威將軍，移戍右衛。

translations.literal: Xi Fu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the Martial and shifted to garrison at Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Fu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the Martial and transferred to garrison duty at Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 召科爾沁蒙古王沙津入京，面授機宜，使誘噶爾丹。

translations.literal: The Khorchin Mongol prince Shajin was summoned to the capital, given instructions in person, and sent to entice Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: The Khorchin Mongol prince Shajin was summoned to court, given his orders in person, and sent to draw Galdan out.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免陝西、江南、四川等省十三州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster levies were remitted in varying amounts for thirteen prefectures and counties in Shaanxi, Jiangnan, Sichuan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying amounts for thirteen prefectures and counties in Shaanxi, Jiangnan, Sichuan, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十二年癸酉春正月甲子，詔朝鮮歲貢黃金木棉永行停止。

translations.literal: In the 32nd year, guiyou, spring, first month, day jiazi: an edict permanently halted Korea's annual tribute of gold and kapok cotton.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, guiyou, spring, first month, on jiazi day, an edict permanently ended Korea's annual tribute of gold and cotton.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥朔，發帑金，招商販米西安平市價。

translations.literal: Second month, yihai new moon: treasury gold was issued to invite merchants to sell grain at Xi'an at market price.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yihai new moon, treasury funds were released to encourage merchants to bring grain to Xi'an and sell it at market rates.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣內大臣坡爾盆等往督歸化城三路屯田。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Inner Minister Po'erpen and others were sent to supervise garrison farming on the three routes at Guihuacheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Inner Minister Po'erpen and others were sent to supervise garrison farming on the three routes at Guihuacheng.

sentences.zh: 詔修南河周橋堤工，往年靳輔與陳潢所經度者，至是閱河大臣繪圖進呈，特詔修之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered repair of the Zhou Bridge embankment works on the southern canal—what Jin Fu and Chen Huang had surveyed in earlier years; now the river-inspection grandees submitted drawings, and a special edict ordered the repairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered repairs to the Zhou Bridge embankment on the southern canal—the works Jin Fu and Chen Huang had surveyed in earlier years; now the river-inspection officials submitted plans, and a special edict commanded the work to proceed.

sentences.zh: 策旺阿拉布坦遣使入貢，報告使臣馬迪被害及噶爾丹密事，以綵緞賚之。

translations.literal: Tsewang Rabtan sent envoys bearing tribute, reporting the killing of envoy Ma Di and secret intelligence on Galdan; colored silks were bestowed in reward.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang Rabtan sent envoys with tribute, reporting the murder of Ma Di and secret news about Galdan; colored silks were bestowed in return.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day guimei, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimei day the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 改宣府六廳十衛為一府八縣。

translations.literal: The six subprefectures and ten guards of Xuanfu were reorganized into one prefecture and eight counties.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanfu's six subprefectures and ten guards were reorganized into one prefecture and eight counties.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命郎談為昭武將軍，偕阿南達、碩鼐帥師赴寧夏，將軍博濟、孫思克參軍事。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Lang Tan was made General Who Manifests Martiality; together with Ananda and Shuonai he led troops to Ningxia; Generals Boji and Sun Sike joined the military council.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Lang Tan was appointed General Who Manifests Martiality; with Ananda and Shuonai he led troops to Ningxia, while Generals Boji and Sun Sike served on the staff.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上巡幸畿甸，閱霸州苑家口堤工，諭巡撫郭世隆修之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor toured the capital region, inspected the Yuanjiakou embankment works at Bazhou, and instructed Governor Guo Shilong to repair them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Emperor toured the capital region, inspected the Yuanjiakou dike at Bazhou, and ordered Governor Guo Shilong to repair it.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 貴州巡撫衛既齊疏報剿辦土司失實，奪職戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: Guizhou Governor Wei Jiji memorialized that the campaign against native chieftains had been misreported; his office was seized and he was banished to serve at Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou Governor Wei Jiji reported that the pacification of native chieftains had been falsely represented; he was dismissed and banished to serve at Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，遣皇子胤禔祭華山。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingwu: Imperial Son Yinti was dispatched to sacrifice at Mount Hua.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingwu day, Imperial Son Yinti was sent to offer sacrifice at Mount Hua.

sentences.zh: 丁未，移饒州府駐景德鎮。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Raozhou Prefecture's seat was moved to Jingdezhen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the seat of Raozhou Prefecture was moved to Jingdezhen.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，置廣東運司、潮州運同。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Guangdong transport commissioner and Chaozhou transport deputy were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Guangdong transport intendant and the Chaozhou transport deputy were established.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔趙良棟系舊臣，可暫領寧夏總兵。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, an edict said Zhao Liangdong, as a former minister, might temporarily hold the post of Ningxia regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict said that Zhao Liangdong, as a veteran minister, might temporarily hold the post of regional commander at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，喀爾喀台吉車凌扎布自鄂羅斯來歸，賚之袍服，賜克魯倫游牧。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingxu: Khalkha taiji Cheling Zhabu came back from Russia; robes were bestowed and he was granted nomadic pastures on the Kerulen.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on bingxu day, the Khalkha taiji Cheling Zhabu returned from Russia; robes were bestowed and he was granted pastures on the Kerulen.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命檢直省解送物料共九十九項，減去四十項免解。

translations.literal: On day guisi, an order was issued to review the ninety-nine categories of materials sent as tribute from the provinces; forty categories were cut and exempted from delivery.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day an order was issued to review the ninety-nine categories of goods the provinces were required to send; forty categories were struck from the list and exempted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以心裕為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Xinyu was made Mongol Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Xinyu was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，命內大臣伯費揚古為安北將軍，駐歸化城。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu: Inner Minister Bei Feiyanggu was made General Who Pacifies the North and stationed at Guihuacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengxu day, Inner Minister Bei Feiyanggu was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and stationed at Guihuacheng.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，廣八旗鄉、會中額。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: the civil-service quota for Eight Banner candidates in the provincial and metropolitan examinations was expanded.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai day, the examination quotas for banner candidates in the provincial and metropolitan tests were increased.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，免廣西、四川、貴州、雲南四省明年地丁稅糧。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: land-and-poll taxes and grain levies for next year were remitted in Guangxi, Sichuan, Guizhou, and Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, land and poll taxes and grain levies for next year were remitted in Guangxi, Sichuan, Guizhou, and Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上巡幸塞外行圍。

translations.literal: On day guimei, the Emperor toured beyond the passes for the border hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On guimei day the Emperor went beyond the passes for the hunting encampment.

sentences.zh: 蒙古科爾沁諸部朝行在，賜冠服銀幣。

translations.literal: The various tribes of the Mongol Khorchin came to court at the traveling palace; caps, robes, silver, and coins were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Khorchin Mongol tribes came to court at the traveling palace and were given caps, robes, silver, and cash.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，修盛京城。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei: repairs were made to Shengjing city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingwei day, Shengjing city was repaired.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，琉球來貢，遣其質子還國。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Ryukyu came with tribute and its hostage prince was sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Ryukyu presented tribute, and its hostage prince was sent back to his country.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，詔曰：「給事中彭鵬奏劾順天考官，請朕親訊，是大臣皆不可信矣。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renshen: an edict said, "The supervising secretary Peng Peng memorialized impeaching the Shuntian examination officials and asked that I personally interrogate them—this means that no grand minister can be trusted.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on renshen day, an edict stated: "Supervising Secretary Peng Peng impeached the Shuntian examination officials and asked me to question them in person—as if no high minister could be trusted.

sentences.zh: 治天下當崇大體，若朕事事躬親，則庶務何由畢理乎？

translations.literal: In governing the realm one should uphold the great principles; if I personally attended to every matter, how could the myriad affairs ever be fully settled?
translations.idiomatic: In governing the realm one must keep to the larger principles; if I handled every matter myself, how could the myriad affairs ever be brought to completion?

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，上大閱於玉泉山。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day renchen, the Emperor held a great review at Jade Spring Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen day the Emperor held a grand military review at Jade Spring Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，鄂羅斯察漢汗來貢。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Russian Tsar of Siberia came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Russian Tsar of Siberia presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 上諭大學士曰：「外籓朝貢，固屬盛事，傳至後世，未必不因而生事。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed the Grand Secretaries: "Tribute missions from outer domains are indeed a splendid affair, yet handed down to later ages they may not fail to breed trouble on that account.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told the Grand Secretaries: "Tribute from the outer domains is indeed a splendid thing, yet if this is carried on for generations it may well breed trouble.

sentences.zh: 惟中國安寧，則外患不生，當培養元氣為根本耳。

translations.literal: Only when China is tranquil will outer troubles not arise; one should cultivate the vital energy as the root.
translations.idiomatic: Only when China is at peace will outer troubles not arise; the fundamental task is to nurture the realm's vital strength.

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: [Closing quotation mark]

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，上奉皇太后謁孝庄山陵、孝陵。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinchou: the Emperor, attending the Empress Dowager, paid respects at the Xiaozhuang tomb mound and the Xiaoling mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to worship at the Xiaozhuang tomb and the Xiaoling mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 庚申，還宮。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, they returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day they returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔免順天、河間、保定、永平四府明年稅糧。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict remitted next year's land tax and grain levies in the four prefectures of Shuntian, Hejian, Baoding, and Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict remitted next year's taxes and grain levies in Shuntian, Hejian, Baoding, and Yongping.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，以宗室公楊岱為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: the imperial clansman Duke Yangdai was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, Imperial Clansman Duke Yangdai was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting encampment.

sentences.zh: 諭：「滿洲官兵近來不及從前之精銳，故比年親加校閱，間以行圍。

translations.literal: An instruction said: "Manchu officers and soldiers of late have not been as sharp as in former times; therefore in recent years I have personally reviewed them and occasionally held hunting encampments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Manchu officers and soldiers have lately fallen short of their former keenness; in recent years I have therefore reviewed them in person and held hunting encampments from time to time.

sentences.zh: 頃見諸士卒行列整齊，進退嫻熟，該軍校等賞給一個月錢糧，該管官賞給緞疋，以激戎行。

translations.literal: Just now I saw the troops in orderly ranks, advancing and withdrawing with practiced skill—the company officers and the like are rewarded with one month's pay and grain, and the commanding officers with bolts of silk, to spur them in military service.
translations.idiomatic: I have just seen the men in orderly ranks, advancing and withdrawing with practiced skill—the company officers are rewarded with one month's pay and grain, and their commanders with bolts of silk, to encourage them on campaign.

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day dingyou, the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingyou day the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、浙江、山西、湖廣等省六十九州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for sixty-nine prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Shanxi, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees in sixty-nine prefectures and counties across Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Shanxi, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 三十三年甲戌春正月乙卯，盛京歉收，命馬齊馳往，以倉穀支給兵丁，海運山東倉穀濟民食。

translations.literal: Thirty-third year, jiaxu: spring, first month, day yimao—Shengjing had a poor harvest; Ma Qi was ordered to hurry there, issuing grain from the granaries to supply the troops, and shipping grain from Shandong granaries by sea to relieve the people's food shortage.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, jiaxu, spring, first month, on yimao day—Shengjing had a poor harvest; Ma Qi was dispatched in haste to issue grain from the granaries to the troops and to ship grain from Shandong by sea to feed the people.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召見河道總督于成龍，問曰：「爾前言減水壩不宜開，靳輔糜費錢糧，今竟何如？

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the river-course grand coordinator Yu Chenglong was summoned and asked: "You said earlier that the flood-reduction dam should not be opened and that Jin Fu wasted funds and grain—how does it stand now?
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the river-course grand coordinator Yu Chenglong was summoned and asked: "You said earlier that the flood-reduction dam should not be opened and that Jin Fu had wasted funds and grain—what is the truth of it now?

sentences.zh: 」成龍曰：「臣前誠妄言。

translations.literal: Chenglong said: "Your servant spoke falsely before.
translations.idiomatic: Chenglong replied: "Your servant spoke falsely before.

sentences.zh: 今所辦皆照靳輔而行。

translations.literal: What is now being done all follows Jin Fu's methods.
translations.idiomatic: Everything now being done follows Jin Fu's methods.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「然則爾所言之非，靳輔所行之是，何以不明白陳奏，尚留待排陷耶？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Then what you said was wrong and what Jin Fu did was right—why did you not state this plainly in memorial, but still leave room to entrap him?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Then what you said was wrong and what Jin Fu did was right—why did you not state this plainly in memorial, but still leave room to entrap him?

sentences.zh: 」因諭大學士曰：「于成龍前奏靳輔未曾種柳河堤，朕南巡時，指河干之柳問之，無辭以對。

translations.literal: He then instructed the Grand Secretaries: "Yu Chenglong formerly memorialized that Jin Fu had never planted willows on the river embankment; when I toured south I pointed to the willows along the river and asked him, and he had no answer.
translations.idiomatic: He then told the Grand Secretaries: "Yu Chenglong once reported that Jin Fu had never planted willows on the river dike; when I toured south I pointed to the willows along the bank and he had no reply.

sentences.zh: 又奏靳輔放水淹民田，朕復至其地觀之，斷不至淹害麥田。

translations.literal: He also reported that Jin Fu released water and drowned the people's fields; I went again to see the place and it certainly could not have flooded the wheat fields.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that Jin Fu had released water and drowned the people's fields; when I went to see the place myself it could not possibly have harmed the wheat.

sentences.zh: 而王騭、董訥等亦附和于成龍言之。

translations.literal: Wang E and Dong Ne too echoed Yu Chenglong's words.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E and Dong Ne too echoed Yu Chenglong.

sentences.zh: 」下部議，將于成龍革職枷責。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to the ministries for deliberation; Yu Chenglong was to be dismissed and punished with the cangue.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the ministries; Yu Chenglong was to be dismissed and punished with the cangue.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「伊經手之工未完，應革職留任。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The works under his hand are not yet finished; he should be dismissed but kept in office.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "The works under his charge are not yet finished; dismiss him from rank but keep him at his post.

sentences.zh: 」王騭休致，董訥革職。

translations.literal: Wang E was retired, Dong Ne dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E was allowed to retire; Dong Ne was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinwei: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei day, the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大學士請間三四日一御門聽政。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Grand Secretaries requested that audience be held every three or four days.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Grand Secretaries asked that the Emperor hear affairs at court every three or four days.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「昨諭六十以上大臣間日奏事，乃優禮老臣耳。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Yesterday's instruction that ministers over sixty might present business every other day was only a courtesy to old officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Yesterday's instruction that ministers over sixty might present business every other day was only a courtesy to aged officials.

sentences.zh: 若朕躬豈敢暇逸，其每日聽政如常。

translations.literal: As for My person, how could I dare be idle? Daily audience shall continue as usual.
translations.idiomatic: As for myself, how could I dare be idle? Daily audience shall continue as before.

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，以諾穆圖為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day dingchou, Nomutu was made Han Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingchou day Nomutu was appointed Han Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 敕修通州至西沽兩岸堤工。

translations.literal: An order was issued to repair the embankment works on both banks from Tongzhou to Xizhu.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued to repair the embankments on both banks from Tongzhou to Xizhu.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，上還京。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinchou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書沙穆哈以議皇太子祀奉先殿儀注不敬免官。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Shamoha was dismissed for irreverence in deliberating the ritual protocol for the Crown Prince's sacrifice at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Shamoha was dismissed for irreverence in drafting the ritual for the Crown Prince's sacrifice at the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜胡任輿等一百六十八人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, one hundred sixty-eight men including Hu Renyu were granted jinshi and other degrees in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day one hundred sixty-eight men including Hu Renyu received the jinshi degree and other ranks in varying grades.

sentences.zh: 以范承勛為左都御史。

translations.literal: Fan Chengxun was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chengxun was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，理籓院奏編審外籓蒙古四十九旗人丁二十二萬六千七百有奇。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengwu: the Court of Colonial Affairs reported the registration and review of the population of the forty-nine outer Mongol banners—two hundred twenty-six thousand seven hundred odd persons.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on gengwu day, the Court of Colonial Affairs reported the registration of the outer Mongol banners: two hundred twenty-six thousand seven hundred and odd persons.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以查木揚為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Zhamuyang was made general at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Zhamuyang was appointed general at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，步軍統領凱音布奏天壇新修之路，勿令行人來往。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: the infantry commander Kaiyinbu memorialized that on the newly repaired road at the Temple of Heaven pedestrians should not be allowed to pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, the infantry commander Kaiyinbu reported that the newly repaired road at the Temple of Heaven should be closed to pedestrians.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「修路以為民也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Roads are built for the people.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Roads are built for the people.

sentences.zh: 若不許行，修之何益。

translations.literal: If passage is forbidden, what is the use of repairing them? If they are damaged later, let the infantry repair them at once.
translations.idiomatic: If they may not be used, what is the point of building them? If they are damaged hereafter, let the infantry repair them at once.

sentences.zh: 後若毀壞，令步兵隨時葺治。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: [Closing quotation mark]

sentences.zh: 」順天學政李光地丁母憂，令在京守制。

translations.literal: Li Guangdi, educational intendant of Shuntian, entered mourning for his mother; he was ordered to observe the mourning period in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangdi, educational intendant of Shuntian, entered mourning for his mother and was ordered to observe it in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命翰林院、詹事府、國子監日輪四員入直南書房。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, four officials a day from the Hanlin Academy, the Household of the Heir Apparent, and the Directorate of Education were ordered to rotate duty in the Southern Library.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day four officials a day from the Hanlin Academy, the Household of the Heir Apparent, and the Directorate of Education were ordered to rotate duty in the Southern Library.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以紀爾他布為滿洲都統，噶爾瑪為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Jiertabu was made Manchu commander-in-chief and Ga'erma Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Jiertabu was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief and Ga'erma Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔修類函。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, an edict ordered the compilation of the classified compendium.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered the compilation of the classified compendium.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上巡幸畿甸，閱視河堤，諭扈從衛士魚貫而行，勿踐田禾。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor toured the capital region, inspected the river dikes, and instructed the escorting guards to march in single file and not trample the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Emperor toured the capital region, inspected the river dikes, and ordered the escort to march in single file and not trample the grain.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上閱龍潭口。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor inspected Longtan Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Emperor inspected Longtan Ford.

sentences.zh: 己未，閱化家口、黃須口、八百戶口、王家甫口、筐兒港口、白駒場口，薄弱之處，咸令增修。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, he inspected Huajia Ford, Huangxu Ford, Babaihu Ford, Wangjiafu Ford, Kuang'er Ford, and Baijuchang Ford; wherever the works were weak, repairs were ordered strengthened.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day he inspected Huajia Ford, Huangxu Ford, Babaihu Ford, Wangjiafu Ford, Kuang'er Ford, and Baijuchang Ford; wherever the works were weak, strengthening was ordered.

sentences.zh: 庚申，閱桃花口、永安口、李家口、信艾口、柳灘口等處新堤。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, he inspected the new dikes at Taohua Ford, Yong'an Ford, Lijia Ford, Xin'ai Ford, Liutan Ford, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he inspected the new dikes at Taohua Ford, Yong'an Ford, Lijia Ford, Xin'ai Ford, Liutan Ford, and other places.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「觀新堤甚屬堅固，百姓可免數年水患矣。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Seeing the new dikes so solid, the people may be spared flood trouble for several years.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "The new dikes are very solid; the people may be spared floods for several years.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，上還京。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day renxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " On renxu day the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 閏五月庚午，上試翰林出身官於豐澤園。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, day gengwu: the Emperor tested Hanlin graduates at the Fengze Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, on gengwu day, the Emperor tested Hanlin graduates at the Fengze Garden.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，加湖廣提督徐治都鎮平將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinchou: Xu Zhidu, provincial military commissioner of Huguang, was given the additional title General Who Pacifies Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinchou day, Xu Zhidu, provincial military commissioner of Huguang, was given the additional title General Who Pacifies Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以范承勛為江南江西總督。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Fan Chengxun was made governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Fan Chengxun was appointed governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，以蔣弘道為左都御史，轉王士禛戶部左侍郎，王掞戶部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingmao: Jiang Hongdao was made Left Censor-in-Chief; Wang Shizhen was transferred to Left Vice Minister of Revenue and Wang Yan to Right Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingmao day, Jiang Hongdao was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief; Wang Shizhen was transferred to Left Vice Minister of Revenue and Wang Yan to Right Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 巴圖爾額爾克濟農奏報降人祁齊克逃遁，遣兵追斬之。

translations.literal: Batur Erkejinong reported that the surrendered man Qiqiike had escaped; troops were sent in pursuit and he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Batur Erkejinong reported that the surrendered man Qiqiike had escaped; troops were sent in pursuit and he was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上求文學之臣。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor sought literary officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor sought men of literary talent.

sentences.zh: 大學士舉徐乾學、王鴻緒、高士奇及韓菼、唐孫華以對。

translations.literal: The Grand Secretaries recommended Xu Qianxue, Wang Hongxu, Gao Shiqi, and also Han Tan and Tang Sunhua.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Secretaries recommended Xu Qianxue, Wang Hongxu, Gao Shiqi, and also Han Tan and Tang Sunhua.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「韓菼非謫降之人，當以原官召補。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Han Tan is not a man demoted for crime; he should be recalled to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Han Tan was not dismissed for crime; he should be recalled to his original post.

sentences.zh: 徐乾學、王鴻緒、高士奇可起用修書。

translations.literal: Xu Qianxue, Wang Hongxu, and Gao Shiqi may be re-employed to compile books.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qianxue, Wang Hongxu, and Gao Shiqi may be re-employed to compile books.

sentences.zh: 並召徐秉義來。

translations.literal: Xu Bingyi is also to be summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Bingyi is also to be summoned.

sentences.zh: 」他日試唐孫華詩佳，授禮部主事、翰林院行走。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On another day Tang Sunhua's poetry in the test was excellent; he was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Rites and a Hanlin attendant.
translations.idiomatic: " On another day Tang Sunhua's test poetry was excellent; he was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Rites and Hanlin attendant.

sentences.zh: 己丑，江南江西總督傅拉塔卒，贈太子太保，予祭葬，諡清端。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Fu Lata, governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi, died; he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted funeral rites, and given the posthumous title Qingduan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Fu Lata, governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi, died; he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted funeral honors, and given the posthumous title Qingduan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Emperor went beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，上駐蹕拜巴哈昂阿。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiwei: the Emperor encamped at Baibaha'ang'a.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei day, the Emperor encamped at Baibaha'ang'a.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀哲布尊丹巴來朝，賜之冠服。

translations.literal: The Khalkha Jebtsundamba came to court; caps and robes were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Khalkha Jebtsundamba came to court and was given caps and robes.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，廣八旗入學學額。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: the school quotas for the Eight Banners were increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi day, the school quotas for the Eight Banners were increased.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以石文炳為漢軍都統，以王繼文為雲南貴州總督。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Shi Wenbing was made Han Banner commander-in-chief and Wang Jiwen governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Shi Wenbing was appointed Han Banner commander-in-chief and Wang Jiwen governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，以吳赫為四川陝西總督。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen: Wu He was made governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on bingshen day, Wu He was appointed governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以金世榮為福州將軍。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Jin Shirong was made general at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Jin Shirong was appointed general at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，溫僖貴妃鈕祜祿氏薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao: the Worthy and Blessed Consort of the Niohuru clan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao day, the Worthy and Blessed Consort of the Niohuru clan died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以張旺為江南提督。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhang Wang was made provincial military commissioner of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Zhang Wang was appointed provincial military commissioner of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，起陳廷敬為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Chen Tingjing was recalled as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Chen Tingjing was recalled as Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，以覺羅席特庫為滿洲都統，杜思噶爾為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu: Imperial Clansman Xitekui was made Manchu commander-in-chief and Dusigar Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengxu day, Imperial Clansman Xitekui was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief and Dusigar Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山東等省十二州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for twelve prefectures and counties in Zhili, Shandong, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees in twelve prefectures and counties across Zhili, Shandong, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十四年乙亥春正月丁亥，以護巴為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Thirty-fourth year, yihai: spring, first month, day dinghai: Hubba was made Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, yihai, spring, first month, on dinghai day, Hubba was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，以郭世隆為浙江福建總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day jihai: Guo Shilong was made governor-general of Zhejiang and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai day, Guo Shilong was appointed governor-general of Zhejiang and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太和殿工成。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Hall of Supreme Harmony was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Hall of Supreme Harmony was completed.

sentences.zh: 休致大學士李之芳卒，予祭葬，諡文襄。

translations.literal: The retired Grand Secretary Li Zhifang died; funeral rites were granted and the posthumous title Wenxiang was given.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Secretary Li Zhifang died; funeral honors were granted and the posthumous title Wenxiang was conferred.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，以石文英為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingxu: Shi Wenying was made Han Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, Shi Wenying was appointed Han Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，平陽府地震。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingyou: Pingyang Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on dingyou day, Pingyang Prefecture was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣使冊立班禪胡土克圖。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, envoys were dispatched to invest the Panchen Erdeni.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day envoys were sent to invest the Panchen Erdeni.

sentences.zh: 己酉，追敘趙良棟平蜀、滇功，授一等子世職。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Zhao Liangdong's achievements in pacifying Shu and Yunnan were posthumously recognized; he was granted the hereditary office of first-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Zhao Liangdong's achievements in pacifying Sichuan and Yunnan were posthumously recognized and he was granted a hereditary first-class viscounty.

sentences.zh: 其部將升賞有差。

translations.literal: His subordinate officers received promotions and rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinate officers received promotions and rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 己未，以李輝祖為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Li Huizu was made governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Li Huizu was appointed governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅朔，遣尚書馬齊察賑地震災民。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon renyin: Minister Ma Qi was dispatched to inspect and relieve earthquake victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renyin new moon, Minister Ma Qi was sent to inspect and relieve earthquake victims.

sentences.zh: 巡撫噶世圖以玩災免。

translations.literal: Governor Gashitu was dismissed for neglecting the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Gashitu was dismissed for neglecting the disaster.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命在京八旗分地各造屋二千間住兵。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Eight Banners in the capital were each allotted land to build two thousand houses to quarter troops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day each of the Eight Banners in the capital was allotted land to build two thousand houses to quarter troops.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上巡幸畿甸，閱新堤及海口運道，建海神廟。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor toured the capital region, inspected the new dikes and the seaport transport route, and built a temple to the Sea God.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor toured the capital region, inspected the new dikes and the seaport transport route, and built a temple to the Sea God.

sentences.zh: 戊子，還京。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，策封皇太子胤礽妃石氏。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingyou: conferred investiture on Crown Prince Yinreng's consort, Lady Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou day, investiture was conferred on Crown Prince Yinreng's consort, Lady Shi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以久雨詔廷臣陳得失，禮部祈晴。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, because of prolonged rain an edict ordered court ministers to state gains and losses; the Ministry of Rites prayed for clear weather.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, because rain had lasted so long, the Emperor ordered court ministers to speak frankly of what had gone right or wrong, and the Ministry of Rites offered prayers for fair weather.

sentences.zh: 庚申，漕運總督王樑奏參衛千總楊奉漕船裝帶貨物。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Grain Transport Director-General Wang Liang memorialized accusing Guard company commander Yang Feng of loading commercial goods on grain-transport boats.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Grain Transport Director-General Wang Liang impeached Guard company commander Yang Feng for loading private merchandise on grain-transport vessels.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「商人裝帶貨物，於運何妨。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Merchants loading goods—what harm to transport?
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "When merchants load goods aboard, what injury does that do to transport?

sentences.zh: 王樑乃將貨物搜出棄置兩岸，所行甚暴，即解任。

translations.literal: Wang Liang searched out the goods and cast them ashore on both banks—conduct far too violent; he was dismissed at once.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Liang had the goods seized and dumped on both banks—conduct outrageously harsh—and was removed from office on the spot.

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，以覺羅舒恕為寧夏將軍，鄂羅順為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jichou: Aisin Gioro Shushu was made Ningxia regional commander and Eluoshun Jiangning regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on jichou day, Aisin Gioro Shushu was appointed regional commander at Ningxia and Eluoshun regional commander at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 趙良棟告赴江南就醫，命給與南巡舊船。

translations.literal: Zhao Liangdong reported going to Jiangnan for medical treatment; he was ordered given the old boats used on the southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Liangdong asked leave to seek treatment in Jiangnan and was granted the boats that had served on the southern tour.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renchen: the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen day, the Emperor went on tour beyond the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，博濟奏報噶爾丹屬下回子五百人闌入三岔河汛界，肅州總兵官潘育龍盡俘之，拘於肅州。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Boji reported that five hundred Hui followers of Galdan had crossed into the San Cha He garrison sector; Suzhou regional commander Pan Yulong took them all captive and detained them at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Boji reported that five hundred Muslim subjects of Galdan had crossed the San Cha He garrison line; Suzhou regional commander Pan Yulong captured them all and held them at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，次克勒和洛。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, halted at Ke'le Heluo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the imperial train stopped at Ke'le Heluo.

sentences.zh: 命宗室公蘇努、都統阿席坦、護巴領兵備噶爾丹。

translations.literal: Ordered Princes of the Blood Su-nu, commander-in-chief A-shi-tan, and Hu-ba to lead troops against Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of the Blood Su-nu, commander-in-chief A-shi-tan, and Hu-ba were ordered to take the field against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，次克勒烏理雅蘇台。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, halted at Ke'le Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the train halted at Ke'le Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 調董安國為河道總督，桑額為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Dong Anguo was transferred to Grand Director of Rivers and Channels; Sange was made Grain Transport Director-General.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Anguo was transferred to grand director of rivers and channels, and Sange was appointed grain transport director-general.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，上還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔順天、保定、河間、永平四府水潦傷稼，免明年地丁錢糧，仍運米四萬石前往平糶。

translations.literal: On day guimao, an edict said that in Shuntian, Baoding, Hejian, and Yongping—four prefectures where floods had damaged the crops—next year's land and poll taxes were remitted, and forty thousand shi of grain were still transported for sale at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict declared that Shuntian, Baoding, Hejian, and Yongping, where floods had ruined the harvest, were exempt from next year's land and poll taxes, while forty thousand shi of grain were sent for relief sale at fair price.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，命內大臣索額圖、明珠視察噶爾丹。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingwei: ordered Inner Ministers Songgotu and Mingzhu to reconnoiter Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on dingwei day, Inner Ministers Songgotu and Mingzhu were sent to inspect Galdan's movements.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day jiwei: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, the jiwei day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命大軍分三路備噶爾丹，裹八十日糧，其駝馬米糧，令侍郎陳汝器、前左都御史于成龍分督之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the main army was ordered divided into three routes against Galdan, each carrying eighty days' provisions; camels, horses, and grain were placed under the joint supervision of Vice-Minister Chen Ruqi and former Left Censor-in-Chief Yu Chenglong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the main force was split into three columns to meet Galdan, each column carrying eighty days' rations, while Vice-Minister Chen Ruqi and former Left Censor-in-Chief Yu Chenglong were assigned to supervise camels, horses, and grain.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，停今年秋決。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, this year's autumn executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the autumn executions for the year were stayed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命李天馥復為大學士。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Li Tianfu was reappointed Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Li Tianfu was restored to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上大閱於南苑。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor held a grand review at the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor conducted a grand military review at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命安北將軍伯費揚古為撫遠大將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, General Who Pacifies the North Bo Feiyanggu was made Pacification-General of the Far Campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Bo Feiyanggu, general who pacifies the north, was appointed pacification-general of the far campaign.

sentences.zh: 遣大臣如蒙古徵師，示師期。

translations.literal: Ministers were dispatched to Mongolia to levy troops and announce the campaign date.
