translations.idiomatic: Ministers were sent into Mongolia to raise troops and proclaim the day of mobilization.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，命將軍博濟、孫思克師出鎮彝。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai: ordered generals Boji and Sun Sike to march out by Zhenyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai day, Generals Boji and Sun Sike were ordered to take the field through Zhenyi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，平陽地震，命蠲本年糧額，並免山西、陝西、江南、浙江、江西、湖廣、廣東、福建等省逋賦，赦殊死以下，其政令有不便於民者，令督撫以聞。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Pingyang suffered an earthquake; this year's grain quota was remitted, tax arrears were exempted in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, Guangdong, Fujian, and other provinces, an amnesty was granted for all below capital crimes, and governors were told to report policies inconvenient to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an earthquake struck Pingyang; the year's grain levy was remitted, arrears were forgiven in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, Guangdong, Fujian, and elsewhere, all crimes short of death were pardoned, and governors were instructed to report any measure that burdened the people.

sentences.zh: 以齊世為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Qi Shi was made Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shi was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山西、江西、福建、廣東等省十二州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year disaster levies were remitted in varying amounts for twelve prefectures and counties in Zhili, Shanxi, Jiangxi, Fujian, Guangdong, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for twelve prefectures and counties in Zhili, Shanxi, Jiangxi, Fujian, Guangdong, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 三十五年丙子春正月甲午，下詔親征噶爾丹。

translations.literal: Thirty-fifth year, bingzi; spring, first month, day jiawu: an edict announced that the Emperor would lead the campaign in person against Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year, bingzi, on jiawu of the first spring month, an edict proclaimed that the Emperor would take the field in person against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 賚隨征大臣軍校宴。

translations.literal: Feasts were bestowed on the ministers and officers accompanying the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Banquets were granted to the ministers and officers who would join the expedition.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命公彭春參贊西路軍務。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Duke Pengchun was ordered to assist in western-route military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Duke Pengchun was assigned to assist in the western army's operations.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥朔，上謁陵。

translations.literal: Second month, first day dinghai: the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the second month the Emperor performed rites at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以碩鼐為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Shuonai was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Shuonai was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，告祭郊廟社稷。

translations.literal: On day guichou, sacrifices were announced at the suburban altars, the state temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the court announced sacrifices at the suburban altars, the dynastic temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命皇太子胤礽留守。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Crown Prince Yinreng was ordered to remain and guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Crown Prince Yinreng was left in Beijing to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上親統六師啟行。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor personally led the Six Armies and set out.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Emperor took command of the Six Armies in person and marched.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，上出行宮觀射。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen: at the traveling palace the Emperor watched archery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen day, the Emperor watched archery at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，次滾諾，大雨雪，上露立，俟軍士結營畢，乃入行幄。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, halted at Gunnuo; heavy rain and snow fell—the Emperor stood in the open until the soldiers had finished pitching camp, then entered his tent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the train stopped at Gunnuo in driving rain and snow; the Emperor remained standing in the open until the troops had finished raising camp, and only then entered his tent.

sentences.zh: 軍中畢炊，乃進膳。

translations.literal: Only after the army had finished cooking did he take his meal.
translations.idiomatic: He would not eat until the whole army had cooked its food.

sentences.zh: 以行帳糧薪留待後至者。

translations.literal: Campaign grain and fuel from the traveling stores were held back for those arriving later.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and firewood from the imperial train were reserved for men still on the road.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，予故巡撫王維珍祭葬，諡敏愨。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the late governor Wang Weizhen was granted funeral rites and the posthumous title Minqi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the late governor Wang Weizhen was granted funeral honors and the posthumous name Minqi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，上次格德爾庫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinmao: halted at Ged'erku.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinmao day, the train halted at Ged'erku.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上駐塔爾奇拉。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor encamped at Tarqila.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Emperor encamped at Tarqila.

sentences.zh: 諭：「茲已抵邊界，自明日始，均列環營。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Having reached the frontier, from tomorrow all shall form circular camps.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ran: "We have reached the border; from tomorrow every unit is to pitch in a ring camp.

sentences.zh: 」前哨報噶爾丹在克魯倫，命蒙古兵先進據河。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] The vanguard reported Galdan at the Kerulen; Mongol troops were ordered to advance first and hold the river.
translations.idiomatic: The vanguard reported that Galdan was on the Kerulen, and Mongol detachments were sent ahead to seize the river first.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，上駐蹕拖陵布拉克。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day bingchen: the Emperor encamped at Tuoling Bulake.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month the Emperor encamped at Tuoling Bulake.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，次枯庫車爾。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, halted at Kukuche'er.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the train stopped at Kukuche'er.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，偵知噶爾丹所在，上率前鋒先發，諸軍張兩翼而進。

translations.literal: On day renxu, scouts located Galdan; the Emperor led the vanguard out first while the other columns advanced with both wings spread.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day scouts found Galdan's position; the Emperor moved first with the vanguard while the main columns advanced with both wings extended.

sentences.zh: 至燕圖庫列圖駐營。

translations.literal: Camp was pitched at Yantu Kulietu.
translations.idiomatic: The army encamped at Yantu Kulietu.

sentences.zh: 其地素乏水，至是山泉湧出，上親臨視。

translations.literal: The place had always lacked water; now a mountain spring gushed forth—the Emperor went in person to see it.
translations.idiomatic: The ground had always been dry, but now a spring burst from the hills, and the Emperor went to look at it himself.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，次克魯倫河。

translations.literal: On day guihai, halted at the Kerulen River.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the train halted on the Kerulen River.

sentences.zh: 上顧大臣曰：「噶爾丹不知據河拒戰，是無能為矣。

translations.literal: The Emperor turned to the ministers and said: "Galdan does not know enough to hold the river and fight—he can do nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said to his ministers: "Galdan does not even know to defend the river—he is finished.

sentences.zh: 」前哨中書阿必達探報噶爾丹不信六師猝至，登孟納爾山，望見黃幄網城，大兵雲屯，漫無涯際，大驚曰：「何來之易耶！

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] Vanguard secretary A-bi-da reported that Galdan had not believed the main army could arrive so suddenly; he climbed Mount Mengna'er, saw the yellow canopy and networked camp, troops dense as clouds without limit, and cried in alarm: "How could they come so easily!
translations.idiomatic: Vanguard secretary A-bi-da reported that Galdan had refused to believe the main army could appear so soon; climbing Mount Mengna'er he saw the yellow canopy and the netted encampment, troops massed like clouds without end, and exclaimed in terror: "How could they come so easily!

sentences.zh: 」棄其廬帳宵遁。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] He abandoned his dwellings and fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: He abandoned his tents and fled in the night.

sentences.zh: 驗其馬矢，似遁二日矣。

translations.literal: Inspecting horse droppings, he seemed already to have been fleeing two days.
translations.idiomatic: From the horse droppings it appeared he had been running for two days.

sentences.zh: 上率輕騎追之。

translations.literal: The Emperor led light cavalry in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor himself led the light horse in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 沿途什物、駝馬、婦孺委棄甚眾。

translations.literal: Along the way goods, camels, horses, women, and children were abandoned in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The road was strewn with goods, camels, horses, women, and children left behind in vast numbers.

sentences.zh: 上顧謂科爾沁王沙津曰：「虜何倉皇至是？

translations.literal: The Emperor turned and said to the Khorchin prince Shajin: "Why is the enemy in such panic?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor asked the Khorchin prince Shajin: "Why is the foe in such headlong flight?

sentences.zh: 」沙津曰：「為逃生耳。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] Shajin said: "To save his life, nothing more.
translations.idiomatic: Shajin answered: "Only to save his life.

sentences.zh: 」喀爾喀王納木扎爾曰：「臣等當日逃難，即是如此。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] Khalkha Prince Namuzha'er said: "When we fled in distress, it was just like this.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha Prince Namuzha'er said: "When we fled for our lives, it looked just like this.

sentences.zh: 」上上書皇太后，備陳軍況，並約期回京。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] The Emperor wrote the empress dowager, detailing the army's situation and setting a date for return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote to the empress dowager with a full account of the campaign and a fixed day for his return to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 追至拖納阿林而還，令內大臣馬思喀追之。

translations.literal: He pursued as far as Tuona Alin and turned back; Inner Minister Ma Sika was ordered to continue the pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: He chased the enemy to Tuona Alin and then withdrew, leaving Inner Minister Ma Sika to press the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上班師。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the army began its return march.

sentences.zh: 是日晨，五色雲見。

translations.literal: That morning five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day five-colored clouds were seen.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，次中拖陵。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, halted at Zhongtuoling.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the train halted at Zhongtuoling.

sentences.zh: 撫遠大將軍伯費揚古大敗噶爾丹於昭莫多，斬級三千，陣斬其妻阿奴。

translations.literal: Pacification-General Bo Feiyanggu inflicted a great defeat on Galdan at Jao Modo, beheading three thousand; Galdan's wife Anu was killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification-General Bo Feiyanggu routed Galdan at Jao Modo, taking three thousand heads, and Galdan's wife Anu was slain on the field.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹以數騎遁。

translations.literal: Galdan escaped with a few horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan fled with only a handful of riders.

sentences.zh: 癸未，次察罕諾爾。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, halted at Chaghan Nur.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the train stopped at Chaghan Nur.

sentences.zh: 召見蒙古諸王，獎以修道鑿井監牧之勞，各賜其人白金。

translations.literal: Mongol princes were summoned, rewarded for labor in building roads, digging wells, and tending herds, and each was granted silver for his people.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol princes were called in, praised for building roads, sinking wells, and guarding herds, and each received silver for his followers.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，上還京。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guisi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 是役也，中路上自將，走噶爾丹，西路費揚古大敗噶爾丹，唯東路薩布素以道遠後期無功。

translations.literal: In this campaign the central route was led by the Emperor in person and drove Galdan off; on the western route Feiyanggu crushed Galdan; only on the eastern route did Sabsu, distant and late, achieve nothing.
translations.idiomatic: In that campaign the central column, which the Emperor commanded himself, put Galdan to flight; on the west Feiyanggu shattered him; only Sabsu on the east, far away and behind schedule, won no success.

sentences.zh: 甲午，論喀爾喀郡王善巴盡以馬匹借軍功，晉封親王，貝子盆楚克偵敵有勞，封為郡王。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Khalkha Prince Shanba, who had lent all his horses to the army, was promoted to Prince of the First Rank; beise Pencechu, who had scouted with merit, was created Prince of the Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Khalkha Prince Shanba, who had lent every horse he owned to the army, was raised to prince of the first rank, and beise Pencechu, who had spied on the enemy with distinction, was created prince of the second rank.

sentences.zh: 諸臣行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: The ministers performed congratulatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: The court ministers offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜察哈爾護軍月饟加一金，喀爾喀人六金，限給三年。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Chahar guards were granted an extra tael in monthly pay, Khalkha six taels each, for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Chahar guards received one extra tael in monthly rations and Khalkha six taels apiece, for three years.

sentences.zh: 詔停本年秋審。

translations.literal: An edict suspended this year's autumn judicial review.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stayed the autumn judicial review for the year.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以吳琠為左都御史，調張旺為福建水師提督，張雲翼為江南提督。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Wu Yan was made Left Censor-in-Chief; Zhang Wang was transferred to Fujian naval commander and Zhang Yunyi to Jiangnan commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Wu Yan became left censor-in-chief; Zhang Wang was transferred to Fujian naval commander and Zhang Yunyi to Jiangnan commander.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，以平定朔漠勒石太學。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuwu: a stele was erected at the Imperial Academy commemorating the pacification of the northern deserts.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuwu day, a commemorative stele for the pacification of the northern deserts was set up at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 以李輝祖為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Li Huizu was made Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huizu was appointed governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，廣直省鄉試解額。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the provincial examination quotas in the metropolitan provinces were expanded.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the quota of provincial graduates in the metropolitan provinces was increased.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，改吳英福建陸路提督，岳升龍為四川提督。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Wu Ying was changed to Fujian land-route commander and Yue Shenglong to Sichuan commander.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Wu Ying was reassigned as Fujian land-route commander and Yue Shenglong as Sichuan commander.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，索諾和以乏軍需免，以凱音布為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingyou: Suonuhei was dismissed for shortage of military supplies; Kairinbu was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, Suonuhei was removed for failing to supply the army, and Kairinbu was made minister of war.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅朔，回回國王阿卜都里什克奏：「臣仗天威，得以出降。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day jiayin: the Hui king Abdurishike memorialized: "Relying on Heaven's majesty, I was able to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the ninth month the Muslim king Abdurishike memorialized: "By Heaven's majesty I was able to submit.

sentences.zh: 遣臣回國葉爾欽，請敕策旺阿拉布坦勿加虐害。

translations.literal: I was sent back to my country Yarkand; I beg an edict that Tsewang Arabtan not maltreat us.
translations.idiomatic: I have been sent back to Yarkand and beg an edict that Tsewang Arabtan do us no harm.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，賜厄魯特降人官秩衣糧。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day yimao, Oirat submitters were granted ranks, clothing, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Oirat who had surrendered were given office, clothing, and rations.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor again went beyond the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，次沙城。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, halted at Shacheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the train stopped at Shacheng.

sentences.zh: 詔：「年來宣化所屬牧養軍馬，供億甚繁，深勞民力，其悉蠲明年額賦。

translations.literal: An edict said: "In recent years raising army horses in Xuande jurisdiction has imposed heavy burdens on the people—all next year's quota levies are remitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "For years the horse pastures under Xuande have pressed hard on the people; all quota taxes for next year are hereby remitted.

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，副都統祖良璧敗噶爾丹部人丹濟拉於翁金。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day dingchou, Vice commander-in-chief Zu Liangbi defeated Galdan's follower Danjila at Wengjin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Vice commander-in-chief Zu Liangbi defeated Danjila, a leader under Galdan, at Wengjin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申朔，遣官齎賜西路軍士衣裘牛羊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day jiashen: officials were dispatched bearing furs, sheep, and cattle as gifts for soldiers on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of winter's tenth month officials were sent with furs, sheep, and cattle for the western army.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，次昭哈。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, halted at Zhaoha.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the train halted at Zhaoha.

sentences.zh: 賜右衛、大同陣亡軍士白金。

translations.literal: Silver was granted to soldiers of the Right Guard and Datong who had died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Silver was bestowed on the families of soldiers of the Right Guard and Datong who had fallen in battle.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大將軍費揚古獻俘至。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Grand General Feiyanggu presented captives.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Grand General Feiyanggu arrived with prisoners.

sentences.zh: 賜銀贖出，令其完聚。

translations.literal: Silver was granted to redeem them and restore their households.
translations.idiomatic: Silver was given to ransom them and let them rejoin their families.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上臨視右衛軍士，賜食。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor inspected Right Guard soldiers in person and granted food.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Emperor reviewed the Right Guard troops in person and gave them a feast.

sentences.zh: 傳諭曰：「昭莫多之役，爾等乏糧步行而能禦敵，故特賜食。

translations.literal: A transmission edict said: "At Jao Modo you lacked grain, marched on foot, yet could fight the enemy—hence this special grant of food.
translations.idiomatic: An order was passed down: "At Jao Modo you had little grain, marched on foot, and still held the enemy—therefore this special meal.

sentences.zh: 悉免所借庫銀。

translations.literal: All borrowed treasury silver is remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Every debt of silver owed the treasury is forgiven.

sentences.zh: 其傷病之人，另頒賜之。

translations.literal: The wounded and sick shall receive separate grants.
translations.idiomatic: The wounded and sick will receive additional gifts.

sentences.zh: 」眾叩首歡謝。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] All kowtowed in joyous thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The men kowtowed and thanked him with shouts of joy.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上駐蹕麗蘇。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor halted at Lisu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Emperor halted at Lisu.

sentences.zh: 上皇太后書，謝賜裘服。

translations.literal: He wrote to the Empress Dowager thanking her for the gift of fur garments.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote to the Empress Dowager to thank her for the gift of fur robes.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，噶爾丹遣使乞降，其使格壘沽英至，蓋微探上旨也。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: Galdan sent envoys suing for surrender; his envoy Gelü Guyin arrived—likely probing the Emperor's intent in small ways.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin day, Galdan sent envoys to sue for surrender; his envoy Gelü Guyin arrived, likely probing the Emperor's intentions.

sentences.zh: 上告之曰：「俟爾七十日，過此即進兵矣。

translations.literal: The Emperor told him: "Wait seventy days for you; after that I shall advance the army."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told him, "I shall give you seventy days; after that I advance the army."

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，迴鑾。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day gengchen, the imperial procession returned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the imperial procession returned.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，上還京。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renyin day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 以宗室費揚固為右衛，祁布為滿洲都統，雷繼尊為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: The princely clansman Fei Yanggu was made commander of the Right Guard; Qi Bu Manchu commandant-general; Lei Jizun Han Army commandant-general.
translations.idiomatic: The princely clansman Fei Yanggu was appointed commander of the Right Guard; Qi Bu was made Manchu commandant-general; and Lei Jizun Han Army commandant-general.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔：「陝、甘沿邊州縣衛所，當師行孔道，供億繁多，閭閻勞苦，其明年地丁銀米悉行蠲免。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, an edict said: "Along the Shaanxi and Gansu frontiers, prefectures, counties, and guard posts lie on the army's main routes and have borne heavy requisitions—the people are worn out. Next year's land-and-poll silver and grain shall all be remitted."
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict said, "Prefectures, counties, and guard posts along the Shaanxi and Gansu frontiers lie on the army's main routes and have borne heavy requisitions, to the people's exhaustion. Next year's land and poll taxes in silver and grain are all remitted."

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、江西等省三十二州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster levies were remitted in varying degree for thirty-two prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster levies were remitted in varying degrees for thirty-two prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十六年丁丑春正月丙辰，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: Year thirty-six, dingchou; first month of spring, day bingchen: the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, dingchou cycle, on bingchen day in the first spring month, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunt.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，哈密回部擒噶爾丹之子塞卜騰巴爾珠爾來獻。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Hami Muslims captured Galdan's son Sebeten Balzhur and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Muslim community of Hami captured Galdan's son Sebeten Balzhur and sent him in.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣官存問勇略將軍趙良棟，賜人葠鹿尾。

translations.literal: On day jisi, officials were sent to inquire after Brave Strategist General Zhao Liangdong and grant him ginseng and deer tails.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day officials were sent to inquire after Brave Strategist General Zhao Liangdong and to grant him ginseng and deer tails.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，諭：「朕觀明史，一代並無女後預政，以臣陵君之事。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, an instruction said: "Reading the History of Ming, that dynasty throughout had no empresses interfering in government, nor subjects browbeating their sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an instruction said, "Reading the History of Ming, I find that dynasty had no empresses wielding government and no ministers bullying their sovereign.

sentences.zh: 我朝事例，因之者多。

translations.literal: In our court precedents, many have followed along these lines.
translations.idiomatic: Our own court has many precedents along these lines.

sentences.zh: 朕不似前人輒譏亡國也。

translations.literal: I am not like earlier writers who hastily revile a state as doomed.
translations.idiomatic: I am not like earlier writers who hastily denounce such arrangements as signs of a doomed state.

sentences.zh: 現修明史，其以此諭增入敕書。

translations.literal: As the Ming History is now being compiled, let this instruction be added to the imperial commission."
translations.idiomatic: As the Ming History is now being compiled, add this instruction to the imperial commission."

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: The instruction closed.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，上親征噶爾丹，啟鑾。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: the Emperor personally campaigned against Galdan and set out.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai day, the Emperor personally took the field against Galdan and set out.

sentences.zh: 是日，次昌平。

translations.literal: That day he halted at Changping.
translations.idiomatic: That day he stopped at Changping.

sentences.zh: 阿必達奏哈密擒獲厄魯特人土克齊哈什哈，系害使臣馬迪之首犯。

translations.literal: A Bida reported that Hami had captured the Eleuth Tukchi Hashiha, chief culprit in killing the envoy Ma Di.
translations.idiomatic: A Bida reported that Hami had seized the Eleuth Tukchi Hashiha, the chief culprit in the murder of envoy Ma Di.

sentences.zh: 命誅之，子女付馬迪之家為奴。

translations.literal: He was ordered executed; his children were given to Ma Di's family as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered executed, and his children were given to Ma Di's family as slaves.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上駐大同。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor halted at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor halted at Datong.

sentences.zh: 丁未，次李家溝。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, he halted at Lijia Gou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he stopped at Lijia Gou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔免師行所過岢嵐、保德、河曲等州縣今年額賦。

translations.literal: On day wushen, an edict remitted this year's quota levies for Kelan, Baode, Hequ, and other counties on the army's route.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day an edict remitted this year's quota levies for Kelan, Baode, Hequ, and other counties along the army's march.

sentences.zh: 是日，次輦鄢村，山泉下涌，人馬霑足。

translations.literal: That day he halted at Nianyan village; mountain springs welled up below and men and horses waded ankle-deep.
translations.idiomatic: That day he stopped at Nianyan village, where mountain springs burst forth and men and horses waded ankle-deep.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣官祭黃河之神。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, officials were sent to sacrifice to the God of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day officials were sent to sacrifice to the God of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，上駐蹕屈野河。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: the Emperor halted at Quye River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingchen day, the Emperor halted at Quye River.

sentences.zh: 厄魯特人多爾濟、達拉什等先後來降。

translations.literal: Eleuths including Duo'erji, Dalashi, and others surrendered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Eleuths including Duo'erji, Dalashi, and others surrendered one after another.

sentences.zh: 賜哈密回王金幣冠服。

translations.literal: The Muslim King of Hami was granted gold, coins, robes, and caps.
translations.idiomatic: The Muslim king of Hami was granted gold, coins, robes, and caps.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，趙良棟卒，上聞之，嗟悼良久，語近臣曰：「趙良棟，偉男子也。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Zhao Liangdong died; when the Emperor heard, he sighed in mourning a long while and told close officials: "Zhao Liangdong was a great man."
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Zhao Liangdong died; when the Emperor heard, he mourned at length and told close officials, "Zhao Liangdong was a great man."

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，次榆林。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day xinyou, he halted at Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day he halted at Yulin.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，次安邊城。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, he halted at Anbian Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day he stopped at Anbian Cheng.

sentences.zh: 寧夏總兵王化行請上獵於花馬池。

translations.literal: Ningxia regional commander Wang Huaxing asked the Emperor to hunt at Huama Chi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huaxing, regional commander at Ningxia, asked the Emperor to hunt at Huama Chi.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「何如休養馬力以獵噶爾丹乎？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Would it not be better to rest the horses' strength for hunting Galdan?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Would it not be better to spare the horses' strength for hunting Galdan?"

sentences.zh: 」辛未，次花馬池。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day xinwei, he halted at Huama Chi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day he halted at Huama Chi.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上自橫城渡河。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor crossed the river from Hengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Emperor crossed the river from Hengcheng.

sentences.zh: 遣皇長子胤禔賜奠趙良棟及前提督陳福。

translations.literal: The eldest imperial son Yinreng was sent to offer sacrifices for Zhao Liangdong and former provincial commander Chen Fu.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest imperial son Yinreng was sent to offer sacrifices for Zhao Liangdong and the former provincial commander Chen Fu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上駐蹕寧夏。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor halted at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Emperor halted at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 察恤昭莫多、翁金陣亡弁兵。

translations.literal: He investigated and relieved the dependents of officers and soldiers killed at Zhaomoduo and Wengjin.
translations.idiomatic: He investigated and granted relief to the dependents of officers and soldiers killed at Zhaomoduo and Wengjin.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祭賀蘭山。

translations.literal: On day jimao, he sacrificed at Helan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he sacrificed at Helan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上閱兵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor reviewed troops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor reviewed the troops.

sentences.zh: 命侍衛以御用食物均賜戰士。

translations.literal: He ordered the guards to distribute imperial food equally among the warriors.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the guards to share imperial food equally among the warriors.

sentences.zh: 閏三月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, first day xinsi: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the first day of the intercalary third month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，康親王傑書薨。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Prince Kang Jieshu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Kang Jieshu died.

sentences.zh: 寧夏百姓聞上將行，懇留數日。

translations.literal: Ningxia commoners, hearing the Emperor was leaving, begged him to stay several days.
translations.idiomatic: When the people of Ningxia heard the Emperor was leaving, they begged him to stay a few days longer.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「邊地磽瘠，多留一日，即多一日之擾。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The borderland is barren and poor—each extra day I stay is another day of hardship for you."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This border country is barren and poor; each extra day I remain is another day of hardship for you."

sentences.zh: 爾等誠意，已知之矣。

translations.literal: Your sincere goodwill—I have taken note of it."
translations.idiomatic: Your sincere goodwill—I have noted it."

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: The reply closed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，上次狼居胥山。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinhai: the Emperor ascended Langjuxu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinhai day, the Emperor ascended Langjuxu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the imperial procession returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the imperial procession returned.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命直省選文行兼優之士為拔貢生，送國子監。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, he ordered each province to select scholars outstanding in both conduct and letters as tribute students and send them to the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he ordered each province to select scholars outstanding in conduct and letters as tribute students and send them to the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 甲子，費揚古疏報閏三月十三日噶爾丹仰藥死，其女鍾齊海率三百戶來降。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Fei Yanggu memorialized that on the thirteenth of the intercalary third month Galdan died by poison; his daughter Zhongqihai led three hundred households to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Fei Yanggu reported that on the thirteenth of the intercalary third month Galdan had taken poison and died, and that his daughter Zhongqihai had led three hundred households to surrender.

sentences.zh: 上率百官行拜天禮。

translations.literal: The Emperor led all officials in performing the ceremony of worshipping Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor led all officials in performing the ceremony of worshipping Heaven.

sentences.zh: 敕諸路班師。

translations.literal: He ordered all routes to withdraw troops.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered every route army to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 是日，大雨。

translations.literal: That day there was heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: That day there was heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 厄魯特降人請慶賀。

translations.literal: Surrendered Eleuths asked to celebrate.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered Eleuths asked permission to celebrate.

sentences.zh: 止之。

translations.literal: He forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: He forbade it.

sentences.zh: 先是，上將探視寧夏黃河，由橫城乘舟行，至湖灘河朔，登陸步行，率侍衛行獵，打魚射水鴨為糧，至包頭鎮會車騎。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor intended to inspect the Ningxia Yellow River, he went by boat from Hengcheng to Hutian Heshuo, disembarked to walk on foot, led guards hunting, caught fish and shot waterfowl for provisions, and met his carriage escort at Baotou town.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Emperor went to inspect the Ningxia Yellow River, he traveled by boat from Hengcheng to Hutian Heshuo, went ashore on foot, led his guards hunting, took fish and shot waterfowl for food, and rejoined his carriages and cavalry at Baotou town.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，上還京。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiwei day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以傅拉塔為刑部尚書，席爾達左都御史，翁叔元罷，以吳琠為刑部尚書，張鵬翮左都御史。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Fu Lata was made Minister of Punishments, Xierda Left Censor-in-chief; Weng Shuyuan was dismissed; Wu Yan made Minister of Punishments, Zhang Penghe Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Fu Lata was appointed Minister of Punishments and Xierda Left Censor-in-chief; Weng Shuyuan was dismissed; Wu Yan was made Minister of Punishments and Zhang Penghe Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，禮部請上尊號。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Ministry of Rites petitioned to bestow an honorific title on the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Ministry of Rites petitioned to bestow an honorific title on the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: He did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，禮部請於師行所過名山磨崖紀功。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiayin: the Ministry of Rites asked to inscribe achievements on cliff faces at famous mountains along the campaign route.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiayin day, the Ministry of Rites asked to carve records of merit on cliffs at famous mountains along the campaign route.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 予故勇略將軍一等子趙良棟祭葬，諡襄忠。

translations.literal: Posthumous sacrifices and burial were granted to the late Brave Strategist General, First-class Baron Zhao Liangdong, with the posthumous name Xiangzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous sacrifices and burial were granted to the late Brave Strategist General, First-class Baron Zhao Liangdong, with the posthumous name Xiangzhong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，群臣請上皇太后徽號，三上，不允。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiwei: the ministers thrice petitioned to give the Empress Dowager an honorific title—all refused.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on guiwei day, the ministers thrice petitioned to bestow an honorific title on the Empress Dowager; each time he refused.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以朔漠平定，遣官祭告郊廟、陵寢、先師。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, because the northern deserts were pacified, officials were sent to announce at the suburban altars, temples, mausolea, and the Sage's shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, because the northern deserts had been pacified, officials were sent to report at the suburban altars, state temples, imperial tombs, and the shrine of the Sage.

sentences.zh: 賜李蟠等一百五十人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: One hundred fifty men including Li Pan were granted varying ranks as jinshi graduates.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred fifty men including Li Pan were granted jinshi degrees and appointments in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 晉封大將軍伯費揚古一等公，參贊以下各授世職。

translations.literal: Grand General Duke Fei Yanggu was promoted to first-class duke; staff from camp director downward received hereditary offices.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Duke Fei Yanggu was promoted to first-class duke, and officers from camp director downward were granted hereditary posts.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免旗兵借帑。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, banner soldiers' loans from the treasury were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day treasury loans owed by banner soldiers were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣官賚外籓四十九旗兵。

translations.literal: On day yisi, officials were sent to distribute rewards among the troops of the outer forty-nine banners.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day officials were sent to distribute rewards among the troops of the outer forty-nine banners.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Emperor toured beyond the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，上駐巴圖舍里，賜蒙古王、公、台吉銀幣。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai: the Emperor halted at Batu Sheri and granted silver and coins to Mongol princes, dukes, and taiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yihai day, the Emperor halted at Batu Sheri and granted silver and coins to Mongol princes, dukes, and taiji.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，厄魯特丹濟拉來歸。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiwei: the Eleuth Danjila came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei day, the Eleuth Danjila came to submit.

sentences.zh: 上獨御氈幄召見之。

translations.literal: The Emperor alone received him in a felt tent.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor received him alone in a felt tent.

sentences.zh: 丹濟拉出語人曰：「我罪人也，上乃不疑，真神人也。

translations.literal: Leaving, Danjila said to others: "I am a guilty man, yet the Emperor did not distrust me—truly a divine man."
translations.idiomatic: As he left, Danjila said to others, "I am a guilty man, yet the Emperor did not distrust me—truly a divine man."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，上還京。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day jiawu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以都統凱音布兼步軍統領。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, commandant-general Kayinbu was also made commander of the Metropolitan Foot Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day commandant-general Kayinbu was also appointed commander of the Metropolitan Foot Banner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，振平將軍、湖廣提督徐治都卒，贈太子少保，予祭葬，諡襄毅。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Pacification General and Huguang provincial commander Xu Zhidu died; posthumously made Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, granted sacrifices and burial, posthumous name Xiangyi.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Pacification General and Huguang provincial commander Xu Zhidu died; he was posthumously made Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, granted sacrifices and burial, and given the posthumous name Xiangyi.

sentences.zh: 賑黑龍江被水居民。

translations.literal: Relief was given to flood victims in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was granted to flood victims in Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 以席爾達為兵部尚書，哈雅爾為左都御史。

translations.literal: Xierda was made Minister of War; Hayar Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Xierda was appointed Minister of War and Hayar Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳，始令宗室應鄉、會試。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jisi: for the first time princes of the blood were allowed to take provincial and metropolitan examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jisi day, princes of the blood were for the first time allowed to sit for the provincial and metropolitan examinations.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔曰：「比年師行出入，皆經山西地方，有行齎居送之勞。

translations.literal: On day renxu, an edict said: "In recent years campaigns entering and leaving have all passed through Shanxi, whose people have borne the labor of supplying traveling troops."
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict said, "In recent years armies marching out and returning have all passed through Shanxi, whose people have borne the labor of supplying troops on the march."

sentences.zh: 其免山西明年額賦。

translations.literal: Next year's quota levies for Shanxi are remitted."
translations.idiomatic: Next year's quota levies for Shanxi are remitted."

sentences.zh: 」敘從征鎮國公蘇努功，晉封貝子。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] The service of Prince of the State Su Nu on campaign was recorded; he was promoted to beizi.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign service of Prince of the State Su Nu was recorded, and he was promoted to beizi.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，內監劉進朝以訛詐人論死。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, eunuch Liu Jinchao was sentenced to death for extortion and fraud.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the eunuch Liu Jinchao was sentenced to death for extortion and fraud.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，上還京。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinsi day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，和碩恪靖公主下嫁喀爾喀郡王敦多布多爾濟。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Princess Kejing of the first rank married Khalkha prince Dundob Dorji.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Princess Kejing of the first rank was married to the Khalkha prince Dundob Dorji.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，朝鮮告糶，命運米三萬石往賑。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Korea reported grain shortage; thirty thousand shi of grain were ordered transported for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Korea reported a grain shortage, and thirty thousand shi of grain were ordered sent for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔直省報災即察實以聞。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, an edict: when provinces report disaster, investigate truthfully and report at once.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered that when provinces report disaster, officials should investigate promptly and report the facts at once.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，改宗室董額為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingmao: princely clansman Dong'e was reassigned as Manchu commandant-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingmao day, the princely clansman Dong'e was reassigned as Manchu commandant-general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day yihai, combined worship at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day combined worship was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、安徽、江西等省五十九州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster levies were remitted in varying degree for fifty-nine prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Anhui, Jiangxi, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster levies were remitted in varying degrees for fifty-nine prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Anhui, Jiangxi, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十七年戊寅春正月庚寅，策旺阿拉布坦奏陳第巴匿達賴喇嘛圓寂之事，斥班禪而自尊，懇請睿鑒。

translations.literal: Year thirty-seven, wuyin; first month of spring, day gengyin: Tsewang Rabtan memorialized that the Dalai Lama's passing had been concealed by the Depa, who rejected the Panchen and aggrandized himself, earnestly begging the Emperor's judgment.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year, wuyin cycle, on gengyin day in the first spring month, Tsewang Rabtan memorialized that the Depa had concealed the Dalai Lama's death, rejected the Panchen, and exalted himself, earnestly begging the Emperor's judgment.

sentences.zh: 上答之曰：「朕曾敕責第巴具奏認罪，若怙終不悛，朕不輕恕也。

translations.literal: The Emperor replied: "I have already ordered the Depa to memorialize confessing guilt; if he stubbornly refuses reform, I shall not lightly pardon him."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied, "I have already ordered the Depa to submit a memorial confessing guilt; if he stubbornly refuses to reform, I shall not lightly pardon him."

sentences.zh: 」並遣侍讀學士伊道等齎敕往。

translations.literal: " He also dispatched Reader of the Hanlin Academy Yi Dao and others to carry an imperial edict thither.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Hanlin reader Yi Dao and others to deliver an imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上巡幸五台山。

translations.literal: On guimao day the Emperor toured Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the emperor went on pilgrimage to Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，次涿州。

translations.literal: On jiachen day he halted at Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day he stopped at Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 命皇長子胤禔、大學士伊桑阿祭金太祖、世宗陵。

translations.literal: He ordered the eldest imperial son Yinti and Grand Secretary Isanggha to sacrifice at the tombs of Taizu and Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the eldest imperial son Yinti and Grand Secretary Isanggha to offer sacrifice at the tombs of Taizu and Shizong.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，詔免山西三十六年逋賦。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai: an edict remitted thirty-six years of tax arrears in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinhai day, an edict remitted thirty-six years of back taxes in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上駐蹕菩薩頂。

translations.literal: On guichou day the Emperor halted at the Bodhisattva Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the emperor lodged at the Bodhisattva Peak.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣官賑山東。

translations.literal: On yichou day officials were dispatched to relieve Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day officials were sent to provide disaster relief in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上還京。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子朔，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Third month, first day bingzi: the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the first day of the third month, the emperor presided over the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封皇長子胤禔為直郡王，皇三子胤祉為誠郡王，皇四子胤禛、皇五子胤祺、皇七子胤祐、皇八子胤禩俱為貝勒。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the eldest imperial son Yinti was enfeoffed as Prince of the First Rank Direct; the third son Yinchi as Prince Cheng; and the fourth son Yinzhen, fifth son Yinqi, seventh son Yinyou, and eighth son Yinsi were all made beile.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the eldest imperial son Yinti was created Prince of the First Rank Direct; the third son Yinchi was created Prince Cheng; and the fourth son Yinzhen, fifth son Yinqi, seventh son Yinyou, and eighth son Yinsi were all created beile.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁造燒酒。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the distilling of liquor was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the manufacture of distilled liquor was banned.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，直隸巡撫于成龍奏偕西洋人安多等履勘渾河，幫修挑濬，繪圖呈進。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Zhili Governor Yu Chenglong memorialized that, together with the Westerner Antoine Thomas and others, he had surveyed the Hun River on foot, assisted in dredging and excavation, and submitted a map.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Zhili governor Yu Chenglong reported that he and the Westerner Antoine Thomas and others had walked the length of the Hun River, helped with dredging, and submitted a survey map.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「於六月內完工。

translations.literal: A rescript was received: "It must be completed within the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript read, "Finish the work within the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，減廣東海關稅額。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guihai: the Guangdong maritime customs levy was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on guihai day, the Guangdong maritime customs quota was reduced.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔溫郡王延壽行止不端，降為貝勒，貝子袁端削爵。

translations.literal: On jisi day an edict said Prince Wen of Yun Yanshou's conduct was improper; he was demoted to beile, and Beizi Yuanduan was stripped of his title.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict said that Prince Wen of Yun Yanshou had behaved improperly and was demoted to beile, while Beizi Yuanduan was stripped of his rank.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以貝子蘇努管盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On renshen day Beizi Sunu was put in charge of the Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Beizi Sunu was appointed to oversee the Mukden garrison general.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上閱漕河。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the Emperor inspected the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the emperor inspected the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，武清民請築外堤。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiaxu: the people of Wuqing requested that outer dikes be built.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiaxu day, the people of Wuqing asked that outer dikes be built.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「築外堤恐損民田。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Building outer dikes may damage the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Building outer dikes may ruin people's farmland.

sentences.zh: 」民曰：「河決之害，更甚於損田。

translations.literal: " The people said: "The harm of a river breach is worse than damage to fields.
translations.idiomatic: The people replied, "A breach does more harm than lost fields.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「水潦將降，暫立木椿護堤，開小河泄水，俟明春雨水前為爾等成之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Floods are about to descend; for the moment set wooden piles to protect the dikes, open small channels to release the water, and before next spring's rains I will complete it for you.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The floods are coming. For now set wooden piles to shore up the dikes and cut small channels to drain the water; before next spring's rains I will finish the work for you.

sentences.zh: 」癸未，上還京。

translations.literal: " On guiwei day the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，裁上林苑。

translations.literal: On renyin day the Imperial Park was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Imperial Park was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以李林盛為陝西提督，張旺為廣西提督。

translations.literal: Li Linsheng was made Shaanxi provincial military commissioner, and Zhang Wang Guangxi provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Linsheng was appointed provincial military commissioner of Shaanxi, and Zhang Wang provincial military commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，策旺阿拉布坦上言與哈薩克構兵，及將丹津鄂木布拘禁各緣由。

translations.literal: That month Tsewang Rabtan memorialized on his conflict with the Kazakhs and the reasons for detaining Danjin Ombu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tsewang Rabtan reported his war with the Kazakhs and explained why he had detained Danjin Ombu.

sentences.zh: 命示議政大臣。

translations.literal: He was ordered to show it to the Council of Princes and Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was ordered shown to the Council of Princes and Ministers.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，移吳英為福建水師提督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinhai: Wu Ying was transferred to be Fujian naval commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinhai day, Wu Ying was transferred to be Fujian naval commander.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，改四川梁萬營為化林營，設參將以下官。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Sichuan's Liangwan Camp was renamed Hualin Camp, with a deputy commander and subordinate posts established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Sichuan's Liangwan Camp was renamed Hualin Camp and given a deputy commander and lower ranks.

sentences.zh: 己未，雲南巡撫石文晟奏三籓屬人奉旨免緝者，准其墾田應試。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Yunnan Governor Shi Wencheng memorialized that persons connected with the Three Feudatories who had been exempted from arrest by imperial order might reclaim land and sit for examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Yunnan governor Shi Wencheng asked that people tied to the Three Feudatories who had been exempted from arrest be allowed to reclaim land and take the examinations.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉朔，張玉書丁母憂，以吳琠為大學士，王士禛為左都御史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day guiyou: Zhang Yushu entered mourning for his mother; Wu Tai was made Grand Secretary, and Wang Shizhen Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on guiyou, the first day of the month, Zhang Yushu went into mourning for his mother; Wu Tai was appointed Grand Secretary and Wang Shizhen Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命吏部月選同、通、州、縣官引見。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the Board of Civil Appointments was ordered each month to present for audience officials of subprefect, prefect, and county rank selected in the monthly roster.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Board of Civil Appointments was ordered to present monthly for audience the subprefects, prefects, and magistrates chosen in the regular selection.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，霸州新河成，賜名永定河，建河神廟。

translations.literal: On guisi day the new canal at Bazhou was completed; it was given the name Yongding River, and a river-god temple was built.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the new canal at Bazhou was finished, named the Yongding River, and a temple to the river god was erected.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以盧崇耀為廣州將軍，殷化行為廣東提督。

translations.literal: On jihai day Lu Chongyao was made Guangzhou general, and Yin Huaxing Guangdong provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Lu Chongyao was appointed general at Guangzhou and Yin Huaxing provincial military commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以蘇爾發為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Suerfa was made Manchu Commandant-General.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Suerfa was appointed Manchu Commandant-General.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上奉皇太后東巡，取道塞外。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on an eastern tour, taking the route beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the emperor escorted the empress dowager on an eastern tour by way of the outer routes.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，上奉皇太后臨幸喀拉沁端靜公主第，賜金幣及其額駙噶爾臧。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guichou: the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit Princess Duanjing of the Kharachin at her residence and bestowed gold and coins on her and her consort Galdzan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou day, the emperor escorted the empress dowager to Princess Duanjing of the Kharachin and bestowed gold and coin on her and her consort Galdzan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，皇太后望祭父母於發庫山。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Empress Dowager performed a distance sacrifice to her parents at Faku Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the empress dowager offered a distance sacrifice to her parents at Faku Mountain.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜端敏公主及其額駙達爾漢親王班第金幣。

translations.literal: On jisi day Princess Duanmin and her consort, Prince Bandi of the Darhan, were granted gold and coins.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Princess Duanmin and her consort, Prince Bandi of the Darhan, were granted gold and coin.

sentences.zh: 湖南山賊黃明犯靖州，陳丹書犯茶陵州，官兵討平之。

translations.literal: In Hunan the mountain bandits Huang Ming attacked Jingzhou and Chen Danshu attacked Chaling Prefecture; government troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In Hunan the mountain bandits Huang Ming raided Jingzhou and Chen Danshu raided Chaling Prefecture; government troops put them down.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，上次克爾蘇，臨科爾沁故親王滿珠習禮墓前酹酒，孝庄皇后之父也。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: the Emperor halted at Ke'ersu and poured a libation before the tomb of the former Khorchin prince Manzhu Xili — father of Empress Xiaozhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, the emperor stopped at Ke'ersu and poured a libation at the tomb of the former Khorchin prince Manzhu Xili, father of Empress Xiaozhuang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上駐紮星阿。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Emperor halted at Xing'a.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the emperor halted at Xing'a.

sentences.zh: 賜黑龍江將軍薩布素等金幣冠服。

translations.literal: He bestowed gold, coins, robes, and caps on Heilongjiang General Sabusu and others.
translations.idiomatic: He bestowed gold, coin, robes, and caps on Heilongjiang general Sabusu and others.

sentences.zh: 庚子，停盛京、烏拉本年決囚。

translations.literal: On gengzi day capital punishments at Mukden and Wula were suspended for the year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day executions at Mukden and Wula were suspended for the year.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，上行圍，射殪二虎，其一虎，隔澗射之，穿其脇。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: the Emperor went on the hunting encampment and shot two tigers dead; one tiger, shot across a stream, was pierced through the flank.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on guimao day, the emperor went hunting and killed two tigers; one, shot across a ravine, was pierced through the flank.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上行圍，槍殪二熊。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Emperor went on the hunting encampment and with a gun killed two bears.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor went hunting and with a musket killed two bears.

sentences.zh: 是日，駐蹕輝發。

translations.literal: That day he halted at Huifa.
translations.idiomatic: That day he lodged at Huifa.

sentences.zh: 己酉，裁雲南永寧府，置永北府。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Yongning Prefecture in Yunnan was abolished and Yongbei Prefecture established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yongning Prefecture in Yunnan was abolished and Yongbei Prefecture established in its place.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上駐蹕興京。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Emperor halted at Xingjing.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the emperor halted at Xingjing.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上謁永陵。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Emperor visited Yongling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the emperor visited Yongling.

sentences.zh: 遣官賜奠武功郡王禮敦墓。

translations.literal: He dispatched an official to offer sacrifice at the tomb of Prince Wu of Gong Lidun.
translations.idiomatic: He sent an official to offer sacrifice at the tomb of Prince Wu of Gong Lidun.

sentences.zh: 改貴州水西土司，置大定、平遠、黔西三流官。

translations.literal: The Shuixi native chieftaincy in Guizhou was reformed, and the three regular prefectures of Dadin, Pingyuan, and Qianxi were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuixi native chieftaincy in Guizhou was abolished and replaced by the three regular prefectures of Dadin, Pingyuan, and Qianxi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上謁福陵、昭陵，臨奠武勛王揚古利、直義公費英東、弘毅公額亦都墓。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the Emperor visited Fuling and Zhaoling and offered sacrifice at the tombs of Prince Wuxun Yangguli, Duke Zhiyi Feiyingdong, and Duke Hongyi Eidu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the emperor visited Fuling and Zhaoling and offered sacrifice at the tombs of Prince Wuxun Yangguli, Duke Zhiyi Feiyingdong, and Duke Hongyi Eidu.

sentences.zh: 免奉天今年米豆。

translations.literal: Grain and beans due from Fengtian this year were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: This year's grain and bean levies in Fengtian were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上奉皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On renxu day the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on the return journey.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the emperor escorted the empress dowager on the return journey.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiwei: the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei day, the emperor escorted the empress dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔曰：「朕巡幸所經，敖漢、奈曼、阿祿科爾沁、扎魯特諸蒙部水草甚佳，而生計窘迫，蓋因牲畜被盜，不敢夜牧耳。

translations.literal: On bingxu day an edict said: "Along the route of my tour, the Mongol banners of Aohan, Naiman, Ar Horqin, and Zhalut have excellent pasture, yet their livelihoods are strained — largely because their livestock are stolen and they dare not pasture at night.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict said, "Along my tour the Mongol banners of Aohan, Naiman, Ar Horqin, and Zhalut have fine pasture, yet their people live in hardship because livestock are stolen and they dare not herd at night.

sentences.zh: 朕即遣郎中李學聖等往為料理，盜竊衰止。

translations.literal: I have already sent Director Li Xuesheng and others to handle the matter, and theft has declined.
translations.idiomatic: I have already sent Director Li Xuesheng and others to take charge, and theft has begun to fall off.

sentences.zh: 其他處蒙古亦宜照此差遣。

translations.literal: Other Mongol areas should likewise be sent officials on this model.
translations.idiomatic: Other Mongol regions should be handled in the same way.

sentences.zh: 旗員有原往蒙古教導者，准其前往。

translations.literal: Bannermen who wish to go to Mongolia to instruct the people are permitted to go.
translations.idiomatic: Bannermen who wish to go to Mongolia to instruct the people may do so.

sentences.zh: 命盜各案，同聽決之。

translations.literal: In theft cases of every kind they are to hear and decide together.
translations.idiomatic: In all theft cases they are to hear and decide together.

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，以張鵬翮為江南江西總督。

translations.literal: " On gengyin day Zhang Penghe was made Governor-General of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Zhang Penghe was appointed governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑朔，命徐廷璽協理河務，命尚書馬齊，侍郎喻成龍、常綬察視河工。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day xinchou: Xu Tingxi was ordered to assist in river works; Ministers Maqi and Vice Ministers Yu Chenglong and Chang Shou were ordered to inspect the river projects.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the first day of the twelfth month, Xu Tingxi was ordered to assist in river works, and Minister Maqi and Vice Ministers Yu Chenglong and Chang Shou were ordered to inspect the river projects.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，諭宗人府：「閒散宗室，材力幹濟，精於騎射，及貧無生計者，各察實以聞。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the Imperial Clan Court was instructed: "Idle clansmen of ability, skilled in riding and archery, and those poor and without livelihood — investigate each case and report.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Imperial Clan Court was instructed, "For idle clansmen of ability, skilled in riding and archery, and those who are poor and without livelihood, investigate each case and report.

sentences.zh: 」詔官民妻女緣事牽連，勿拘訊，著為令。

translations.literal: " An edict said that when officials' and commoners' wives and daughters were implicated in cases, they were not to be detained for questioning; this was made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that when officials' and commoners' wives and daughters were implicated in cases they were not to be detained for questioning, and this was made a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 改四川東川土司為東川府，設知府以下官。

translations.literal: The Dongchuan native chieftaincy in Sichuan was changed to Dongchuan Prefecture, with a prefect and subordinate officials established.
translations.idiomatic: The Dongchuan native chieftaincy in Sichuan was converted into Dongchuan Prefecture with a prefect and subordinate officials.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔八旗察訪孝子節婦。

translations.literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered the Eight Banners to seek out filial sons and chaste widows.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered the Eight Banners to seek out filial sons and chaste widows.

sentences.zh: 己未，以巴錫為雲南貴州總督，馬自德為京口將軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Baxi was made Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou, and Ma Zide Jingkou general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Baxi was appointed governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, and Ma Zide garrison general at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On jisi day the collective winter sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the collective winter sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、福建、浙江、湖廣等省三十五州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for thirty-five prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees in thirty-five prefectures and counties of Zhili, Jiangnan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十八年己卯春正月辛卯，詔：「朕將南巡察閱河工，一切供億，由京備辦。

translations.literal: Thirty-eighth year, jimao, spring, first month, day xinmao: an edict said: "I am about to tour south to inspect the river works; all supplies shall be prepared from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, jimao, spring, first month, on xinmao day, an edict said, "I am about to tour south to inspect the river works; all supplies shall be prepared from the capital.

sentences.zh: 預飭官吏，勿累閭閻。

translations.literal: Officials are to be warned in advance not to burden the people.
translations.idiomatic: Officials are to be warned in advance not to burden the people.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，詹事尹泰以不職解任。

translations.literal: Second month, day renyin: Yin Tai, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was dismissed for incompetence.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renyin day, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Yin Tai was dismissed for incompetence.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上奉皇太后南巡啟鑾。

translations.literal: On guimao day the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager as the southern tour set out.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the emperor escorted the empress dowager as the southern tour set out.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以天津總兵潘育龍訓練有方，賜御服貂裘。

translations.literal: On wushen day Tianjin Regional Commander Pan Yulong, for disciplined training, was granted an imperial sable fur coat.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Tianjin regional commander Pan Yulong, for his disciplined training of troops, was granted an imperial sable coat.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，上次清口，奉皇太后渡河。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu: the Emperor halted at Qingkou and escorted the Empress Dowager across the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengwu day, the emperor stopped at Qingkou and escorted the empress dowager across the river.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上御小舟，臨閱高家堰、歸仁堤、爛泥淺等工。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the Emperor boarded a small boat and inspected in person the works at Gaojiayan, the Guiren Dike, and Nianniyan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the emperor boarded a small boat and personally inspected the works at Gaojiayan, the Guiren Dike, and Nianniyan.

sentences.zh: 截漕糧十萬石，發高郵、寶應等十二州縣平糶。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand piculs of tribute grain were diverted, and grain was released for sale at fair price in twelve prefectures and counties including Gaoyou and Baoying.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred thousand piculs of tribute grain were diverted, and grain was released for sale at fair price in twelve prefectures and counties including Gaoyou and Baoying.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上閱黃河堤。

translations.literal: On renshen day the Emperor inspected the Yellow River dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the emperor inspected the Yellow River dikes.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕駐揚州。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage halted at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage halted at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 諭隨從兵士勿踐麥禾。

translations.literal: He instructed the accompanying soldiers not to trample the wheat and grain.
translations.idiomatic: He instructed the accompanying soldiers not to trample the wheat and grain.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔免山東、河南逋賦，曲赦死罪以下。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict remitted tax arrears in Shandong and Henan and granted a special pardon below the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict remitted tax arrears in Shandong and Henan and granted a special pardon below the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 癸未，車駕次蘇州。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the imperial carriage stopped at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the imperial carriage stopped at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，車駕駐杭州。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the imperial carriage halted at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the imperial carriage halted at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上閱兵較射。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the Emperor reviewed the troops and held an archery contest.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the emperor reviewed the troops and held an archery contest.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上奉皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on the return journey.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the emperor escorted the empress dowager on the return journey.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子朔，回次蘇州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day gengzi: on the return journey he stopped again at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on gengzi, the first day of the month, he stopped again at Suzhou on the return journey.

sentences.zh: 詔免鹽課、關稅加增銀兩，特廣江、浙二省學額。

translations.literal: An edict remitted the added silver on the salt levy and customs duties and specially enlarged the examination quotas for Jiangsu and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted the added silver on the salt levy and customs duties and specially enlarged the examination quotas for Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以丹岱為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: On yisi day Dandai was made Hangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Dandai was appointed general at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，車駕次江寧。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the imperial carriage stopped at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the imperial carriage stopped at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 上閱兵。

translations.literal: The Emperor reviewed the troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reviewed the troops.

sentences.zh: 庚申，次揚州。

translations.literal: On gengshen day he stopped at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he stopped at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以彭鵬為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Peng Peng was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Peng Peng was appointed governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，渡黃河，上乘小舟閱新埽。

translations.literal: On bingyin day he crossed the Yellow River; the Emperor boarded a small boat to inspect the new revetment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day he crossed the Yellow River, and the emperor boarded a small boat to inspect the new revetment.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，次仲家閘，書「聖門之哲」額，懸先賢子路祠。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei: he stopped at Zhongjia Sluice, wrote the plaque "Sage of the Confucian Gate," and hung it at the shrine of the former worthy Zilu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinwei day, he stopped at Zhongjia Sluice, wrote the plaque "Sage of the Confucian Gate," and hung it at the shrine of the former worthy Zilu.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the emperor escorted the empress dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以馬爾漢為左都御史，王鴻緒為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Ma Erhan was made Left Censor-in-Chief, and Wang Hongxu Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Ma Erhan was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief and Wang Hongxu Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌朔，起郭琇為湖廣總督，以鎮國公英奇為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on wuxu: Guo Qiu was reinstated as governor-general of Huguang; Guo-guo-gong Yingqi was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the sixth month, Guo Qiu was reinstated as governor-general of Huguang, and Guo-guo-gong Yingqi was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，河決淮、揚。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiashen: the Yellow River burst its banks in the Huai and Yang regions.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiashen day, the Yellow River broke through at Huai and Yang.

sentences.zh: 閏七月戊戌，敏妃張佳氏薨。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day wuxu: Consort Min, née Zhangjia, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, on wuxu day, Consort Min of the Zhangjia clan died.

sentences.zh: 誠郡王胤祉其所出也，不及百日薙髮，降貝勒。

translations.literal: Prince Cheng Yinzhi was her son; he shaved his head before the hundred-day mourning had passed and was demoted to beile.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Cheng Yinzhi was her son; he tonsured before the hundred-day mourning had passed and was demoted to beile.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，先是，苗賊黃明屢報獲報死，仍報犯事。

translations.literal: On day guichou: earlier, the Miao bandit Huang Ming had repeatedly been reported captured or killed, yet fresh reports of crimes still came in.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day: earlier, the Miao bandit Huang Ming had repeatedly been reported captured or killed, yet fresh reports of outrages still arrived.

sentences.zh: 至是，遣官按鞫，並其夥陳丹書、吳思先等三十餘人誅之。

translations.literal: Now officials were sent to investigate on the spot; Chen Danshu, Wu Sixian, and more than thirty accomplices were executed.
translations.idiomatic: At this time officials were dispatched to investigate; Chen Danshu, Wu Sixian, and more than thirty accomplices were put to death.

sentences.zh: 其奏報不實之督撫麻勒吉等降黜有差。

translations.literal: The governors-general and governors who had filed false reports, including Malaqi, were demoted or dismissed to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Governors-general and governors who had reported falsely, including Malaqi, were demoted or dismissed in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: The Emperor toured the outer marches.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor toured the outer marches.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，上還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu day, the emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor presided at the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the emperor presided at the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 改揚岱為滿洲都統，魯伯赫、拖倫、崇古禮俱為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Yangdai was made Manchu commander-in-chief; Luberhe, Tuolun, and Chongguli were all made Mongol commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yangdai was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief; Luberhe, Tuolun, and Chongguli were all appointed Mongol commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大學士阿蘭泰卒，上悼惜之，遣皇長子胤禔視疾，賜奠加祭，諡文清。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Grand Secretary Alan Tai died; the Emperor mourned him, sent the First Imperial Son Yinti to visit his sickbed, granted funeral offerings with an additional sacrifice, and gave the posthumous title Wenqing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Grand Secretary Alan Tai died; the emperor mourned him, sent the First Imperial Son Yinti to inquire after him, granted sacrificial gifts with added rites, and bestowed the posthumous title Wenqing.
