translations.literal: Third month, day wuzi: the Emperor presided at the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi day, the emperor presided at the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，張鵬翮請以治河方略纂集成書。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Zhang Penghe asked to compile river-control methods into a book.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Zhang Penghe asked to compile river-control methods into a book.

sentences.zh: 上斥之曰：「朕於河務之書，罔不披閱，大約坐言則易，實行則難。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked him: "I have read every book on river affairs; in general it is easy to speak at a desk but hard to carry out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked him: "I have read every book on river affairs; in general it is easy to speak at a desk but hard to carry out.

sentences.zh: 河性無定，豈可執一法以繩之。

translations.literal: The river has no fixed nature; how can one method bind it?
translations.idiomatic: The river has no fixed nature; how can one method bind it?

sentences.zh: 編輯成書，非但後人難以仿行，即揆之己心，亦難自信。

translations.literal: Compiled into a book, not only would later men find it hard to follow, but measured against my own mind I could hardly trust it.
translations.idiomatic: Compiled into a book, not only would later men find it hard to follow, but measured against my own mind I could hardly trust it.

sentences.zh: 張鵬翮試編輯之！

translations.literal: Let Zhang Penghe try compiling it!
translations.idiomatic: Let Zhang Penghe try compiling it!

sentences.zh: 」給事中馬士芳劾湖北布政使任風厚年老。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] Supervising secretary Ma Shifang impeached Hubei provincial treasurer Ren Fenghou for old age.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Ma Shifang impeached Hubei provincial treasurer Ren Fenghou for old age.

sentences.zh: 調來引見，年尚未衰。

translations.literal: Ren was summoned for audience; he was not yet infirm.
translations.idiomatic: Ren was summoned for audience; he was not yet infirm.

sentences.zh: 上因諭曰：「坐而辦事，必得老成練達者，方能得當，州縣官則不可耳。

translations.literal: The Emperor therefore instructed: "For desk work one must have the seasoned and experienced to get it right; that does not apply to district magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor therefore instructed, "For desk work one must have the seasoned and experienced to get it right; that does not apply to district magistrates.

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: [Closing quotation mark]

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，調李林盛為甘肅提督，擢潘育龍為固原提督，移藍理為天津總兵官，以曹秉桓為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiwei: Li Linsheng was transferred to Gansu provincial commander; Pan Yulong was promoted to Guyuan commander; Lan Li was moved to Tianjin regional commander; Cao Binghuan was made Chinese Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jiwei day, Li Linsheng was transferred to Gansu provincial commander; Pan Yulong was promoted Guyuan commander; Lan Li was moved to Tianjin regional commander; and Cao Binghuan was made Chinese Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙子，刑部尚書王士禛請假回籍。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Minister of Punishments Wang Shizhen asked leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Minister of Punishments Wang Shizhen asked leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 上諭大學士曰：「山東人性多偏執，好勝尋仇，惟王士禛無之。

translations.literal: The Emperor told the Grand Secretaries: "Shandong men are mostly obstinate, eager to win and quick to feud—only Wang Shizhen is not so.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the Grand Secretaries, "Shandong men are mostly obstinate, eager to win and quick to feud—only Wang Shizhen is not so.

sentences.zh: 其詩甚佳，居家惟讀書。

translations.literal: His poetry is excellent; at home he reads only books.
translations.idiomatic: His poetry is excellent; at home he reads only books.

sentences.zh: 若令回籍，殊為可惜。

translations.literal: To let him return home would be a real loss.
translations.idiomatic: To let him return home would be a real loss.

sentences.zh: 給假五月，不必開缺。

translations.literal: Grant five months' leave without vacating his post.
translations.idiomatic: Grant five months' leave without vacating his post.

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，上閱永定河。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day dingchou, the Emperor inspected the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the emperor inspected the Yongding River.

sentences.zh: 諭李光地：「隆冬冰結，可照常開泄。

translations.literal: He instructed Li Guangdi: "In deep winter when ice forms, sluices may be opened as usual.
translations.idiomatic: He instructed Li Guangdi, "In deep winter when ice forms, sluices may be opened as usual.

sentences.zh: 清水流於冰下，為冰所逼，沖刷河底愈深。

translations.literal: Clear water flowing under the ice, forced by the ice, scours the riverbed deeper.
translations.idiomatic: Clear water flowing under the ice, forced by the ice, scours the riverbed deeper.

sentences.zh: 」閱大灣口，諭：「石堤尚未興工，可以南來杉木排椿，爾等勿忽。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] Inspecting Dawankou, he instructed: "The stone dike is not yet under construction; southern fir can be rafted in for piling—you must not neglect this.
translations.idiomatic: Inspecting Dawankou, he instructed, "The stone dike is not yet under construction; southern fir can be rafted in for piling—you must not neglect this.

sentences.zh: 」閱子牙河。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] He inspected the Ziya River.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected the Ziya River.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上還京。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，黑龍江管水手官員缺，部臣擬補遣戍道員周昌。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi: a vacancy for an official managing Heilongjiang boatmen; the ministry proposed the exiled circuit intendant Zhou Chang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guisi day, there was a vacancy for an official managing Heilongjiang boatmen; the ministry proposed the exiled circuit intendant Zhou Chang.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「周昌既遣戍矣，又補官烏拉，是終身不得歸也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Zhou Chang has already been exiled; to appoint him again at Wula means he could never return home.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Zhou Chang has already been exiled; to appoint him again at Wula means he could never return home.

sentences.zh: 可令八旗官原效力者為之。

translations.literal: Let a banner officer who had been serving on merit take the post.
translations.idiomatic: Let a banner officer who had been serving on merit take the post.

sentences.zh: 」戊申，御史張瑗請毀前明內監魏忠賢墓，從之。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day wushen, censor Zhang Yuan asked to destroy the tomb of the Ming eunuch Wei Zhongxian; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Censor Zhang Yuan asked to destroy the tomb of the Ming eunuch Wei Zhongxian; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor toured the outer marches.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the emperor toured the outer marches.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，授宋儒邵雍後裔五經博士。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: a descendant of the Song scholar Shao Yong was appointed Erudite of the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengchen day, a descendant of the Song scholar Shao Yong was appointed Erudite of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，領侍衛內大臣公費揚古隨扈患病，上為停鑾一日，親往視疾。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai: Duke Feiyanggu, chief guard of the heir apparent, fell ill while accompanying the hunt; the Emperor halted the imperial progress for one day and went in person to visit him.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on dinghai day, Duke Feiyanggu, chief guard of the heir apparent, fell ill while on the hunting tour; the emperor halted the imperial progress for one day and went in person to visit him.

sentences.zh: 隨以不起聞，賜鞍馬三匹，散馬四匹，銀五千兩，遣大臣護送還京，予祭葬，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: Soon word came that he would not recover; three saddled horses, four remounts, and 5,000 taels of silver were granted; a minister escorted him back to the capital; funeral rites were granted; posthumous title Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon word came that he would not recover; three saddled horses, four remounts, and 5,000 taels of silver were granted; a minister escorted him back to the capital; funeral rites were granted; posthumous title Xiangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，上幸索岳爾濟山。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yichou: the Emperor visited Mount Suoyarji.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou day, the emperor visited Mount Suoyarji.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「此山形勢崇隆，允稱名勝。

translations.literal: An edict said: "This mountain rises in lofty grandeur and truly deserves the name of a scenic wonder.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "This mountain rises in lofty grandeur and truly deserves the name of a scenic wonder.

sentences.zh: 嗣後此處禁斷行圍。

translations.literal: Henceforth hunting encampments are forbidden here.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth hunting encampments are forbidden here.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，上次馬尼圖行圍，一矢穿兩黃羊，並斷拉哈里木，蒙古皆驚。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On day jiashen, the Emperor held a hunting encampment at Manitu; one arrow pierced two yellow sheep and broke a laharimu target; the Mongols were all astonished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the emperor held a hunting encampment at Manitu; one arrow pierced two yellow sheep and broke a laharimu target; the Mongols were all astonished.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，簡親王雅布隨扈薨，命大臣送還京，皇長子胤禔、皇三子胤祉出迎，遣官治喪，賜銀四千兩，皇子合助銀三千兩。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinchou: Prince Jian Yabu died while accompanying the hunt; a minister was sent to escort the body to the capital; the First Imperial Son Yinti and the Third Imperial Son Yinzhi went out to meet it; officials were sent to manage the funeral; 4,000 taels of silver were granted and the princes together contributed 3,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou day, Prince Jian Yabu died while accompanying the hunt; a minister was sent to escort the body to the capital; the First Imperial Son Yinti and the Third Imperial Son Yinzhi went out to meet it; officials were sent to manage the funeral; 4,000 taels of silver were granted and the princes together contributed 3,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 發引時，皇子侍往送，予祭葬立碑，諡曰修。

translations.literal: When the coffin was moved, the princes attended to escort it; funeral rites and a stele were granted; posthumous title Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin was moved, the princes attended to escort it; funeral rites and a stele were granted; posthumous title Xiu.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上還京。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor presided at the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the emperor presided at the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 大學士王熙以衰疾乞休，溫旨衛慰諭，加少傅致仕。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Wang Xi, citing age and illness, asked to retire; a warm edict comforted him and he was made Junior Tutor and allowed to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Wang Xi, citing age and illness, asked to retire; a warm edict comforted him and he was made Junior Tutor and allowed to leave office.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹之女鍾齊海到京，命與其兄一等侍衛色卜騰巴爾珠爾同居，配二等侍衛蒙古沙克都爾。

translations.literal: Galdan's daughter Zhongqihai arrived in the capital; she was ordered to live with her elder brother, First-rank Bodyguard Sebetengba'erzhu'er, and was given in marriage to Second-rank Bodyguard Mongol Shakuduo'er.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan's daughter Zhongqihai arrived in the capital; she was ordered to live with her elder brother, First-rank Bodyguard Sebetengba'erzhu'er, and was given in marriage to Second-rank Bodyguard Mongol Shakuduo'er.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，以宗室特克新為滿洲都統，迓圖布爾塞為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuwu: the imperial clansman Tekexin was made Manchu commander-in-chief and Yatuobu'erse Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on wuwu day, the imperial clansman Tekexin was made Manchu commander-in-chief and Yatuobu'erse Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己未，召大學士張玉書還朝。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu was recalled to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 詔免甘肅來年額賦。

translations.literal: An edict remitted Gansu's scheduled land tax for next year.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted Gansu's scheduled land tax for next year.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以梁鼐為福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Liang Nai was made Fujian land-force provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Liang Nai was made Fujian land-force provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免江蘇明年額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Jiangsu's scheduled land tax for next year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Jiangsu's scheduled land tax for next year was remitted.

sentences.zh: 起岳升龍為四川提督。

translations.literal: Yue Shenglong was reinstated as Sichuan provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Shenglong was reinstated as Sichuan provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 辛未，改普奇為滿洲都統，孫渣齊為蒙古都統，以華顯為四川陝西總督。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Puqi was made Manchu commander-in-chief, Sunzhachi Mongol commander-in-chief, and Hua Xian governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Puqi was made Manchu commander-in-chief, Sunzhachi Mongol commander-in-chief, and Hua Xian governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大學士張英乞休，溫旨慰諭令致仕。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Grand Secretary Zhang Ying asked to retire; a warm edict comforted him and he was allowed to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Grand Secretary Zhang Ying asked to retire; a warm edict comforted him and he was allowed to leave office.

sentences.zh: 御史靳讓疏言為州縣者，須令家給人足，方為良吏。

translations.literal: Censor Jin Rang memorialized that a good district magistrate must make every household secure and provided for.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Jin Rang memorialized that a good district magistrate must make every household secure and provided for.

sentences.zh: 命改靳讓通州知州。

translations.literal: Jin Rang was appointed magistrate of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Rang was appointed magistrate of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔總督郭琇、張鵬翮、桑額、華顯，巡撫李光地、彭鵬、徐潮各舉賢能。

translations.literal: An edict ordered governors-general Guo Qiu, Zhang Penghe, Sang'e, and Hua Xian, and governors Li Guangdi, Peng Peng, and Xu Chao each to recommend able men.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered governors-general Guo Qiu, Zhang Penghe, Sang'e, and Hua Xian, and governors Li Guangdi, Peng Peng, and Xu Chao each to recommend able men.

sentences.zh: 平悼郡王訥爾福薨，子訥爾素襲爵。

translations.literal: Prince Pingdao Ne'erfu died; his son Ne'ersu inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Pingdao Ne'erfu died; his son Ne'ersu inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，詔：「朕詳閱秋審重案，字句多誤。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu: an edict said: "I have carefully reviewed the autumn assize capital cases; the wording contains many errors.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day, an edict said, "I have carefully reviewed the autumn assize capital cases; the wording contains many errors.

sentences.zh: 廷臣竟未察出一二，刑部尤為不慎，其議罰之。

translations.literal: The court ministers did not catch a single one; the Board of Punishments was especially careless—let penalties be deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: The court ministers did not catch a single one; the Board of Punishments was especially careless—let penalties be deliberated.

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark]
translations.idiomatic: [Closing quotation mark]

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，廣東連山瑤匪作亂，命都統嵩祝討之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renshen: Yao bandits at Lianshan in Guangdong rebelled; Commander-in-chief Song Zhu was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen day, Yao bandits at Lianshan in Guangdong rebelled; Commander-in-chief Song Zhu was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、河南、陝西、廣東等省四十二州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for forty-two prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for forty-two prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.
